title: 1st & 2nd Level Support Specialist im Neo-Banking m/w/d  Hotline & Backoffice
descriptionHtml:
Generation Impuls sucht Verstärkung! Für unseren Partner – eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Neo-Banken Europas mit Sitz in Amsterdam – suchen wir starke Profile für den deutschen Markt. In dieser Rolle bist du weit mehr als klassischer Kundenservice: Du bist das Aushängeschild der Bank, Problemlöser und das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen unseren Nutzern und der Technik.

Aufgaben

Im 1st Level Support (Hotline, Chat & E-Mail):

  • Der direkte Kontakt: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere deutschsprachigen Privat- und Geschäftskunden. Du begleitest sie beim digitalen Onboarding, erklärst App-Funktionen und hilfst bei der Kontoeinrichtung.
  • Troubleshooting: Kunden melden sich bei dir wegen verlorener Karten, vergessener PINs oder Fragen zu aktuellen Abbuchungen. Du reagierst schnell, kompetent und absolut lösungsorientiert.
  • KYC & Sicherheit: Du unterstützt bei Fragen zum Identifikationsverfahren (Know Your Customer) und gibst verlässliche Hilfestellungen bei gesperrten Konten oder Sicherheitswarnungen.

Im 2nd Level Support & Backoffice:

  • Komplexe Fälle: Du übernimmst die Tickets, die im 1st Level nicht sofort gelöst werden können. Dazu gehören detaillierte Zahlungsnachverfolgungen (SEPA/SWIFT), Chargebacks und unklare Transaktionsfehler.
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit internen Fachabteilungen wie Compliance, Fraud Prevention und der IT, um tiefgreifende Account-Probleme zu eskalieren und nachhaltig zu lösen.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Muster, dokumentierst Bugs sauber im System und hilfst proaktiv dabei, unsere internen FAQs und Service-Workflows weiter zu verschlanke

Qualifikation

  • Sprachen: Dein Deutsch ist fehlerfrei in Wort und Schrift (C1/C2) und du sprichst fließend Englisch. Unsere gesamte interne Firmenkommunikation sowie die Software-Systeme laufen auf Englisch.
  • Erfahrung: Du hast nachweisbare Berufserfahrung im kundennahen Umfeld (Customer Care, Support, Backoffice) – idealerweise im Bereich Finanzen, E-Commerce oder bei einem Tech-Start-up.
  • Klartext statt Floskeln: Du redest nicht um den heißen Brei herum. Du kannst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Sachverhalte einfach und verständlich erklären – direkt, transparent und ohne überflüssige Phrasen.
  • Tech-Affinität: Du arbeitest sicher in digitalen, cloud-basierten Umgebungen. Du nutzt mühelos moderne CRM- und Ticketsysteme und behältst auch bei mehreren geöffneten Fenstern souverän den Überblick.
  • Stressresistenz: Im Banking geht es um das Geld unserer Kunden. Du bleibst professionell, verbindlich und empathisch, auch wenn die Situation am anderen Ende der Leitung einmal hitzig wird.

Benefits

  • Internationales Umfeld: Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz wahlweise im Zentrum von Amsterdam oder an einem unserer deutschen Standorte – verbunden mit einem durchweg internationalen Team.
  • Klare Strukturen: Bei uns gibt es keine langen Debatten oder verstaubte Banken-Hierarchien. Wir schätzen klare operative Grenzen, unmittelbare Verantwortlichkeit und schnelle Entscheidungen.
  • Modernes Setup: State-of-the-Art Equipment für reibungslose, digitale Arbeitsabläufe.
  • Wachstum: Ein fundiertes Onboarding und die echte Chance, in einem schnell skalierenden Fintech mitzuwachsen und dich intern weiterzuentwickeln.

Passt das zu dir?

Dann verlier keine Zeit. Schick uns direkt deine Unterlagen durch – wir freuen uns darauf, zu sehen, wer du bist!

title: 3D Data Operator (w/m/d) | 3D Scans to Digital Twins of Real Factories
descriptionHtml:
Transforming factory scans into digital reality

At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts.

We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. This is an entry-level role with defined workflows and plenty of support, ideal if you’re starting your career or moving into 3D and tech. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline.

At a glance:

  • Location: Düsseldorf, hybrid, with regular days in our Düsseldorf office

  • Full time (40h/week), 12-month fixed-term contract

  • Level: entry-level, a first step into 3D data work

Your daily work

  • Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows.

  • Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing.

  • Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others).

  • Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results.

  • Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues).

  • Track and report your weekly processing output.

  • Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges.

What we are looking for

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to reliably handle repetitive tasks with care.

  • Self-motivated and dependable: you take responsibility and get things done.

  • Comfortable following defined workflows and standards, and asking for help when something is unclear.

  • Team player with a proactive mindset: you enjoy working in a collaborative team.

  • Fast learner: no prior experience with point clouds required; you're comfortable picking up new tools and workflows quickly.

  • Basic digital literacy: you're confident navigating structured software tools, browser-based interfaces and Microsoft Office.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 3D environments (e.g., through gaming, CAD, or similar), or a general spatial intuition.

  • English is a must; proficiency in German is a plus for clear communication with the team.

  • Right to work in Germany: You already have the right to work full time in Germany. We can’t offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Based in or near Düsseldorf: This is a hybrid role with regular days in our Düsseldorf office, so you should be able to commute there regularly.

Nice to have

  • Experience with 3D tools or software (e.g., CAD, 3D modelling, game engines) or 3D scan data, or a general spatial intuition.

  • Familiarity with industrial or manufacturing environments, for example through a technical apprenticeship, studies, or work in production or engineering.

This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the opportunity to extend or move to a permanent contract based on performance and business development.

Benefits

  • Additional vacation days

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid office culture

  • Public transport subsidy

Why You Should Join

  • Build something that makes a tangible difference in the world's most important sector: manufacturing.

  • Help shape a product that is being built from first principles.

  • Collaborate with a sharp, hands-on team that values speed, clarity, and ownership.

  • Backed by top international investors and preparing to scale.

title: Account Director, Influencer Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

Position Overview:

Viral Nation is seeking a dedicated Account Director with a robust mix of influencer marketing, social media, analytics, and content marketing experience. By nature, they are a confident, courageous and strategic leader who excels in building bulletproof relationships with both their clients and their internal team. They are known to bring value to every conversation, provide consultative direction to their clients, and know when and how to challenge the status quo within our ever-changing industry. 

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for key clients, owning strategic relationships and ensuring consistent alignment to goals, KPIs, and performance expectations.
  • Identify, develop, and surface growth and expansion opportunities across accounts, partnering with CSLs and internal teams to drive revenue and long-term client value.
  • Lead strategic planning, quarterly business reviews, success measurement, and account vision-setting, ensuring narratives are insight-driven, performance-focused, and tied to client impact.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign execution across influencer, community management, production, paid social, and events, ensuring flawless delivery across all products and services.
  • Lead and oversee creator communications for Macro & Mega tiers, ensuring white-glove talent management, clear expectations, and strong partnership execution.
  • Manage campaign pacing, KPIs, optimization efforts, and overall program success to consistently meet or exceed performance benchmarks.
  • Drive elevated brand storytelling, creative ideation, insights, and analytics, pushing teams to deliver innovative, differentiated work across a client portfolio.
  • Lead the BI partnership kickoff for all key accounts, aligning on measurement frameworks, KPIs, reporting timelines, and success metrics in collaboration with the CSL.
  • Own the wrap-report workflow, coordinating with BI, reviewing all reports for accuracy and strategic alignment, and ensuring insights are clearly communicated to clients.
  • Provide leadership, guidance and escalation support to Account Supervisors and Account Managers, fostering accountability and growth.
  • Coach and develop direct reports by providing regular feedback, training, and guidance, fostering a collaborative team culture that drives strong performance, career growth, and high-quality client delivery.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Creative, Finance, and BI to deliver integrated, scalable solutions for clients.
  • Act as the internal advocate for the client’s POV, ensuring their needs, priorities, and feedback are clearly represented across teams while balancing those inputs with what’s required to deliver successful, high-performing campaigns.
  • Maintain accurate Kantata project data, ensuring budgets, resourcing, timelines, and tasks are consistently reviewed and optimized.
  • Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies across planning, forecasting, and client-facing materials to improve speed, quality, and scalability.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 6+ years of experience in digital, social, and influencer marketing across integrated service offerings, managing multiple client portfolios with strong business outcomes.
  • Proven expertise in strategic planning, business insights, and performance measurement, using data to guide client recommendations, forecasting, and account growth.
  • Advanced knowledge of influencer marketing and production strategy, including paid and organic tactics, contract negotiations, content development, and campaign measurement.
  • Strong ability to lead high-level client relationships, ensuring alignment to goals, long-term partnership success, and consistent delivery.
  • Demonstrated success in revenue growth and account expansion through strategic recommendations and opportunity identification.
  • Effective people leader with experience coaching and developing teams to meet client expectations and performance standards.
  • Exceptional project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, partnering with planning, creative, production, and media teams to drive results.
  • Expert grasp of social platforms, amplification strategies, and cross-channel integration.
  • Proficient with influencer management tools (e.g., CreatorIQ, Klear, Tagger, Upfluence), social management platforms (Sprout, Sprinklr, Hootsuite), CRM tools (HubSpot), and presentation software (MS Office, Google Workspace).
  • Familiarity with creative tools (Photoshop, Canva, motion graphics) and relevant certifications (Facebook Blueprint, Twitter Flight School, Google Analytics) are a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Privacy Policy:

By submitting your application, you acknowledge your data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. 

Compensation Philosophy:
At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.
Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.   AI in Recruitment:   Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across France and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and French

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, plus remote teams across several European countries. Under our choice-first work approach, you can work fully remotely from Day 1. That said, we’ve found people generally ramp faster when they spend a few days a week in the office alongside the team (esp. in the early months) and we hope you’ll want to.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £62-70k base + 100% variable (OTE £124-140k) with accelerators, at IC3 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over about 3 weeks.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Max Baldry-Steen, Director of Sales

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

  

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Buyers come to Juro because we're easy to use and fast to implement, AI runs through the whole product and our product team ships fast. To keep up with that demand in 2027, we're growing our Account Executive team.

 

Your role is to drive new business growth at Juro. That means:

  1. Meet or beat your ARR target (around $800k new business a year).

  2. Build a strong pipeline, with a good share of it from leads you generate yourself.

  3. Land a clear value narrative with prospects: real pain, a business case, buy-in from several stakeholders.

  4. Keep your CRM and forecast reliable and accurate.

  5. Run a high-velocity motion that makes it easy for smaller companies to buy Juro, alongside larger $100k+ deals.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

  

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four Principles. We hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

 

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You carried and hit a quota of around $800k a year at a B2B SaaS scale-up, incl. a good share of pipeline you built yourself.

  • You sold in a high-velocity motion - 5-week cycles and ACVs around $20-50k — you also closed some larger deals.

  • You multi-thread by default, and your discovery builds a business case with several stakeholders, not a feature tour.

  • You use AI every day in your sales work (research, call prep, follow-up) and have opinions about what works.

 

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • Your quota, velocity or ACV are far from ours. Quotas under $600k, 90+ day cycles, or deals well outside $20-100k usually make ramping here hard.

  • You’re waiting for marketing to fill your pipeline. Our inbound is strong, but the best reps here build their own.

  • You rely on a single champion to carry the deal.

  • You wait for the buyer to set next steps. Here, AEs ask for the deal and drive it.

  • You don't want regular feedback. We share call scorecards and pipeline data openly, and we expect you to act on them quickly.

  • Your pitch is "sales-y". We sell to legal and operations leaders, who dislike that style.

  

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

  • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

  • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

  • builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Commercial AE is where incident.io's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business.

What that looks like day to day

This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.

You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.

We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.

What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.

AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.

The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.

Who you are

  • You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

  • Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

  • You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell.

  • You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own.

  • You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you.

  • You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon.

  • Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover, we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

À propos de Lexroom
Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va structurer et faire grandir l'équipe d'Account Executives.

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne vendez pas un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue.

  • Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur : vous définissez les standards, les process et la culture commerciale de l'équipe dès le départ.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter le revenu outbound SMB : objectifs d'ARR, couverture de pipeline, taux de conversion, durée de cycle, ACV, gestion rigoureuse des remises, prévisions fiables.

  • Manager et coacher une équipe d'AE full-cycle : 1:1 hebdomadaires, revues de pipeline, coaching sur les appels, stratégie de deals, plans d'amélioration concrets.

  • Construire la machine outbound : segmentation ICP, découpage des territoires, stratégie de sourcing des comptes, prospection multicanale (téléphone, email, LinkedIn), standards de cadence et suivi activité → résultats.

  • Recruter, onboarder et faire monter en compétence les AE, avec un plan de ramp-up et des jalons clairs.

  • Gérer la performance : attentes claires, rituels hebdomadaires (WBR), diagnostic des causes (compétence, motivation, territoire, message) et action rapide en cas de sous-performance.

  • Collaborer avec le Marketing (campagnes, contenus, événements), les Partenariats (canaux locaux, KOLs) et le Produit (remontée des insights terrain).

  • Garantir la discipline process et outils : CRM irréprochable, séquences rigoureuses, reporting fiable. Les faits avant les impressions.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience confirmée en management commercial outbound SMB dans le SaaS B2B, avec une équipe d'AE full-cycle atteignant régulièrement ses objectifs.

  • Expertise terrain : vous savez vous-même lancer des séquences, faire du cold call et enseigner une prospection qui convertit.

  • Mindset de coach : vous identifiez rapidement les écarts de performance et coachez de façon structurée (écoute d'appels, scorecards), pas avec des discours de motivation génériques.

  • Profil data-driven : à l'aise avec la funnel math (activité → meetings → démos → essais → closing), le forecast et la couverture de pipeline.

  • Maîtrise des outils : CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), outils de séquençage et d'automatisation, Sales Navigator, et une vraie exigence sur la qualité des données.

  • Français natif, anglais courant (clientèle francophone, équipes internes internationales).

  • Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération totale cible (OTE): 110 000 – 130 000 € brut annuel

  • Equity

  • Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être)

  • Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris

  • Team retreats et off-sites

Processus de recrutement

title: Affiliate Marketing Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace under a newly-appointed CMO. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Finding and signing new affiliate and influencer partners is the core of our growth engine going forward, and we’re building the team to power it. We’re looking for an Affiliate & Influencer Acquisition Executive whose core mission is sourcing brand-new partners — not just managing the ones we already have. Reporting to a Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll own the full new-partner funnel end-to-end: mapping affiliates and influencers we don’t work with yet, running outbound outreach, and negotiating CPA or fixed-fee deals structured so every partnership delivers measurable, incremental customer acquisition.

This is an acquisition-first partnership seat: you’ll spend as much time prospecting and pitching new affiliates and influencers as you do modelling payback economics. If you think in CPA, fixed-fee and incremental CAC as naturally as you think in relationships, this role is built for you.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

• Proven track record sourcing and closing brand-new affiliate or influencer partnerships from scratch this is a new-business role, not just account management

• 2-3+ years in affiliate marketing, acquisition or performance marketing roles for a consumer brand

• Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics – CPA, fixed-fee, LTV, ROI and blended CAC and confident structuring CPA or fixed-fee deals that guarantee incremental acquisition

• Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

• Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

• Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

• Strong account / relationship management skills

• Comfortable with the data — channel economics, attribution and ROI

• Highly organised and detail-oriented — you can run multiple activations in parallel

• Strong commercial communicator — you can hold your own with senior partners

• Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

• Experience in fintech or financial services

• Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

• Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize, Income access) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

• Experience building an affiliate or influencer programme from 0 to 1 in a consumer brand

You’re a good fit if you’re:

• An experienced affiliate marketer who has sourced new customer-acquisition channels, not just managed existing ones

• A natural relationship-builder — partners trust you, and so does your team

• Commercially literate first, relationship-led second – you measure success in growth, not vanity

• Data-fluent – you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

• Hands-on and resourceful — you make things happen

• Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

New Partner Acquisition:

• Proactively map the affiliate and influencer landscape to identify new partners who can drive incremental customer acquisition

• Run outbound outreach and pitch new affiliates and influencers, building and working a pipeline of prospective partners

• Negotiate and close new commercial deals primarily CPA or fixed-fee structured so every new partner is measurably incremental

• Own onboarding and activation of every new partner, from signed deal through to first live campaign

Commercial & Performance:

• Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners —

prioritising CPA and fixed-fee structures that tie partner pay to genuine incremental customer acquisition — and know which model fits each partner

• Own the unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

• Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

• Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

• Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end — brief, plan, ship, measure

• Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

• Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Affiliate Management:

• Own the affiliate relationship from first contact — be the trusted operator they call first, from outreach and onboarding through to ongoing management

• Manage budgets and timelines across activations

• Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

• Track partnership performance against targets — CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

• Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

• Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

• Partner with creative on activation assets

• Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

• Report on partnership performance to the Head of Growth Partnerships, with the numbers to back every recommendation

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Agent Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Competencies

You're part product manager, part builder, part engagement lead. You take a messy customer process and re-design for Pi to handle autonomously. You're technical enough to own the configuration yourself: you understand APIs, data flows, retrieval and authentication, and you use AI coding tools to extend what Pi does, with the judgement to know when a change makes sense and the discipline to test it before it ships. You're as comfortable running a requirements workshop with a commercial leadership team as you are debugging why Pi made a decision, and you care deeply about the outcome Pi delivers.

More specifically, the people who do this well bring:

  • You turn customer requirements into precise Pi configuration: instructions, data, guardrails and escalation paths

  • You configure and fix things yourself, using AI tools to handle technical changes without waiting on engineering

  • You test like it matters: you design the scenarios and simulations that define what good looks like, and you don't launch until Pi meets them

  • You run engagements with energy and structure, keeping customers, timelines and stakeholders moving toward go-live

  • You own the number: adoption, time saved, revenue retained, whatever the customer deployed Pi to deliver

  • You are Product's voice from the field, turning what you see across customers into clear, prioritised feedback that makes Pi better

You likely have at least 3 to 4 years of experience, and you're technically competent enough to configure, test and debug an AI agent yourself. That might come from:

  • A recent role as a forward-deployed product manager or forward-deployed engineer

  • Product management on a technical product

  • Founding a company, or building hands-on with AI in a way you can show us

More than your title, we care about curiosity, rigour and a bias to action.

Trajectory

Pi is Planhat's customer agent: a single agent that can be configured to take on processes across the commercial lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption to renewal and expansion.

Agent Product Managers are the people who make Pi real for each customer. You join once the customer has signed, work directly with them to shape how Pi is configured for their processes, and extend it to new processes and teams. You run a small portfolio of customers, own a specialty commercial area and help shape how the team works.

Everything you learn feeds straight back to Product, so Pi gets better for every customer, and you work closely with Sales, CS, Product and Engineering so no context or momentum is lost.

Imagine:

  • Taking Pi live on a customer's renewals process in weeks, from the first requirements session through testing to launch

  • Setting Pi up to run account management for a customer's long-tail accounts: monitoring health, preparing renewals and handling the outreach no human team has time for

  • Reviewing a week of Pi's work for a customer, spotting where it falls short, and shipping the fix the same afternoon

  • Extending Pi from one process to the next for the same customer, until it runs across their commercial lifecycle

  • Turning a pattern you've seen across five customers into a capability Product builds into Pi for everyone

In this role you will:

  • Run Pi deployments for a portfolio of customers, from kickoff to live and beyond

  • Agree success metrics with each customer and report on the impact

  • Help customer leaders decide where Pi goes next

  • Train the teams who work alongside Pi so they use it and trust it

  • Build the playbooks and templates that make each deployment faster

Definition of Success

  • Success in this role is measured by what Pi delivers for your customers, and how much better it gets because of you.

    • Your customers hit the targets they deployed Pi for

    • Their leaders come back to you for what's next, and Pi expands into new processes and teams

    • Product ships improvements to Pi that started with you

Compensation

The OTE salary range for this position is $130,000 - $150,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Netherlands.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

title: AI Solutions Engineer - R&D
descriptionHtml:
AI Solutions Engineer - R&D

➡️ Do you understand how R&D and engineering teams work, from technical research and technology evaluation through to product development and innovation?

➡️ Have you gone beyond using AI to actually building solutions, integrating APIs, developing agents or automating complex workflows?

➡️ Can you combine hands-on technical capability with the confidence to engage enterprise customers, understand their challenges and design solutions that deliver real value?

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

We have an exciting new role as an AI Solutions Engineer to support our R&D customers.

You’ll work alongside Account Executives and Account Managers throughout the sales process, speaking directly with prospective customers to understand their R&D and data workflows, uncover what they’re trying to achieve, and design AI-powered solutions around those needs. This isn’t a role where you simply demo an existing product. You’ll be expected to build and tailor the solution for the customer — using Patsnap’s data, APIs, MCP capabilities and AI tools to create agents, workflows, prototypes and proof-of-concepts that bring their use case to life.

The brief is simple:

Understand the customer. Build the solution. Prove the value.

We’re looking for people who can bring together:

Domain knowledge + customer-facing experience + real AI build capability

A typical day could involve joining several customer calls, running technical discovery, building a prototype between meetings, demonstrating it live to a prospect, refining it based on feedback and, where needed, supporting deployment after signature.

We're looking for someone who brings together three core strengths:

  • R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding: You understand how R&D, engineering and innovation teams operate, the challenges they face and where AI can deliver value.

  • Customer-Facing & Commercial Capability: You're confident engaging enterprise customers, leading technical discovery and translating requirements into compelling solutions.

  • Hands-On AI Development: You can independently build AI agents, integrations, automated workflows and technical prototypes, rather than simply demonstrating existing software.

You'll use Patsnap's proprietary R&D and innovation intelligence, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities and AI technologies to design, build and demonstrate solutions tailored to customer needs.

That could involve developing an AI agent to accelerate technical research, integrating Patsnap's intelligence into existing enterprise systems, automating technology scouting processes or creating intelligent workflows to support engineering and product development decisions.

You'll take customer challenges from initial discovery through to working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful improvements to their R&D processes.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You won’t be expected to build production software from scratch, but you will need to be technically confident, comfortable building independently and credible in front of enterprise customers.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position in our London, UK office, working 1–2 days in the office and the rest from home.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research and Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Build with AI every day. Design and develop AI agents, technical workflows, integrations and prototypes that address real customer challenges.

  • Work at the forefront of R&D innovation. Help leading organisations transform how they approach research, technology discovery, engineering and product development.

  • Go beyond traditional pre-sales. You'll have the freedom to design and build tailored solutions rather than simply demonstrate existing software.

  • Make a tangible commercial impact. See your technical work directly influence customer decisions, accelerate opportunities and support enterprise adoption.

  • Help shape our AI capabilities. Work closely with Product and Engineering, bringing real customer requirements into the development of scalable solutions.

  • Join at an exciting stage of growth. Be part of Patsnap's continued investment in agentic AI, enterprise integrations and the evolution of our Solution Consulting function.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to support complex enterprise opportunities across R&D, engineering, product development and innovation.

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers, understanding their existing research processes, engineering workflows, systems, data requirements and business challenges.

  • Design, build and demonstrate AI agents, intelligent workflows, integrations and proof-of-concepts using Patsnap's APIs, MCP capabilities, LLMs and other relevant technologies.

  • Translate real-world R&D use cases, such as technology scouting, technical literature analysis, engineering research, competitive intelligence and product innovation, into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • Integrate Patsnap's proprietary intelligence into customer workflows, internal systems and AI applications.

  • Deliver tailored technical demonstrations that clearly communicate how proposed solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.

  • Own proof-of-concept development from initial requirements and solution design through to testing, iteration and customer presentation.

  • Support technical implementation and deployment following signature, collaborating with Product, Engineering and Customer Success where required.

  • Identify opportunities to develop reusable workflows, templates and solution frameworks that can be applied across customers.

  • Share customer insights and technical feedback to help shape Patsnap's future AI capabilities.

  • You won't carry an individual sales quota, but your contribution will be measured through the commercial opportunities you help progress and close.


What We'd Love From You:

There are three equally important parts to this role:

1) R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding

  • Strong understanding of R&D and engineering workflows, including how organisations approach technical research, technology scouting, product development, innovation and technical decision-making.

  • Experience working within or supporting engineering, industrial R&D, manufacturing, technology development or other research-intensive environments.

  • Ability to understand the challenges faced by R&D and engineering teams, including fragmented data, complex research processes, information discovery and opportunities for workflow automation.

  • Confidence engaging with technical stakeholders, understanding their requirements and translating these into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • A background in engineering, technical consulting, industrial technology, scientific software or a related discipline would be advantageous.

2) Customer-Facing Experience

  • Experience working directly with customers or prospects in areas such as pre-sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, consulting or technical delivery.

  • Confidence leading discovery and requirements conversations.

  • Able to explain complex scientific and technical concepts clearly.

  • Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions live.

  • Good commercial judgement: you know when to go deeper technically and when to focus on business value.

3) Hands-On AI Experience

You must already have experience building with AI, not simply using LLMs for everyday productivity.

We care less about whether something reached production and more about whether you have personally built, tested and iterated something that solved a real problem.

That might include:

  • AI agents or agentic workflows

  • LLM-powered applications

  • APIs and integrations

  • MCP

  • RAG or data-driven AI applications

  • Workflow automation

  • Prompt-based systems

  • Rapid prototypes or proof-of-concepts

Comfort with APIs, no-code/low-code tools, data and light scripting such as Python is a strong plus.

Backgrounds That Could Fit

You might currently work as a:

  • Solutions Engineer / Solution Consultant

  • Technical Pre-Sales Consultant

  • Product Manager / Product Owner

  • Technical or Implementation Consultant

  • Business or Product Analyst

  • Scientific Software Consultant

  • Life Sciences Technology Consultant

We’re typically looking for around 3–4 years of relevant professional experience, although the quality and relevance of your experience matters more than an exact number.

Benefits & Perks:

A culture we’re genuinely proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares knowledge, raises standards and celebrates wins properly together. You’ll have plenty of ownership, work with smart people across the business and be encouraged to keep learning and experimenting. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

title: Android Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The team We’re on a mission to take our mobile app to the next level, and we’re looking for someone to help shape the future of our Android experience in Kotlin. Joining the Mobile Platform team, you’ll work on the technical foundations that power the app — from architecture and shared libraries to core experiences, build systems, and analytics infrastructure. You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

The team is accountable for keeping these foundations reliable, scalable and easy for our product squads to build on. You’ll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, improve the developer experience, and reduce the underlying technical complexity that product engineers need to manage.

The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Product teams remain responsible for their customer experiences and the services they own, including responding to incidents within those product-owned areas. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively. While the app today is built with React Native, we are expanding our native capabilities in Swift and Kotlin and are transforming the Android experience with a move toward a more fully native approach. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of that journey!
A day in the life:
  • Reporting to an Engineering Manager within one of our teams. Your final team placement will be agreed during the final stages of the interview process.
  • Collaborate closely with other native mobile engineers to design, build, and evolve the Android platform.
  • Play a key role in migrating the app from React Native to native Android, building in Kotlin with strong architectural foundations and industry best practices.
  • Partner with the wider mobile engineering community, including React Native developers, to define best practices for native development and support engineers cross-training into native Android.
  • Improve the performance, robustness, and overall quality of the app by identifying bottlenecks, addressing technical debt, and resolving defects to optimise the user experience.
  • Work cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to design and deliver features that fully leverage native Android capabilities.

    • About you:
  • Experienced in building and shipping production Android applications in Kotlin, including publishing apps to the Google Play Store.
  • Strong understanding of Android frameworks, platform APIs, and native app development best practices.
  • Background working on modern, high-engagement mobile applications with a focus on performance, reliability, and delivering exceptional user experiences.
  • Passionate about quality, with a track record of raising engineering standards through thoughtful design, testing, and maintainable code.
  • Motivated by opportunities to create broad impact through better processes, tooling, and automation that raise the bar for mobile engineering across teams.
  • Customer-focused, with a genuine interest in Zopa’s mission.

    • Added bonus:
  • Experience applying mobile security best practices in production Android applications.
  • Working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps, including build, test, and release automation.
  • Experience collaborating closely with iOS (Swift) and/or React Native engineers in a cross-platform mobile environment.
    • #LI-IB1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.
