title: Company Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Complaints Officer (FOS)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As we grow, we’re looking to expand our Complaints handling team. As an excellent communicator, you will quickly build relationships with customers and other departments across Lendable to understand customer friction points and come to fair and objective decisions.

If you have experience of either handling complex complaints (preferably motor or secured product related) or have worked in the automotive finance sector and have the following skills we’d love to hear from you:

  • Problem solving and decision making skills - putting the customer at the heart of everything you do

  • The ability to assess and critique evidence coming to a fair and comprehensive decision

  • Be able to shift focus and re-prioritise workloads based on business and customer needs

  • Great phone and written communication skills, being clear and concise to promote customer understanding.

  • The ability to build rapport and manage multiple third parties including ensuring that customer expectations are managed.

Also, even better if you have:

  • Experience of working in a regulated motor finance environment

  • An understanding of the Consumer Rights Act 2015

  • An understanding of Motor related policies and industry standards

  • The ability to comprehend complex Satisfactory Quality-related complaints

  • Strong experience working with the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Your team’s objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. Lendable is committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that it reaches the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we can evolve as a business to ensure that we are meeting our customers' expectations and continuously improving our service and the team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insights to the business in order to improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers, and therefore to the benefit of us as a business, has never been more important than now; as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

How you’ll impact those objectives

The ideal candidate will have experience of resolving complaints or customer disputes within a regulated environment and have an aptitude for investigating, analysing, problem-solving and dispute resolution.

  • You will be able to self manage a varied and complex caseload, identifying best contact mechanisms for customers and prioritising cases where appropriate to be highly productive and efficient, and to maintain the required level of performance against our KPI minimum standards.

  • You will champion using our AI tools and technology to bring a first class service to our customers.

  • You will work well under pressure and be adaptable, being able to turn your hand to other areas of operational need, as the business may require.

  • You will ensure that you follow our complaint handling standards, have good record keeping skills and ensure that all decisions made are backed up with demonstrable evidence and rationale.

  • You will work closely with the Complaints Team, to resolve complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, as well as be responsible for feeding back to both frontline and product teams on product and process improvements across the Operations Team and wider Lendable business.

  • You will be responsible for communicating with the complainant, either in writing or by phone and will enjoy finding solutions to issues raised, managing customer expectations and handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism.

  • You will have a good knowledge and understanding of FCA regulation as well as DISP complaint handling rules and guidance.

  • You will also ensure that you maintain up to date knowledge of Lendable’s products through effective use and review of policies, procedures and business tools made available to you.

  • You will have strong letter writing skills, being able to create professional final response letters which break down complex issues into comprehensible information for consumers to understand.

  • You will also have a sound moral compass, speaking up where necessary to ensure that good customer outcomes are always at the heart of what we do, striving to resolve complaints without the need for the customer to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service, and ensuring you are applying any learnings from both internal and FOS complaints to future complaint cases.

The Interview Process

  • A quick phone call with one of the team

  • An exercise to demonstrate your ability to resolve complaints

  • An assessment to evidence your knowledge of FCA regulations and DISP complaint handling rules/guidance.

  • Onsite Interview

  • Discuss the exercises you have completed

  • Meet the team you’ll work with daily

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

title: Consultant·e Senior Transformation Product & Conduite du changement (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Une réorganisation qui tient sur le papier, tout le monde sait faire.
Celle qui tient encore un an après, c'est une autre histoire.

Chez Saint-Gobain, nous avons créé un Product Ops Center pour diffuser la culture produit à l'échelle du groupe. Chez SNCF, Decathlon ou France TV, nous aidons les Directions à quitter la logique projet pour une logique produit.

Ce changement ne se décrète pas en COMEX. Il se construit avec les managers, les équipes et les dirigeants, jusqu'à ce qu'il devienne la nouvelle normalité.

Ton rôle : porter ces transformations, de la première conversation avec un COMEX jusqu'au moment où l'organisation fonctionne sans toi.

Ce que tu vas faire

  • Embarquer les équipes. Tu acculturés, tu accompagnes les managers, tu traites les résistances une par une plutôt que de les contourner.

  • Dessiner l'organisation. Gouvernance, rôles, rituels : des modèles pensés pour durer, pas pour une restitution.

  • Changer la façon de décider. Tu installes un pilotage par la valeur : OKR, KPI stratégiques, nouveaux circuits de décision.

  • Faire grandir les collectifs. Ateliers, formations, coaching des équipes produit et de leurs leaders.

  • Parler à tous les étages. Tu tiens la même crédibilité face à un COMEX que face à une équipe opérationnelle.

Notre objectif pour toi : que ton expertise de conseil se mesure à ce qui change réellement chez le client. Ensuite, tu choisis ta voie : Manager, pour faire grandir une équipe, ou Principal, pour devenir la référence sur ton sujet.

Pourquoi Hubvisory

  • Le produit est notre seul sujet. Pour un profil Change, c'est rare : tu transformes des organisations autour du produit, entouré de PM, designers et AI Engineers que tu peux solliciter à tout moment.

  • Tu sais ce que tu gagnes, et pourquoi. De 58 à 68 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable, et un intéressement jusqu'à 22 % des profits partagé à parts égales.

  • Ton impact se voit vite sur ta fiche de paie. Revalorisations deux fois par an, et la majorité des postes à responsabilité occupés par des collaborateurs évolués en interne.

  • Tu démarres entouré. Deux semaines de Campus pour prendre nos méthodes en main, un buddy, un mentor, et 1000 h de formation à piocher selon tes besoins.

  • Tu connais les gens avec qui tu travailles. 135+ consultants : l'exigence d'un cabinet, sans l'anonymat.


Le profil recherché

Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en cabinet de conseil (transformation, organisation, stratégie ou digital), avec des missions menées de bout en bout.

title: Cryogenics Engineer – Test Facility & Auxiliary Cryoplants
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

You will deliver the helium refrigerator and cryogenic distribution for Proxima's Alpha coil test facility, taking these systems from requirements and process design through procurement, installation and commissioning. You will also support the engineering of the refrigerator for the cryopumps of the neutral beam injectors and divertor, and act as the process and safety owner for these systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the cryogenic supply infrastructure for the Alpha coil test facility, covering the main refrigerator, liquid nitrogen equipment, cryogenic distribution and interconnecting valve box, from concept to commissioning and test operation

  • Define requirements, process flow diagrams and P&IDs for cryogenic refrigerators and ancillary systems such as helium storage tanks, LHe dewars, purification and gas recovery

  • Size lines, valves and pressure relief devices based on your relief case definitions, in line with PED and relevant EN/ISO standards

  • Write specifications and RFQ packages, evaluate offers, and act as expert customer for suppliers through design reviews, FAT, installation and site acceptance

  • Plan and lead installation and commissioning, write operating procedures, and support operation on site close to Munich

WHO YOU ARE

  • A team player who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes

  • A proven track record of designing, building and commissioning cryogenic or similar gas systems in industrial plants, test facilities, accelerators, or space infrastructure

  • Hands-on experience developing P&IDs, sizing pressure relief devices to recognised standards (e.g. ISO 21013, ISO 4126), and using process or system simulation tools such as EcosimPro or Aspen HYSYS for helium refrigeration plants or similar

  • Experience with pressure equipment design to EN 13445 or AD 2000, and with CAD

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential

  • Demonstrated ability to manage the delivery of complex systems with external suppliers to schedule and budget

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

This role sits at L2/L3/L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don't look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) bist du die persönliche Ansprechperson für unsere Abschlussjahrgänge, von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, das Onboarding läuft über Videos und Formulare. Du kümmerst dich um das, was Automatisierung nicht kann: echte Beziehungen zu den Jahrgängen aufbauen und dafür sorgen, dass jedes Projekt sicher ins Ziel kommt. Das heißt kurze Wege, direkte Wirkung und viel Verantwortung. Es heißt aber auch, dass du eigenständig arbeiten und priorisieren musst.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung: Du betreust unsere Jahrgänge per Videocall, Chat und Telefon und bist für alles da, was über Chatbot und Helpcenter hinausgeht.

  • Projektbegleitung: Du begleitest jeden Jahrgang von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung, behältst Fristen und Freigaben im Blick und fasst nach, wenn ein Projekt hängt. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, das Produktion und Lieferung steuert.

  • Pipeline: Du hast deine Kunden eigenständig im Griff: Status, nächste Schritte, Risiken. Wo es eng wird, merkst du es vor dem Kunden.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Wir bauen buchbare Video-Calls auf, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Begleitung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen. Du gestaltest das Format mit und führst die Calls.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und sorgst dafür, dass Chatbot und Helpcenter sie künftig beantworten.

  • Wachstum: Wenn du Lust hast, wächst du in Upselling und Referral hinein: Textilien für Jahrbuch-Kunden, Jahrbuch für Textil-Kunden, Schulshops und Empfehlungen an andere Jahrgänge und Schulen.

So arbeiten wir

  • Persönlich ist unser Unterschied. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt und stemmen oft ihr erstes großes Projekt. Sie brauchen jemanden, der erreichbar ist, mitdenkt und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Support oder Customer Success gesammelt. Wie lange, interessiert uns weniger als das, was du daraus mitnimmst.

  • Quereinstieg ist willkommen, zum Beispiel aus dem Lehramt, auch ohne abgeschlossenes Referendariat.

  • Du kannst mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache.

  • Telefon und Kamera schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil.

  • Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig, auch wenn viel gleichzeitig läuft. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Tools und digitalen Kanälen.

  • Du erkennst, wenn ein Kunde mehr braucht, und sprichst es an. Vertriebserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: vom Support hin zu echtem Customer Success mit Upselling und Referral

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen.

title: Customer Success Manager, Mid Market
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager at Harvey, you are the custodian of value for a portfolio of law firms and in-house legal teams across DACH — you own their mutual success plan and their renewal. You connect Harvey's technology and expertise to each customer's goals, moving them along the AI maturity curve so adoption keeps deepening, and you are directly accountable for retaining and growing that relationship. You will run your book as a portfolio, deliver a consistently high-quality customer journey at scale, and partner with Account Executives, Legal Engineers and Product to turn adoption into measurable value and expansion.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver the customer journey: run kickoffs, implementation reviews and QBRs tailored to each customer, anchored on a mutual success plan that ties Harvey to their objectives, priorities and measures of success.

  • Drive adoption and value: engage end users, administrators and senior stakeholders — managing partners, general counsel, heads of innovation — to position Harvey as essential to how their legal work gets done, build on proven use cases, and quantify ROI in business terms.

  • Orchestrate cross-functionally: bring in Sales, Legal Engineering, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance at the right moment, and represent customer needs back to Product and Engineering.

  • Expand: identify and progress expansion opportunities within your accounts, partnering with Account Executives where appropriate.

  • Own the renewal end to end: run your book as a portfolio — knowing whether each account is in Defend, Maintain or Grow, with evidence — build renewal plans and timelines, forecast accurately, lead commercial conversations, negotiate terms and close renewals on or ahead of schedule against a gross and net revenue retention target.

What You Have

Ideal candidates for the Mid-Market CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • 3–4+ years in customer-owning roles at tech or SaaS platforms, including direct ownership of renewals, retention or a commercial / account-management target.

  • A track record of owning and delivering against a revenue, retention or net-revenue-retention number.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily and can show how it has changed your own output.

  • Experience running the renewal motion end to end — forecasting, renewal planning and leading commercial negotiations.

  • Account management and portfolio planning across a high-volume book of business, including segmentation and revenue-based prioritisation.

  • Quantifying and communicating ROI and measurable business value to customers, grounded in concrete use cases.

  • Identifying at-risk accounts early and executing structured mitigation plans.

  • Mapping an organisation and influencing stakeholders, including economic buyers and executive sponsors.

  • Curiosity about how law firms and legal teams work.

  • Working cross-functionally with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal / Finance and Product teams.

  • Adapting seamlessly in the face of high-speed change and growth, with a strong point of view and proactive self-management.

  • Fluent in German and English; based in or able to travel regularly within Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
FanDuel Group is a world-class team of brands and products that deliver sports betting, gaming and entertainment to millions of US sports fans every day. That’s no easy task and wouldn't be possible without a fantastic team who have helped us pioneer new products and innovative features that make us a leader in the industry.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We are seeking a Data Engineer to help lead the technical design and implementation of our most critical data infrastructure and products. You’ll be responsible for designing scalable systems, setting data architecture standards, and solving complex technical challenges that power analytics, data science, and business function use cases across the company.

You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to architect data solutions that are performant, reliable, and built with a long-term, customer-centric mindset.

If you’re excited by this challenge and want to work within a dynamic company, then we’d love to hear from you.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Implement High-Impact Data Systems

  • Implement and help design scalable, maintainable, and secure real-time and streaming data infrastructure and architectures that support enterprise-wide data needs
  • Define standards for real-time system design and real-time tooling using modern tools and cloud-native technologies, and driving technical roadmaps for multi-phase and cross-team initiatives
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business and analytical requirements into end-to-end data solutions

Drive Engineering Best Practices

  • Embody engineering best practices around code quality, testing, documentation, and deployment
  • Contribute to the evolution of the data platform, ensuring systems are modular, interoperable, and resilient
  • Contribute to technical design and code reviews, mentoring peers and raising the bar for engineering excellence

Contribute to Strategic Initiatives

  • Partner with data platform, data engineering, analytics, data science, and product engineering teams to deliver reusable data assets and shared infrastructure
  • Identify and resolve structural and performance bottlenecks in the current data platform and propose improvements that reduce complexity and boost performance
  • Help define and deliver on metrics and initiatives that improve system reliability, scalability, data quality, lineage, and observability

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field, with a focus on building scalable data systems and platforms.
  • Expertise in modern streaming data tools and frameworks such as Kafka, Spark, Databricks, and cloud-native services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Deep understanding of streaming architectures, distributed systems, ETL/ELT pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and build processes.
  • Proficiency at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Scala) and scripting
  • Demonstrated experience working on complex technical systems end-to-end, from design through production
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on complex and large-scale data platforms that support analytics, machine learning, and operational workloads
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks
  • Background in customer-centric or product-driven environments (e.g., digital, eCommerce, SaaS)
  • Experience with data modelling and data processing tooling and best practices

We treat our team right

  • Great financial package - Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy, along with a number of other benefits.

title: Data Science Lead
descriptionHtml:
Data Science Lead

The adjoe Ads Data Science team owns the entire bidding algorithm that decides which ad you are most likely to enjoy from start to finish: conversion prediction, user quality estimation, and bid shading. Every bid adjoe placed in an ad auction is the output of ML models making 50 billion predictions daily, trained on data from our mobile SDKs that capture real user behavior at scale.

The team moves fast: new ideas tested offline, A/B tests launched in production within minutes. We rely on industry-proven state of the art technology, adapted to our needs and self-hosted where it matters: PyTorch and TensorFlow for modeling, Trino and Athena for querying a 350TB Iceberg data lake, Airflow and Ray for orchestrating our different training pipelines across multiple GPU clusters. Models are built on 600+ features and trained on 200 million data points, with the full ML lifecycle owned by the team from research and experimentation to deployment and real-time inference at sub-200ms latency.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Hands-on People Leadership: You are a good listener and navigator, you inspire and empower your colleagues to florish. You will directly manage a team of Data Scientists and Data Analysts, owning 1-on-1s, performance reviews, and career growth. You are able to spot great modeling work, catch blockers like GPU limits or data quality issues, and brainstorm directly with the team rather than passing questions along.

  • Pragmatic Execution & Adaptive Process: You will build lightweight workflows for A/B testing, code reviews, incident management, and AI agent usage, introducing stricter structures only as our products mature. With a "hacker mindset," you prioritize shipping over bureaucracy, know when to balance experimentation with focus, and embed code hygiene into daily routines instead of one-off cleanup days.

  • Technical Fluency & Root-Cause Instinct: While not coding daily, you read Python, write SQL, use Git, and understand how technical systems work and what they cost under the hood. You use your analytical background to spot early warning signs in data, code, or team dynamics and trace them to their root cause.

  • Roadmap Co-Ownership & Business Alignment: You will partner with Staff Data Scientists to shape the roadmap while bridging business stakeholders and tech teams. You prioritize ideas by business impact, translate requirements into technical realities for the team, and align competing perspectives when multiple valid opinions exist.

  • Problem-First Ownership & Pace: You drive projects forward, refusing to accept "it doesn't work" as an answer and finding ways to make solutions viable. You push back when execution slows down, start with the problem before the solution, and know when to move fast versus when to double-check everything.

  • Plus: A formal background in mathematics and prior hands-on experience as a Data Science IC.

    What’s in It for You?

    At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

    • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

    • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

    • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

    • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

    • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

title: Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist; it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

About the Role

Our team is growing, and we are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will own the full arc of our most strategic services engagements, from the first conversation about what AI could do for a customer's business, through the delivery that builds it, to the value they realise from it. You will scope and price the services that move an enterprise from AI ambition to AI running in production, support the sale of that work alongside the Account Owner, and orchestrate the consultants and engineers who deliver it. You will stay with the engagement well past the build, accountable for turning what the customer bought into AI that is genuinely doing their work.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our London office.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery with executives and process owners, then build the deployment strategy with them: which departments, workflows, and use cases move to intelligent, agent-driven execution on the monday AI work platform.

  • Translate that strategy into a scoped and priced services engagement, owning packaging, effort and unit estimation, and the proposals and statements of work that carry it.

  • Support the sale of services alongside the Account Owner, articulating the path from a customer's current state to AI in production for stakeholders from technical staff to executive sponsors.

  • Define the work clearly enough for someone else to build it, capturing the outcome, the estimate, and the shape of the solution, then bring in the forward deployed consultants and engineers who execute it.

  • Own timeline, budget, quality, risk, and commercial administration across your engagements, running one-time projects directly, overseeing execution on ongoing ones, and directing the resources assigned to you.

  • Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence.

  • Own AI value realisation inside your engagements, tracking consumption against the plan agreed at sale and diagnosing where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back.

  • Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified.

  • Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner.

  • Feed the practice from the field, contributing the patterns, estimation inputs, and playbooks that make each AI deployment faster than the last.

Requirements

title: Direct Mail Growth Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

  • Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

  • Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

  • Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

  • Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

  • Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

  • Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management

  • Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

  • Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team

title: Director - Business Development
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.  

DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS

Based in Munich, Germany, as the Director - Business Development, you will drive Rocket Lab's growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Lead business development initiatives focused on satellite solutions for defense, national security, civil space, and commercial applications across Germany and Europe
  • Develop and execute capture strategies for securing large defense, civil space, and government contracts, including opportunities with German and European government agencies, defense organizations, space institutions, and prime contractors
  • Engage with key customer stakeholders, government officials, policymakers, and industry leaders to build and maintain long-term relationships, ensuring Rocket Lab's solutions align with their evolving mission requirements and strategic priorities
  • Develop and maintain relationships across the German and European space and defense ecosystem, including government organizations, prime contractors, industry partners, and relevant European institutions
  • Collaborate closely with Government Affairs and cross-functional teams to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government-funded programs
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and deliver compelling proposals that meet customer requirements and win new business
  • Monitor German and European industry trends, government priorities, procurement initiatives, policy developments, and competitor activities to inform and adapt our business development strategies
  • Grow existing business opportunities and nurture relationships with existing customers to develop additional business opportunities
  • Create new business opportunities and relationships by presenting Rocket Lab's capabilities/experience to provide satellite solutions – including bus offerings and complete satellites to meet mission requirements
  • Identify and pursue opportunities associated with European sovereign space and defense capabilities, dual-use technologies, and evolving European procurement priorities
  • Lead and/or participate in proposal activities, including generation of technical, management, cost, schedule, and proposal content for new business
  • Develop strong relationships across all levels of the business to ensure alignment, efficiency, and collaboration, including coordinating with stakeholders across Business Development, Government Affairs, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations
  • Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences, government forums, industry associations, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe
  • Build awareness of relevant European government programs and procurement pathways, including opportunities involving ESA, the European Union, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, DLR, and German defense and space organizations
  • Support Rocket Lab's positioning within the evolving European space and defense landscape, including launch sovereignty, European sovereign capability, dual-use technology, and defense modernization priorities
  • Develop an understanding of relevant export control and regulatory considerations affecting Rocket Lab's ability to pursue European opportunities, including ITAR/EAR and applicable German and European requirements
  • Travel as needed for business opportunities, customer meetings, industry events, and capture activities
  • Other duties as assigned or required

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other technical discipline
  • 12+ years of experience in business development, program management, or systems engineering within the aerospace, space, defense, or related technology sector
  • In-depth knowledge of government acquisition processes, government contracting, and the national security landscape within Germany and/or Europe
  • Proven track record of securing large (>$20M) contracts and managing strategic relationships within the aerospace, space, or defense industry
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with senior government officials, defense organizations, policymakers, prime contractors, and other public- and private-sector stakeholders
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Strong understanding of German and European defense priorities, civil space programs, government procurement processes, and the broader European space and defense ecosystem
  • Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required German or European security clearance, if applicable to assigned programs

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master's degree in aerospace engineering or related engineering field; or business
  • Specialization in German or European government business development, with deep experience selling to German or European national security, defense, civil space, or government customers
  • Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms
  • Extensive awareness of current and ongoing German and European government national security, defense, civil space, and satellite programs
  • Experience working with or within organizations such as DLR, Bundeswehr, BAAINBw, German federal government entities, ESA, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, EU defense bodies, NATO, or other European space and defense institutions
  • Experience pursuing European government-funded programs and navigating German or EU defense and space procurement pathways
  • Familiarity with European sovereign space and defense initiatives, including the European Defense Fund (EDF), European Defense Industry Program (EDIP), EU Space Program initiatives, and related European defense modernization priorities
  • Familiarity with NATO space and defense structures and European security and resilience priorities
  • Understanding of export control regimes and regulatory considerations relevant to European business development, including ITAR/EAR and German/EU requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in both German and English
  • Experience leading, managing, and growing geographically dispersed teams on fast-paced projects
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Suite products, including MS Project
  • General knowledge of industry specific technical requirements and quality requirements
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software
  • Experience with proposal development, writing, and best practice capture processes, and ability to independently complete cost and technical proposals
  • Experience working with subject matter experts to collect and create compelling proposal content and detailed responses

WHAT TO EXPECT

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

As a Director of Strategic Projects, you will support the VP of STARK and own the end-to-end delivery of strategic engagements across Ukraine and partner nations. title: Director of Support Engineering
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for a Director of Support Engineering to establish and lead our enterprise support function while supporting large global enterprise customers using Unframe's AI-powered solutions.

In this founding role, you will be the bridge between our Fortune 500 customers, Product, and Engineering. You will own the technical post-deployment customer experience, dive deep into system architectures, and build the playbooks, processes, and standards that define customer support at Unframe as we scale.

This role is ideal for an experienced technical leader who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys deep-dive troubleshooting, and wants to shape both our support operations and our AI-first workflows from the ground up.

What you'll do

  • Define and build Unframe’s support architecture, SLA frameworks, incident escalation paths, and diagnostic runbooks for our global enterprise coverage.

  • Bring technical authority and a consultative presence to live video calls with enterprise bank executives, sponsors, and engineering leads. Uncover workflow pain points, translate requirements, and manage high-stakes account de-escalations with professional poise.

  • Independently investigate, reproduce, and resolve complex production incidents across web applications, REST APIs, webhooks, microservices, and databases. Query SQL databases, parse CloudWatch/Datadog/Splunk logs, trace JSON payloads, and inspect source code in GitHub to isolate root causes before involving core engineering.

  • Act as an "AI Support Orchestrator," configuring, testing, and deploying autonomous AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, LLM APIs) to analyze logs, automate triage workflows, and build self-service knowledge bases.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to turn recurring customer friction and edge cases into actionable product specs, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Technical Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, QA, or SRE within complex enterprise or B2B SaaS environments.

  • Diagnostic Tech Stack:

    • Hands-on proficiency writing complex SQL queries to inspect relational and cloud databases.

    • Practical experience conducting deep log analysis in CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or Loki.

  • Daily practitioner of generative AI and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot) for log parsing, code navigation, and workflow automation.

  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with proven experience advising enterprise executives on live technical calls.

Why join us?

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving real technical problems while working closely with customers, product, and engineering teams. You’ll be exposed to complex enterprise environments, cutting-edge AI products, and fast product cycles with real ownership and direct impact from day one. It’s an opportunity to grow quickly, learn how large-scale AI systems are deployed in the real world, and help shape the experience of some of the world’s biggest companies using Unframe.

title: Director Space Business
descriptionHtml:
Destinus is seeking a Director, Space Business to establish and grow its space business, with military satellite communications (Satcom) as the initial priority. The role covers the complete communications system, including the space segment, user terminals, ground infrastructure and integration with tactical networks.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will lead business development and programme delivery, supported by programme managers and a Technical Lead with communications systems expertise. The Director must have enough technical depth to challenge proposals and lead informed decisions.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop the business. Define the Satcom business plan, customer priorities, investment needs and Destinus' role in the industrial partnership. Align proposals with technical feasibility, funding and delivery capacity.
  • Secure customers and programmes. Build relationships with defence customers, space agencies and industrial partners. Lead proposals, commercial negotiations and funding opportunities in coordination with the group commercial team.
  • Deliver agreed programmes. Own programme budgets, milestones and customer commitments. Lead programme managers and coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and entry into service.
  • Build the required team. Recruit business and programme staff within approved plans. Define engineering capability needs with the CTO and establish clear responsibilities for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage industrial partnerships. Select and manage partners and suppliers with the relevant functions. Establish workshare, interfaces and delivery commitments across the complete Satcom system.
  • Develop future opportunities. Assess early warning and interceptor opportunities through customer engagement, partnerships and funding proposals. Present staged investment recommendations before committing development resources.
  • Maintain delivery discipline. Track costs, risks and progress. Resolve issues within the agreed mandate and escalate material changes to scope, investment or portfolio priorities.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Substantial experience in space, aerospace or defence, typically 12+ years, including at least five years leading complex programmes, multidisciplinary teams or a business.
  • A proven record of delivering satellite communications programmes or substantial parts of an integrated Satcom system, with direct responsibility for budgets, schedules and customer commitments.
  • Business development experience with government or defence customers, including shaping requirements, preparing proposals and negotiating contracts or programme funding.
  • An engineering degree or equivalent technical background, with a system-level understanding of satellites, communications payloads, user terminals and the ground segment.
  • Understanding of protected waveforms, anti-jam capabilities and secure tactical datalinks sufficient to assess requirements, risks and integration needs with technical specialists.
  • Experience leading programme managers and coordinating engineering teams in a matrix organisation, with clear resource commitments and accountability for delivery.
  • The ability to build teams, manage industrial partners and make commercial decisions that reflect technical maturity, available resources and funding.
  • The ability to work independently, present clear recommendations to the CEO and execute within an agreed mandate. Fluent English and willingness to travel regularly.

German language skills as well as experience with German defense customers and space programmes are advantages. We value programme delivery and commercial judgement, especially in the context of establishing a new business line or taking a programme from concept to funding and delivery. Deep expertise across all space applications is not required.

title: Director / VP of Marketing (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Empower every employee.

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.


Job description

Marketing is already Flip AI's strongest pipeline channel. Now we want inbound to become our fastest-growing source of new business. We're looking for a VP Marketing who brings the pace of e-commerce and high-growth B2C to a B2B funnel.

You own demand generation across the full funnel: getting the right people's attention, growing traffic and visibility, and turning a first impression into a booked demo. You lead our Marketing team of around 10 people across growth marketing and events, product marketing and brand, and content and SEO/GEO.

You report to our SVP Strategy & Growth, who owns strategy, the budget frame and the board narrative. You own the team, the operating rhythm and the numbers. This is a hands-on leadership role, whether you come from e-commerce, high-ticket DTC, SME SaaS or a B2B scale-up.

What you can expect

Attention and traffic

  • Grow traffic and visibility across paid (search, LinkedIn, ABM), SEO and GEO, so Flip AI shows up wherever buyers search, including AI assistants

  • Turn our brand and content into reach that converts, together with our Product Marketing team

  • Run a fast creative and channel testing rhythm, steered on cost per outcome

From visitor to booked demo

  • Own website conversion end to end: landing pages, demo flow, interactive product tours, testing roadmap and tracking

  • Make sure every booked demo is the right one: qualification, routing, speed-to-lead and show rate, together with Sales and RevOps

  • Run one weekly funnel review built on SAO and cost per SAO, not MQLs

Team and operating rhythm

  • Lead our Head of Growth Marketing, Head of Product Marketing and senior content lead, and build out the digital team

  • Make sure brand, social and events feed pipeline: you set how the work is measured, the team brings the craft

  • Run a two-week sprint cadence and a weekly performance rhythm that work without you in every meeting

  • Support the marketing for our US launch and prepare the funnel for product-led elements

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Funnels you have personally made convert: visitor to lead, appointment or purchase, with before-and-after numbers you can defend

  • Acquisition you have scaled: paid and organic, CRO, tracking and attribution, steered on CAC and cost per outcome

  • At least 3 years leading a marketing or growth team with budget ownership, including leads in your team

  • Pace: you test weekly, kill what doesn't work and scale what does

  • English C1 or above

  • Willingness to be in our Stuttgart HQ regularly (10–30%)

Nice-to-haves

  • German (B2 or above) is a big plus, as our team and our priority market are German-speaking

  • E-commerce, high-ticket DTC or SME SaaS background

  • Experience with a sales-assisted motion: qualification, handover and show rates

  • Interactive product demos or a self-serve / product-led funnel

  • AI-native ways of working across content, design and analysis

What we offer you

  • A real mandate: Ownership of brand and growth for an entire company, seven-figure budget responsibility, as part of the leadership team.

  • Work mode: We're remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value in-person collaboration, which for this role means regular presence in our Stuttgart office, always with plenty of notice.

  • AI is how we work: Access to frontier AI tools is standard here, not something you request. We actively encourage heavy use across content, design, analysis and reporting.

  • Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

title: Electrical Engineer (Ground Control System)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview
Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the GCS module, including ruggedised drone controllers and long-range RF systems designed for demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating RF modules, microcontrollers, power management, and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The GCS team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and power, into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required
