title: Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

title: Expression of Interest – Contractor Engagement – Bridge and Structures Inspectors
descriptionHtml:
About BakerHicks

BakerHicks is a leading design, engineering and project delivery consultancy, delivering complex infrastructure, industrial and built environment projects across the UK and Europe.

Our Infrastructure team supports a wide range of clients and frameworks, providing specialist engineering, inspection, surveying and asset management services. As our project portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of trusted contractors to support current and future bridge inspection requirements across the UK.

Our strength lies in our collaborative approach, technical excellence, and ability to mobilise the right expertise at pace to support our clients’ requirements.

Our Bridges Team

At BakerHicks, our Bridges Team delivers expert engineering solutions across the full lifecycle of bridge and structures projects, from inspection and assessment through to design, refurbishment, strengthening, and replacement works. Our engineers work on a diverse portfolio of assets including highway bridges, railway bridges, footbridges, retaining structures, culverts, and other critical infrastructure across the UK.

We combine technical excellence with a practical, collaborative approach, working closely with clients, asset owners, local authorities, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to develop safe, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Our experience spans inspections, structural assessments, repair schemes, asset management programmes, and the delivery of complex infrastructure projects in highly regulated environments.

The Opportunity

We are seeking Expressions of Interest from competent and experienced Bridge and Structural Inspectors to join our growing contractor talent pool.

This is not a live vacancy tied to a specific project. Instead, we are building a network of pre-qualified professionals who can be considered for assignments as needs arise across our infrastructure portfolio.
Applications are welcomed from anywhere in the UK. Site travel will normally be required, there is no requirement to be based near a BakerHicks office.

We are particularly keen to hear from inspectors based in Scotland, while welcoming applications from inspectors based in England.

What We're Looking For

We welcome inspectors with experience in one or more of the following activities and environments:

  • General inspections
  • Principal inspections, including close-up examination and access equipment
  • Safety, special and reactive inspections
  • Inspections for assessment and monitoring
  • Condition surveys (defect investigations and condition scoring)
  • Highway structures on trunk road and local authority networks
  • Railway structures
  • Inspection and access planning, and reporting
  • Team leadership and technical review by appropriately qualified Senior Inspectors

Relevant asset types and construction forms may include:

  • Road and rail bridges, including footbridges
  • Culverts and buried structures
  • Retaining walls
  • Tunnel structures
  • Sign and signal gantries, masts and other ancillary highway structures
  • Structures over or adjacent to watercourses, including scour-related inspections
  • Concrete, steel, masonry, timber, composite and post-tensioned structures

Knowledge & Experience

Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following, appropriate to the assignments sought:

  • Relevant UK bridge or structures inspection experience, with a clear record of inspection roles and asset types
  • Working knowledge of applicable standards and client procedures, including NR/L3/CIV/006 and/or DMRB CS 450 where relevant
  • Ability to identify, photograph and classify defects; record severity and extent; recognise urgent safety issues; and produce accurate reports and recommendations
  • Ability to plan and coordinate inspection works, including access arrangements and traffic or rail control measures.
  • Knowledge of structural materials, deterioration mechanisms, structural behaviour and inspection limitations
  • Experience with National Highways, Transport Scotland, Network Rail, local authorities or comparable asset owners and supply chains
  • Experience producing inspection reports and condition assessments, including reporting using Bridge Condition Indicators
  • IT Literacy – proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Depending on the assignment, the following will be required or advantageous:

  • Current Bridge Inspector Certification Scheme (BICS) certification at Inspector or Senior Inspector level, appropriate to the work. Required where mandated by the client, including relevant Transport Scotland assignments
  • Relevant BEng/MEng in civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent inspection experience
  • Current working-at-height and confined-space competence, where applicable
  • IPAF/MEWP, IRATA rope-access, PASMA mobile access towers, Ladder or other relevant access qualifications, where applicable
  • Current Safe Working Near Water (SWNW) or other equivalent competence, where applicable
  • Current Safe use of Trolley Equipment or Rail Trolley controller, where applicable
  • Valid CSCS or other required site-access certification
  • For rail work, current Personal Track Safety (PTS) and other role-specific competences; SSSTS or SMSTS for supervisory duties
  • Network Rail Competencies STE2 – 7 as defined in NR/SP/CTM/017

Why Register Your Interest?

By joining our contractor talent pool, you will:

  • Be considered for assignments matching your competence, location and availability
  • Build a working relationship with BakerHicks
  • Work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals
  • Support projects across a variety of sectors, clients and UK locations

How to Register Your Interest

Please submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will review applications alongside our Infrastructure discipline leaders, and suitable candidates will be invited to an introductory discussion.

Engagement Details

  • Contract opportunities (Inside IR35 / PAYE engagement)
  • Flexible working depending on project requirements (office/site/hybrid)
  • Locations across the UK

Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels. The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.

Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK) 

About BakerHicks 

We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks. 

BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.  

Benefits 

Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.  

BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.  
BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.

title: Field CTO, Southern Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

  • A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

  • You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

  • You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

  • Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

  • 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

  • Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

Nice to have

  • Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

  • Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

  • Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Fleet Operations Traing Lead, UK
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead, UK, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

 

Working closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other teams across the business, you will identify capability gaps and translate complex operational and technical information into engaging, practical learning experiences. You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

 

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the UK, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion

  • Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams

  • Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge

  • Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments

  • Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively

  • Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance

  • Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes

  • Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively

  • Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification

  • Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities

  • Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities

  • Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Developing and delivering onboarding, technical, safety, and professional-development training

  • Building and maintaining competency frameworks, learning paths, and certification programs

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with operational and technological change

  • Evaluating training effectiveness using participation, performance, and feedback metrics

  • Running train-the-trainer initiatives and supporting local training delivery

  • Continuously iterating on training content, standards, and processes, making improvements based on data and feedback

  • Supporting operational change by creating learning experiences for new tools, vehicles, and systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have a strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation

  • You have demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment

  • You have experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams

  • You have excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible

  • You have experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs

  • You have strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training

  • You possess strong stakeholder-management skills and can collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts

  • You have excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment

  • You are able to work effectively across Europe and travel between operational locations when required

  • You are available to work on-site five days a week

  • You have a clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements

  • You have a safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks

 

Desirable

 

  • Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions

  • Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts

  • Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches

  • Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers

  • Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware

  • Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions

  • Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry

  • Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan

  • Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

descriptionHtml:

Dieses klare Qualitätsversprechen sorgt dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sich gut informiert, sicher und ernst genommen fühlen.

Gestalte mit uns die Finanzberatung von morgen. WERDE EIN TEIL VON WIR.

Aufgaben

Als selbstständige FORMAXX-Berater:in begleitest du Menschen bei wichtigen finanziellen Entscheidungen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen und ihre finanzielle Zukunft aktiv zu gestalten.   • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und unternehmerisches Denken
  • Selbstorganisierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Motivation, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und deine Karriere aktiv zu gestalten

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir:

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Tailscale, you’ll be the bridge between our technical capabilities and the needs of our most strategic customers. You will work directly with customers to ensure their success with Tailscale’s products, helping them get onboarded, driving their long-term adoption, and providing expert technical guidance throughout their journey. This role requires a combination of technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and an empathetic customer-centric approach to ensure customers are fully empowered to leverage the power of Tailscale. The role will report directly to the Team Lead, Customer Success Engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the onboarding process for new strategic customers, ensuring they quickly understand and adopt Tailscale. Provide training and resources that set customers up for long-term success.
  • Offer technical support for customers, diagnosing and resolving issues across Tailscale's platform. Assist with configuration, integration, and troubleshooting to ensure smooth implementation.
  • Conduct QBRs with customers to review usage, success metrics, and future goals. Use these touchpoints to identify opportunities for deeper engagement and horizontal expansion.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor. Help customers optimize their use of Tailscale by identifying best practices, and by providing recommendations based on their specific use cases and desired business outcomes.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, relaying feedback and insights to the product and engineering teams to help improve the product and the customer experience.
  • Work closely with sales, product, engineering, and support teams to ensure smooth handoffs, escalate critical issues, and drive customer success across the organization.
  • Develop and maintain a repository of technical documentation, FAQs, and guides to help customers self-serve. Share insights and best practices with both the customer and internal teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ Years in a technical role with minimum 2 years of customer-facing experience (Solutions engineer/architect, Sr. Support Engineer, etc.)
  • Experience working with enterprise customers in a consultative capacity
  • Strong understanding of networking, VPNs, and security principles. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and other DevOps technologies
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer/architect, or Customer Success Engineer at a SaaS company
  • Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to a diverse audience, from non-technical stakeholders to engineers. Strong written and verbal communication skills are a must
  • Analytical mindset and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to think critically and methodically to resolve complex technical issues
  • A passion for delivering excellent customer service and a strong focus on building long-term customer relationships
  • Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and keep projects on track. Strong time management and organizational skills are key
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with product, sales, and engineering teams to deliver customer success

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)- Certil
descriptionHtml:
Du baust LLM-Anwendungen, die im Unternehmensalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Und Du bleibst dran, bis sie beim Kunden stabil laufen.

Zwischen einer beeindruckenden KI-Demo und einer Anwendung im Unternehmensalltag liegt viel Arbeit. Genau dort setzt certil an: Wir entwickeln eine Plattform, mit der Unternehmen KI-gestützte und agentische Anwendungen kontrolliert einsetzen können. Quellen, Rechenwege und menschliche Entscheidungen werden nachvollziehbar. Ergebnisse lassen sich nachrechnen, und Menschen prüfen sie und entscheiden offene Fragen verantwortlich.

Bei certil heißt der Bereich, der aus Strategie konkrete Use Cases beim Kunden macht, Forward Engineering. Er umfasst die ganze Kette: Use Case, Konzept, Prototyp, erstes Produkt und Betrieb, gemessen auf jeder Stufe. Der erste Use Case läuft, weitere folgen. Als Forward Deployed Engineer übernimmst Du zuerst Bau und Einführung beim Kunden und betreust mittelfristig ganze Use Cases eigenverantwortlich.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Use Cases zuschneiden: Gemeinsam mit dem Kunden echte Fälle von Hand durchrechnen und messen, ob sich der Use Case lohnt

  • Expertenwissen übersetzen: Die Arbeitsweise von Fachexpert:innen in prüfbare Schritte zerlegen: Dokumente lesen, rechnen, entscheiden

  • Selbst bauen: Vom Prototyp zum ersten produktiven Stand, mit Coding Agents und testgetrieben

  • Einführen und stabilisieren: Den Use Case beim Kunden einführen und so weit stabilisieren, dass manuelle Kontrollschritte wegfallen

  • Zurückspielen: Wiederverwendbare Bausteine an unser Plattform-Team geben, damit der nächste Use Case schneller geht

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn …

  • Du in den letzten zwei Jahren nicht mehr selbst programmiert hast, etwa weil Du in einer reinen Architektur-, Management- oder Beraterrolle warst,

  • Deine LLM-Erfahrung aus Demos oder Hackathons stammt und nie bei echten Nutzer:innen im Einsatz war,

  • Du bisher nur nach Ticket umgesetzt hast, ohne direkten Kontakt zu Kunden oder Fachabteilungen,

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Cinder

Cinder is the mission-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working.

Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated.

We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems.

Why this role

Once a deal closes, you're the technical owner on the ground. You're the escalation point for the customer, working closely with their CSM and Agent Product Manager (agent PM), and the first line of engineering defense when something isn't working the way they expect.

For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day.

What you'd actually work on

  • Shape and prove the solution. Work directly with customers to understand their problems, identify the right use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate value and de-risk the path to production.

  • Own deployments end to end. Take the technical work from scoping and system design through implementation, rollout, and adoption — partnering with the CSM while owning the engineering plan.

  • Build the last mile. Connect Cinder to each customer’s stack through APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, custom workflows, and production-quality code where configuration isn’t enough.

  • Enable customer teams. Run technical workshops, document what you build, and give customers the knowledge and tools to operate successfully without us in the room.

  • Turn fieldwork into product leverage. Solve issues in the systems you ship, identify patterns across customers, and turn those lessons into reusable tools and improvements to the core product. Own on-call for customers when system downtime means moderation stops.

What we're looking for

  • 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Solid Python fundamentals. You can read, debug, and extend backend code without hand-holding. Comfortability with SQL, Typescript, React, and GraphQL.

  • Real experience owning implementation, not just scoping it. You've configured or customized a product for a specific customer and shipped something that changed what that customer could actually do.

  • You are exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and repeatedly take initiative — you thrive when dropped into unfamiliar situations, learning quickly, and finding ways to deliver value.

  • No degree requirement. We care about what you can build, not where you learned to build it. Bootcamp grads are welcome.

Nice to have

  • Understanding of trust & safety or safety operations, either firsthand (you've worked in it) or through a specialized background — a T&S-focused master's, for example — that gives you real fluency, not just familiarity.

  • Consulting experience where you turned a client's ambiguous ask into a working solution.

  • Familiarity with React Query or Strawberry specifically.

  • Experience being embedded with a customer or client team, rather than working at arm's length through tickets.

Location & Benefits

Our team is based in London and we believe that in-person collaboration is important. We offer medical and dental insurance benefits through Allianz Global. We hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer paid lunch when our team is in-person.

Compensation: £115K – £145K • Offers Equity

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in C++, algorithms, and optimization? Check out our Founding Optimization Engineer role.

title: Founding Implementation Manager (Italian Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Sona

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

We're hiring a Founding Implementation Manager to lead how Sona implements in Italy. You'll be the first person doing this job in the market, and you'll own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live.

In the UK, our implementations follow an established playbook. In Italy there isn't one yet, so working out how we do this well is part of the job. Expect a lot of unknowns and plans that change. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed.

Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. You'll own the relationships with our first Italian customers, and build a network of local labour specialists, consultancy-based, whilst you deliver those first implementations.

This role isn't for everyone. If you want a defined process and clear direction on what to do next, you'll find it frustrating. title: Founding Product
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

  • Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

  • Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

  • High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

  • Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

title: Frontend-Entwickler (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns entscheidest du mit, wie unser Frontend aussieht, technisch und inhaltlich. Du hast echten Einfluss auf Architektur, Stack und Qualität und siehst täglich, was deine Entscheidungen bewirken.

  • Moderner Stack ohne Legacy-Blockaden
    Du arbeitest mit React/Next.js, Vue oder dem, was der Job erfordert. Kein Stack wird dir vorgeschrieben, und wenn du ein Tool kennst, das unsere Arbeit besser macht, wollen wir davon hören. Du arbeitest an neuen Projekten und modernisierst bestehende Komponenten, ohne dich durch veralteten Code kämpfen zu müssen.
  • Sichtbarkeit und große Reichweite
    Über 15.000 Website-Klicks täglich. Du siehst den Effekt deiner Arbeit nicht erst nach einem Quartal, sondern direkt: in den Core Web Vitals, in den Conversion-Rates, in den Nutzerzahlen.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook Pro oder Dell XPS mit Linux: Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und niemanden stört), kannst du auch gern Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Frontend-Entwickler (w/m/d) bist du die Verbindung zwischen Design und funktionierendem Produkt. Du arbeitest eng mit UX/UI, Backend und Marketing zusammen, nicht als reine Umsetzung, sondern als technisches Gegenüber auf Augenhöhe. Du sagst Bescheid, wenn ein Design nicht performant umzusetzen ist, schlägst Alternativen vor und trägst aktiv zur Qualität des Gesamtprodukts bei.

  • Entwicklung responsiver UIs
    Du entwickelst moderne, performante Benutzeroberflächen und neue Features, ob für unsere Website, Apps, interne Tools oder zukünftige Projekte.
  • Arbeit mit modernen Frameworks
    Du baust modulare Komponenten und komplette Frontend-Applikationen mit modernen JavaScript-Frameworks wie React/Next.js, Vue.js oder Svelte.
  • Von Figma zu Code
    In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem UX/UI-Team setzt du Figma-Designs in sauberen Code um.
  • Landingpages
    Du baust performante Landingpages für Marketing-Kampagnen, denkst A/B-Tests von Anfang an mit und verstehst, dass Nutzerführung genauso zu deiner Verantwortung gehört wie sauberer Code.
  • Formulare & Nutzer-Flows
    Du gestaltest und optimierst Upload-Strecken, Formularlogiken, Validierungen und Schritt-für-Schritt-Flows in unseren Tools.
  • Dashboards & interne Tools
    Du entwickelst Custom-Tools und Dashboards auf Basis bestehender Daten und Schnittstellen, die unsere internen Prozesse wirklich voranbringen.
  • API-Integration
    Du bindest REST- und GraphQL-APIs ins Frontend ein, sorgst für stabile Datenflüsse und kümmerst dich um Fehlerhandling, Caching und logische UI-Reaktionen.
  • Performance-Optimierung
    Du analysierst und verbesserst unsere Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), optimierst Page Speed und Ladezeiten und nutzt Tools wie Lighthouse, um unsere Produkte messbar schneller zu machen.
  • Page-Builder-Entwicklung
    Gelegentlich unterstützt du das Webdesign-Team bei der Umsetzung in Elementor oder Bricks. Du weißt, wann das sinnvoll ist und wann ein eigenes Template besser ist.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern Erfahrung und echtes Know-how. Du hast Frontend nicht nur ausprobiert, sondern wirklich betrieben: Komponenten, die skalieren. Interfaces, die performen. Code, den andere verstehen. Wenn du das mitbringst und Lust hast, bei uns echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

  • Erfahrung mit modernen Frameworks
    Du hast bereits mit React, Vue, Svelte oder Angular gearbeitet, echte Features damit gebaut, die im Live-Betrieb laufen, und weißt, welche Entscheidungen dabei eine Rolle spielen.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Sichere Web-Grundlagen
    Du beherrschst HTML5, CSS3 (gern auch mit SASS/LESS) und modernes JavaScript. Saubere Struktur, modulares Denken und Wiederverwendbarkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Performance im Blick
    Lazy Loading, Bundling, Caching, WebP: Du denkst Performance nicht als nachträgliche Optimierung, sondern von Anfang an mit.
  • KI-gestützte Entwicklung
    KI ist für dich kein Neuland. Wir stellen dir alle gängigen LLMs zur Verfügung und erwarten, dass du sie sinnvoll nutzt, um deine Arbeit zu optimieren und selbstständig Lösungen zu finden.
  • Dokumentation & Struktur
    Du schreibst klaren, verständlichen Code und hältst wichtige Dinge in kurzer Dokumentation fest.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, Neues auszuprobieren und moderne Webtechnologien in den Alltag einzubringen.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

You will build Laelaps end to end: the Command Centre server that operators use to run fleets of autonomous security robots, and the services on the robot that execute missions and report back. You will own features from the API down to the robot and back, and you will solve the algorithmic problems that sit in between.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Mission and tasking: turning an operator instruction into work for one or many robots across sites, and tracking it to completion

  • Robot-side services that stream telemetry, health, events and evidence to the Command Centre over links that drop out

  • Backend services and APIs behind the operator application, and the frontend where a feature needs it

  • Algorithms for patrol routes, task assignment, coordinate frames and event association

  • Making it all run unsupervised in the field

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • A generalist who is equally at home on a server and on a robot

  • Strong in algorithms and data structures, and able to reason about complexity under real constraints

  • Owns problems end to end and ships

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • 4+ years building production software, on both backend and systems or embedded side

  • Strong Python and one of C++, Rust or Go; TypeScript for the frontend is a plus

  • Linux, networking, distributed systems basics; experience with unreliable networks or edge devices

  • Competitive programming, olympiad or equivalent algorithmic depth is a strong signal

NICE TO HAVE

  • ROS 2 or another robotics middleware

  • Geometry, mapping or multi-agent planning

  • Video or sensor streaming

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
descriptionHtml:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the GRC team 👋

Trainline is investing in the next stage of our security programme, and we’re looking for a Security GRC Associate to help strengthen how we manage third-party security risk and assurance.

You’ll join our Information Security team, reporting to the GRC Manager. Your main job will be making sure the suppliers, technology partners and service providers we rely on meet the security standard our customers expect. You’ll work with Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, Product and teams across the business to manage supplier risk end to end, from onboarding and first assessment through to ongoing assurance and reassessment.

You’ll also support our wider governance and compliance programme, including ISO 27001 and our unified internal control framework. And you’ll help us rethink how GRC gets done, using automation and AI to cut manual effort and give the business a clearer view of risk.

As a Security GRC Associate at Trainline, you will... 🚄

  • Run third-party security risk assessments for new and existing suppliers, including SaaS and cloud providers, technology partners and business-critical vendors

  • Review supplier assurance evidence, such as ISO 27001 certificates, SOC 2 reports, security questionnaires and penetration test summaries, and judge whether the controls in place are adequate

  • Identify and document third-party security risks and recommend proportionate ways to reduce them

  • Help assess the security risks of AI tools, applications and third-party AI integrations, working with the wider GRC and InfoSec teams to review controls and track remediation

  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Privacy and Engineering to build security requirements into supplier onboarding, procurement and contract renewals

  • Keep third-party risk records up to date, track remediation actions, and escalate material risks to the right stakeholders and governance forums

  • Help shape a risk-based approach to ongoing supplier assurance, including periodic reassessments and monitoring of critical suppliers

  • Help improve our Third-Party Risk Management framework, including supplier risk classification, assessment methods, questionnaires and reporting

  • Support ISO 27001 assurance work, such as control assessments, evidence gathering, audit preparation and remediation tracking, and help maintain our unified internal control framework

  • Help build and improve our GRC tooling, using automation and AI to speed up questionnaire reviews, evidence analysis, control mapping and risk reporting

We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Experience in information security, GRC, third-party risk management or a related cyber security discipline

  • Hands-on experience running third-party security assessments, reviewing supplier assurance documentation or supporting vendor risk processes

  • Working knowledge of security standards and frameworks, particularly ISO 27001, ISO 27002 and NIST CSF

  • Experience working with stakeholders across functions, such as Procurement, Legal, Technology and business teams

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to manage several assessments and competing priorities at once

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to explain security requirements to technical and non-technical audiences

  • A proactive, curious mindset and a real interest in improving how security governance and risk management are delivered

Bonus points if you have... ⭐️

  • Experience with GRC or third-party risk platforms such as ServiceNow GRC, Archer, LogicGate, Vanta or Compyl

  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 audits, ISMS maintenance or control assurance

  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 22301, PCI DSS or Cyber Essentials

  • Experience assessing cloud services, SaaS or AI-enabled tools, or familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI RMF

  • Experience automating GRC processes using workflow tools, scripting, low-code platforms or APIs

  • Confident, everyday use of AI tools and LLMs to speed up research and evidence analysis

  • A relevant certification such as ISO 27001 Foundation or equivalent

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought.
