About the role

Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.

You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io, enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.

What would you be doing?

  • Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.

  • Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.

  • Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.

  • Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.

  • Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.

  • Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.

  • Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

What do we need from you?

  • 2+ years in software, systems or integration engineering. You have shipped real integrations or services using APIs, webhooks or event-driven systems.

  • Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. Working SQL plus confidence using Git and code review.

  • Experience integrating with business systems such as CRM, payments, finance, marketing or operations platforms. Salesforce experience is useful but not required.

  • You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders. You can challenge an unclear request and turn the underlying need into something buildable.

  • You can learn unfamiliar systems quickly, then choose the simplest solution that will hold up in production.

  • You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a marketplace or a company selling to small businesses at volume.

  • Hands-on time with an iPaaS or workflow tool such as n8n, Zapier or Workato.

  • Familiarity with tools in our stack such as Snowflake, Customer.io, Gong, Clay or similar systems.

  • Experience with cloud runtimes, CI/CD, observability or production support.

Our culture and what we offer

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • Private health insurance

  • Opportunities for growth and learning

  • Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you: we would still love to hear from you.

title: Head of Business Unit Solaire H/F
descriptionHtml:
🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy ! Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance. Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Nous sommes aujourd’hui une cinquantaine de salariés et nous visons 10 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2027, ce qui nous placera parmi les leaders du marché. Le cap derrière : que tout client qui veut s'équiper pense à nous en premier, parce que nous sommes la référence sur la qualité de l'accompagnement et des produits que nous vendons.

Pour tenir ce cap, nous nous structurons en trois BU :

  • La BU Solaire reste notre activité historique et notre cœur de métier : vente et pose avec nos propres installateu·rices.

  • Notre réseau de Partenaires Certifiés, pour accompagner les clients sur des travaux que nous ne proposons pas en propre (vente et pose de pompe à chaleur notamment).

  • Le matériel, afin de lancer sur le marché français les produits fabriqués par le groupe, comme sa pompe à chaleur Cosy, que l’on souhaite proposer à nos Partenaires Certifiés.

Guillaume, Directeur Général Délégué, qui a lancé la filiale, supervisera les trois et cherche la personne qui dirigera la BU Solaire, notre activité historique.

Ta mission :

Tu diriges la BU Solaire comme un·e véritable dirigeant·e de business : tu fixes le cap, tu portes les résultats et tu construis l'organisation qui nous fera passer à l'échelle. Ton premier chantier : monter en cadence de pose, sans dégrader la qualité, tout en améliorant la rentabilité de la BU en 2027. Tu le fais depuis le terrain autant que depuis le bureau.

Tes responsabilités seront les suivantes :


1. Stratégique : Définir le cap et faire grandir la BU.

Tu portes la vision, la stratégie de développement de la BU et tu prends les arbitrages structurants, notamment :

  • Fixer la trajectoire de la BU et trancher les décisions qui font avancer le business ;

  • Décider, le moment venu, des extensions : nouvelle zone géographique, nouvelle ligne de produit ;

  • Représenter la BU en interne et faire l'interface avec Octopus Energy France (fourniture d'énergie, offre bundlée pose + contrat + pilotage batterie), les fonctions support partagées et les deux autres BU.


    • 2. Économique : Piloter le P&L, la rentabilité et les investissements

    Tu es owner des chiffres de la BU, tu devras notamment :

  • Suivre la rentabilité à chaque maillon de la chaîne (vente, étude, pose, SAV) et les faire suivre à chaque manager ;

  • Travailler avec eux à les améliorer : coût d'acquisition, délais de pose, SAV ;

  • Produire les chiffres du reporting groupe et savoir les défendre.


    • 3. Managériale et opérationnelle : Faire grandir les managers et structurer l'organisation.

    Tu fais monter les responsables de chaque équipe pour qu’ils portent la montée en cadence de la BU dans une organisation qui grandit :

  • Accompagner les managers d’équipe au quotidien pour qu'ils·elles fassent grandir ses équipes, y compris dans les moments difficiles ;

  • Structurer, avec les équipes techniques, la montée en cadence de pose ;

  • Animer le collectif et incarner la culture de l'entreprise : exigence de qualité, jalons, victoires célébrées.


    • Ce qu'on cherche :

    Ce qui compte d'abord, c'est qui tu es :

  • Tu t’intéresses vraiment aux gens, tu es exigeant·e et tu dis les choses clairement, dans le respect de la personne en face.

  • Tu sais engager des équipes pluridisciplinaires : commerce, administratif, technique et terrain ne parlent pas la même langue, tu fais le lien.

  • Tu accompagnes tes managers pour qu'ils fassent monter leurs propres équipes.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans une entreprise en construction : on teste, on se trompe, on recommence.

  • Tu prends ton sujet en main et tu as le courage managérial de dire les choses.

  • Tu es proactif·ve, tu trouves des solutions en autonomie et tu fais s'activer les équipes autour de toi.

    • Côté compétences techniques :

  • Tu as déjà dirigé une activité opérationnelle avec des équipes de terrain. Le solaire résidentiel n'est pas obligatoire.

  • Tu lis un P&L et tu défends tes chiffres devant une direction.

  • Tu as une vraie vision business : tu relies l'opérationnel à la rentabilité.

  • Tu es prêt·e à aller sur le terrain, régulièrement.

  • Tu sais communiquer (écrit et oral) en anglais pour échanger avec le Groupe.

    • Conditions :

  • Contrat : CDI – Statut Cadre

  • Localisation : Paris ou Lille (déplacements à prévoir entre les deux bureaux et sur le terrain)

  • Date de prise de poste : Dès que possible

  • Rémunération : À définir selon profil et expérience


    • Processus de recrutement :

    1. Premier échange avec Chloé, notre Talent Partner en charge de ce recrutement

    2. Échange visio de 30 min avec Guillaume pour comprendre tes motivations pour le poste

    3. Entretien en présentiel à Paris ou Lille avec Guillaume et potentiellement un échange avec un des membres du COMEX Octopus France

    Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

    Tu veux connaitre le salaire ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of E-commerce
descriptionHtml:
On réinvente l'imperméable. Pour de vrai.

On crée des imperméables colorés, modulables et fabriqués à partir de tissus recyclés. Pas pour faire comme tout le monde, mais pour donner enfin envie de porter un imperméable.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une vingtaine, avec un modèle multicanal : un réseau retail en plein développement, un e-commerce qui fonctionne bien et un B2B qui accélère.

Et surtout, on a encore beaucoup de choses à construire et de barrières à faire tomber.

C'est là que tu entres en action.

Le poste

On cherche quelqu'un qui a déjà scalé un e-commerce dans la mode — et qui a envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à dire.

Pas un manager qui supervise. Pas un consultant qui conseille. Un(e) Head of E-commerce qui exécute, qui teste, qui itère, et qui vient chercher le résultat lui-même. Tu travailles en direct avec le fondateur, sans couche intermédiaire, sans réunion de validation à n'en plus finir.

Tu prends le lead sur l'e-commerce de A à Z — et le site, c'est ton produit. Pas un outil qu'on subit, pas un chantier qu'on repousse : quelque chose qu'on améliore en continu, avec méthode, avec des données, et avec l'obsession que chaque visiteur devienne client.

Tu comprends que dans la mode, performance et image de marque ne s'opposent pas — ils se construisent ensemble, sur le long terme. Tu sais qu'une bonne décision d'acquisition peut abîmer une marque, et qu'une marque forte réduit le coût d'acquisition. C'est exactement ce qu'on veut construire chez Flotte.

Si tu cherches un poste où on te demande de « définir uniquement la vision », ce n'est pas ce poste. Si tu cherches un endroit où tu construis quelque chose qui compte, avec quelqu'un prêt à aller vite et à prendre des risques calculés — bienvenue.

Vos missions

Tes responsabilités concrètes

Le site, c'est ton produit

  • Tu « owns » le site de A à Z — pas juste sa performance marketing, mais son expérience, son évolution, sa roadmap
  • Tu priorises les développements avec notre prestataire tech : ce qui sort, dans quel ordre, pourquoi
  • Tu A/B testes en continu — pas une fois par trimestre, mais comme réflexe de travail
  • Tu détectes les points de friction avant que les clients se plaignent
  • Chaque page, chaque étape du tunnel a une raison d'être et un indicateur qui le prouve

Performance & acquisition

  • Piloter et optimiser les campagnes Meta / Google / TikTok (et challenge l'agence qui s'en charge)
  • Construire une stratégie d'acquisition rentable, cohérente avec l'image de marque — pas juste du volume à tout prix
  • Gérer la saisonnalité mode : anticiper les pics, optimiser les périodes creuses, ne jamais sacrifier l'image pour remplir un objectif court terme
  • Déployer un vrai tracking et ne plus naviguer à vue

CRM & retention

  • Structurer la base client, segmenter, personnaliser
  • Email, SMS, automation — construire des flows qui transforment les acheteurs en fans
  • LTV : la faire grimper

Vision 360 & cohérence omnicanale

  • Assurer la cohérence de l'expérience digitale sur tous les canaux : e-commerce, retail, B2B
  • Apporter un regard digital sur la stratégie B2B portée par l'équipe dédiée — sans empiéter sur leur terrain
  • Garantir que le site et les outils digitaux servent l'ensemble des canaux, pas seulement le DTC
  • Être le garant d'une image de marque cohérente quel que soit le point de contact

Développement international

  • Identifier et prioriser les marchés européens à fort potentiel pour Flotte (UK, Benelux, DACH, Nordics...)
  • Définir la stratégie de pénétration marché par marché : positionnement, canaux, pricing, timing
  • Travailler en binôme avec le pôle marketing & communication pour adapter l'image de marque aux marchés cibles sans en diluer l'ADN
  • Tester, mesurer, ajuster — pas de grand plan sur 3 ans, mais une approche structurée et itérative
  • Piloter les partenariats locaux (distributeurs, revendeurs, marketplaces) quand c'est le bon levier

Pilotage

  • Définir les bons KPIs, les suivre, les challenger
  • Être force de proposition sur le budget, les outils, la stack tech
  • Recruter et structurer une petite équipe quand on est prêts

Vos compétences

Le profil qu'on cherche vraiment

Tu as déjà fait le chemin dans la mode — et tu as envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à prouver.

Tu connais les contraintes du prêt-à-porter : les collections qui se succèdent, les stocks à piloter, la saisonnalité qui dicte le calendrier marketing, et la pression permanente de défendre une image de marque tout en délivrant de la performance. Tu sais qu'on ne construit pas une marque mode comme on scale un pure player généraliste. Et tu crois qu'on peut faire les deux.

  • 5 ansd'expérience en e-commerce, obligatoirement dans la mode ou le prêt-à-porter, avec au moins une expérience de scale probante — et des chiffres à l'appui
  • Tu ne sacrifies pas l'image de marque sur l'autel du ROAS — tu sais que la désirabilité d'une marque mode se construit sur le long terme et se détruit très vite
  • Une vision long terme : construire une marque qui dure, pas juste optimiser une saison
  • Un profil entrepreneur dans l'âme : tu penses business autant que tu penses acquisition, tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire
  • Tu maîtrises Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, un outil CRM (Klaviyo ou équivalent)
  • Tu exécutes — la stratégie c'est bien, mais sans exécution ça ne vaut rien
  • Tu es à l'aise pour travailler en direct avec un fondateur exigeant, sans filtre, avec franchise et sans ego
  • Anglais courant obligatoire.

Avantages

Ce qu'on t'offre

Une marque à construire, pas à gérer.

Team Lead Global Logistics (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

As Head of Fulfillment & Logistics Europe, you will own physical logistics, omnichannel operations, and customer deliveries across all our European markets, including the European logistics network strategy. You will also oversee Channel Operations via the Channel Operations Team Lead, and lead the automation roadmap that underpins our Channel Ops efficiency case.

This role is central to making sure our products reach our customers and retail partners on time, every time, as we scale across Europe. How You Work

title: Head of IT & Security
descriptionHtml:
If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

Backed by General Catalyst, the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary.


Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as Head of IT & Security to help our teams support nonprofits with confidence!

We’re looking for a practical, technically credible Head of IT & Security to own and improve the systems, services and controls that help Goodstack work effectively and securely.

You’ll set the direction, make decisions and deliver changes, leading a small, hands-on team. From improving how colleagues get equipment and access to leading our information-security programme, you’ll connect the details to the wider business and make clear trade-offs around risk, productivity, cost and culture.

If you enjoy building a function, developing others and taking improvements from an idea through to a working result, this is an opportunity to shape IT and security in a business helping nonprofits access technology and funding. Working with the VP of Architecture & Infrastructure, you’ll develop the function’s capabilities as Goodstack grows.

As Head of IT and Security, your mission will be to:

  • Own IT and security strategy and delivery. Assess our environment, set priorities and deliver improvements alongside your team. Balance security, productivity, cost and culture while meeting customer commitments. Own the roadmap, budget and risk register, making pragmatic decisions, explaining trade-offs and escalating material risks with recommendations.

  • Build IT that scales with Goodstack. Own identity, devices, SaaS, office technology and employee lifecycle processes. Work with People, Finance, Operations and managers to improve the complete employee experience, remove cross-team friction and reduce manual effort without weakening controls.

  • Lead and develop the function. Set direction, coach technical judgement and support complex work while remaining hands-on. Ensure reliable support coverage and protect time for improvements. Anticipate capability gaps and recommend training, tooling, specialist support or hiring.

  • Own security, compliance and assurance. Lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring policies, controls, audits and evidence are maintained year-round. Work with Engineering on application and cloud risks, including XSS, access controls and configuration weaknesses, ensuring remediation is prioritised and verified.

  • Find weaknesses before they cause harm. Challenge assumptions through threat modelling, authorised security testing, incident exercises and recovery tests. Turn findings into preventive improvements, verify their effectiveness and coordinate security incidents when needed.

  • Build a culture of secure working. Make secure behaviour the easiest choice. Understand why shortcuts happen, improve processes and incentives, provide practical training and encourage early reporting. Help colleagues navigate decisions where the right answer isn't obvious.

  • Own vendors and security relationships. Manage suppliers, licences, renewals, service quality, spend and continuity plans. Coordinate vendor risk, contractual security requirements, subprocessors and privacy operations with Legal, the DPO and business owners. Represent Goodstack in customer security reviews and with auditors and assessors.

  • Lead AI governance and enablement. Own our ISO/IEC 42001 programme, coordinating risk assessments, controls, audit readiness and responsible AI requirements across teams. Establish safeguards for data, access, evaluation and human oversight. Help colleagues adopt approved AI tools safely through guidance, training and pilots, measuring proficiency and impact while department leaders own adoption outcomes.

  • Make IT smarter through automation. Identify recurring problems, employee time lost and avoidable manual work. Choose between simplifying processes, existing tools, deterministic workflows and AI based on risk, value and maintenance cost. Design and review complex automations, measure improvements and ensure appropriate testing, monitoring, exception handling and human oversight.

  • Build a function that doesn't depend on individuals. Establish clear ownership, documentation, recovery procedures and organisation-managed credentials. Ensure critical workflows survive staff departures and can be maintained by others. Use service metrics and operational feedback to continually improve priorities.

After 3, 6 and 9 months, success will look like:

  • 3 months: You've assessed the environment, agreed a prioritised roadmap and delivered initial improvements. Key risks, controls, audit commitments and findings have clear owners. Service baselines are established, and the scope and gaps for ISO/IEC 42001 are understood.

  • 6 months: Routine IT runs reliably without your daily involvement. Measurable improvements show reduced manual effort, delays, and errors without weakening controls. Critical automations have tested recovery arrangements, and initial AI enablement work demonstrates progress. Evidence informs what to continue, simplify, or stop.

  • 9 months: Improvements are sustained, recurring problems are addressed at their source, and leadership has a clear view of risk, spend and priorities. Security exercises and feedback drive prevention, critical workflows can be maintained by others, and you're independently shaping the function's next stage.

  • You've found the stash of sock merch in the office 🧦

This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • Experience owning IT and information security in a growing technology business, with a track record of personally delivering improvements.

  • Strong knowledge of identity, devices, SaaS and workplace IT, alongside enough application and cloud security expertise to challenge and collaborate with engineers.

  • Led ISO 27001 or SOC 2 through assessment and ongoing operation, with the ability to manage both.

  • Excellent judgement balancing security, usability, cost and business needs, including identifying root causes and making decisions under uncertainty.

  • Experience leading and developing colleagues while remaining technically hands-on.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence behaviour, resolve ambiguity and build practical working relationships.

  • Experience delivering reliable automation using scripts, workflows or AI, with sound judgement on security, testing, failure handling, maintainability and measurable impact.

Bonus if you have knowledge or love of:

  • AWS, Google Workspace, Slack, Kandji or Vanta.

  • n8n, API integrations or AI-assisted workflows.

  • Customer security assurance, incident exercises or operational privacy.

  • ISO/IEC 42001, AI governance or organisation-wide AI enablement.

  • Relevant security or service-management qualifications, or equivalent practical experience.

Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. title: Head of Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft.

As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness.

You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service.

  • Define and maintain the propulsion battery system architecture together with the Electrical Systems Architect, ensuring that requirements are correctly allocated, interfaces are controlled, and trade-offs between safety, mass, energy, power, cost and certifiability are made deliberately and documented.

  • Lead, develop and scale the Energy Storage System department, comprising the Airborne Electronics, Airborne Software, Cell Technology, HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration and Thermal Management teams.

  • Recruit, coach and develop team leads and engineers, define clear roles and responsibilities, and align resourcing and hiring plans with the needs of the Microliner programme.

  • Take ownership of key technical decisions, chair design and gate reviews, and escalate programme-level technical risks to the CTO with clear options and recommendations.

  • Own the safety-driven design of the propulsion battery system, including thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and fault tolerance, and work closely with Safety and Systems Engineering on FHA, PSSA, SSA and common-cause analyses.

  • Establish and maintain development processes in line with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, ensuring traceability, configuration control and verification evidence appropriate to the allocated Design Assurance Levels.

  • Shape the certification approach for the propulsion battery system in cooperation with Certification and Airworthiness and represent the ESS team in technical discussions with EASA, including Stage of Involvement (SOI) and compliance reviews.

  • Own the integration of the propulsion battery system with the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the charging and ground infrastructure, including the definition and control of all associated interface requirements.

  • Develop and execute the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system: identify patentable innovations, lead invention disclosures and work with patent counsel on filings, freedom-to-operate assessments and prior-art reviews.

  • Own the PBS department budget, including planning, forecasting and cost control for personnel, hardware, test campaigns and external services.

  • Select and manage key technology suppliers and partners, including cell suppliers, electronics manufacturing partners and suppliers of materials and components, ensuring technical performance, quality and security of supply.

  • Define and oversee the propulsion battery system test strategy, from component and subsystem testing through system-level, environmental, abuse and certification testing, together with the required laboratory and test infrastructure.

  • Prepare the transition from development to series production together with Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain, applying design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly and design-for-test principles.

  • Represent VÆRIDION on technology matters towards authorities, industrial partners, research institutions and funding bodies, and support the preparation and execution of publicly funded research and development projects.

  • Contribute technical expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner and the company’s long-term technology roadmap.

  • Foster an engineering culture defined by technical rigour, accountability, open communication and continuous improvement.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive, Electrochemistry or a related discipline.

  • 15 or more years of professional experience developing complex, safety-critical systems, including at least five years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Proven experience developing high-voltage battery systems for aerospace or automotive applications, from concept through qualification and production.

  • Sound technical understanding of lithium-ion cell technology, battery management systems, high-voltage electrical systems, thermal management and the mechanical integration of battery packs, with the ability to make well-founded decisions across these disciplines.

  • Experience with thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and functional safety concepts for battery systems.

  • Practical experience with aerospace development and certification standards, including ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, is strongly preferred. Familiarity with CS-23 certification is advantageous.

  • A track record of building and scaling engineering organisations, including recruitment, development of team leads and the introduction of structured development processes.

  • Experience with budget responsibility, supplier selection and the management of strategic technology partners.

  • Experience generating and protecting intellectual property, including invention disclosures and collaboration with patent counsel.

  • Experience representing technical programmes towards authorities, partners, funding bodies and other external stakeholders.

  • The ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to engineers, executive management and external stakeholders.

  • A structured, decisive and hands-on leadership style, with the ability to perform in a fast-paced start-up environment.

  • Fluent English-language skills are essential; German-language skills are beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

descriptionHtml:

title: Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Project Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.

We energize the future.

PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.

Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for

  • PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.
  • Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)
  • Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg
  • Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)
  • Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.
  • Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.
  • Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.
  • Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).
  • Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.
  • Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.
  • Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.
  • Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.
  • Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.

Key Projects (2027 portfolio)

  • Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.
  • BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.
  • Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.
  • Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.
  • Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.
  • ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.
  • Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).

Core Competencies

  • Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.
  • Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.
  • Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.
  • Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.
  • Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.
  • Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.
  • Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.
  • Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.
  • Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.
  • Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.
  • Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).
  • Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.
  • Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.
  • Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous

Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.

Reporting Line: Reporting to Head of IT Direct reports: none (functional lead of external infrastructure and security providers)

Workload: 100% - Hybrid

Travel: approx. 10% – PHENOGY offices, BESS customer sites and partner/supplier sites as required

We offer you:

  • Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership.
  • Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy.
  • Become part of our eco-passionate expert team - a first-class team all around. 
  • Benefit from flexible work hours as well as remote and on-site working in a modern sustainable office
  • Enjoy various events, an amazing coffee machine, and the occasional coffee from our CEO (acting Barista)

At PHENOGY, we highly value diversity, equality, and inclusion. It makes our company stronger. Our philosophy: one mindset, many minds.

title: Inside Account Executive | SMB Benelux | Existing customers
descriptionHtml:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Inside Account Executive I is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping prospects and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. The role works with the extended sales team to hit individual targets as well as contributing to the overall CEE sales goals.

This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to be in the office in Amsterdam Zuid 3 days per week. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the NL and have sponsorship to live and work in the NL #LI-Hybrid

What you can expect to do this role:

  • Communicate regularly with a defined list of existing accounts throughout the year to identify areas of need for business growth and new solutions
  • Own on-time renewal for your entire SMB customer portfolio; consistently meet or exceed retention rate targets.
  • Proactively engage customers 90–120 days ahead of renewal to understand health, flag risks, and secure commitment
  • Understand customer business needs and schedule technical demonstrations or face to face meetings with SE as required.
  • Identify and qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer base by aligning Jamf solutions to customer business needs and industry insights.
  • Execute campaigns to drive traffic to online and in-person events
  • Enter new Opportunities and related information into SalesForce.com to document and manage sales activities
  • Develop well-rounded understanding of JAMF sales philosophy, market and customers
  • Know how to position JAMF Software solutions against competitor offerings
  • Accurately process customer transactions such as price quotations and purchase orders
  • Grow understanding of and ability to explain business value of JAMF Software solutions to prospects and existing customers
  • Responsible for leading and closing sales opportunities for the Strategic Commercial team
  • Performs all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and purpose of the organization
  • Adheres to the highest moral, ethical and legal standards to deliver an environment that promotes respect, innovation and creativity
  • Supports and promotes a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed and manifested in our work

What we are looking for:

  • Professional working proficiency in English and Dutch is required.
  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a sales, business or entrepreneurial role (required).
  • General Experience selling in both direct and indirect (channel) models (Preferred)
  • General Experience navigating and negotiating legal agreements (Required)
  • General Experience in software sales within high-growth technology companies (Preferred)
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate well with other team members that are remote
  • Ability to interact effectively with prospects and customers via phone and email
  • Ability to balance areas of responsibility across multiple territories
  • 10% travelling expected

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News.
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. 


What does Jamf do?Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

title: Interim Senior Community Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

title: Intern (m/f/d) Brand & Communication | German Required
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

You want brands to be seen, understood and remembered – and you want to work with people who bring the same energy?

As an Intern (m/f/d) Brand & Communication at our Munich headquarters, you work directly with our Brand Strategist to make sure the yoummday brand reaches the right people, online and offline. Your work goes live – and you see what it achieves.

What your tasks will be

  • Corporate Communication: You research compelling stories around yoummday and prepare them for our newsroom and external media.

  • Content Production: Together with our Brand Strategist, you create content for different channels – from text and video to illustrations, infographics and white papers.

  • Social Media: You help manage and analyse our channels (primarily LinkedIn and YouTube), bring in ideas for their development – and implement them.

  • Thought Leadership Event: You support the planning and delivery of our annual exclusive event for key accounts – from the concept to the details that turn the day into a real "you made my day" moment.

Your Skillset

  • Academic background: You are studying marketing, communications, media or a comparable subject at a renowned university – or you have just graduated.

  • Experience: You have gained first practical experience, e.g. in an agency, a consultancy, a start-up or a scale-up, and you are genuinely interested in brand and marketing.

  • Mindset: You think analytically and strategically, learn fast and work proactively, reliably and in a structured way.

  • Communication: You put yourself in your target audience's shoes, have an eye for detail in text, numbers and design, and present convincingly.

  • Tools: You know common content creation tools for graphics, layout and video (e.g. Canva, Adobe, CapCut) or pick them up quickly. You use AI tools confidently, review the output critically and stand behind your content. Experience with social media analytics is a plus.

  • Languages: You speak and write German and English fluently.

  • Availability: 6-month internship, starting as soon as possible – mandatory or voluntary internship.

Your Winning Deal

  • Your impact: From day one, you help shape one of the strongest and most profitably growing scale-ups – and leave your footprint.

  • Your development: You continuously build your skill set, learn from our experts and have the chance to stay with the Brand & Communication team long-term.

  • Your team: You work closely with our Brand Strategist and cross-functionally with teams from marketing to operations – in a culture of open discussion and mutual learning.

  • Your environment: You work in a market we are turning upside down, with a performance-driven, motivated team and modern technology.

  • Your workplace: You work from our Munich headquarters at least two, ideally three to four days per week, with state-of-the-art equipment.

  • Our values: We live courage, authenticity and sustainability. Show us how you take on the challenge.

About us

Are you looking for a profitable scale-up that offers you long-term prospects and a disruptive business model with a growth-oriented corporate culture? Do you also want to grow beyond the usual standards, bring your own initiative and appreciate actively shaping topics?

Then yoummday is the right place for you!

yoummday: “You made my day” - As an innovative SaaS platform, we connect companies with highly qualified freelance call center agents (“Talents”) worldwide. Our digital solution enables flexible, scalable and efficient customer support - without the need for traditional call center structures. We are a family-run Munich-based scale-up with over 350 employees (“Daymakers”) at 5 locations in Europe and 1 in the USA - further growth is inevitable ;).

Become part of our team and set new standards in AI-supported customer service with us to create smart, data-driven solutions that inspire.

At yoummday, we value diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of gender, background, age, sexual orientation, religion, or disability. Different perspectives make us stronger – which is why we actively promote an inclusive work environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our mission is to provide transparency & access to private markets by building a tech-based platform enabling funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, process-driven Investor Onboarding Manager to join our Operations team at bunch. This role will own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds across multiple markets, especially the Netherlands, the UK, and Germany, by managing documentation, investor communication, KYC/AML pre-checks, and closings. This is an individual contributor role in a growing Investor Onboarding team, reporting to the Investor Onboarding Lead.

How the role contributes to the company's vision

  • Ensure a smooth, compliant, and high-quality onboarding experience for investors by owning onboarding workflows end to end with precision and care

  • Help funds close on time by keeping investor files complete, compliant, and finalised in coordination with fund managers, AML officers, and internal teams

  • Keep onboarding in line with jurisdiction-specific requirements across Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK, including investor qualification, FATCA/CRS, and signing rules

  • Drive consistency and operational excellence by keeping SOPs current and turning edge cases and lessons learned into process improvements

Why you should join bunch

title: Kundenbetreuung, Genehmigungs- & Trainingsmanagement (m/w/d) – Drohnen im professionellen Einsatz
descriptionHtml:
Bielefeld oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands · Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Über U-ROB

U-ROB gehört zu den etablierten Full-Service-Anbietern für Drohnenlösungen. Wir bringen Drohnen in den echten Einsatz. Dafür arbeiten wir mit mobilen Drohnen wie der DJI FlyCart 100, der DJI Matrice 5T und der Matrice 400, mit autonomen Dock-Systemen und mit intelligenter Flugsoftware. Außerdem entwickeln wir Detektionslösungen für die jeweiligen Bedrohungsszenarien unserer Kunden.

Wir sind ein schlagkräftiges Team. In dieser Rolle stehen die sorgfältige fachliche Begleitung komplexer Genehmigungsprojekte, die verlässliche Kundenbetreuung und die Organisation unserer Trainings im Mittelpunkt.

Worum es geht

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Position liegt im Genehmigungsmanagement für komplexe Drohneneinsätze. Du prüfst anspruchsvolle Einsatzvorhaben unter technischen, rechtlichen und operativen Rahmenbedingungen und stimmst die Anforderungen und Lösungswege eng mit unseren Kunden ab.

Du entwickelst genehmigungsfähige Betriebskonzepte, erstellst die erforderlichen Antrags- und Nachweisunterlagen und reichst sie bei den jeweils zuständigen Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden ein. Rückfragen und Anpassungen begleitest du bis zur Entscheidung.

Daneben betreust du unsere Kunden rund um regelmäßig stattfindende Trainings zur Betriebskategorie „speziell“ und zu konkreten Drohnenlösungen. Du koordinierst Termine, Teilnehmende, Trainer, Unterlagen und Nachweise.

Hier kommen Technik, Recht und praktische Anwendung zusammen. Du arbeitest dich detailliert in Einsatzszenarien, technische Systeme und regulatorische Vorgaben ein, bewertest auch anspruchsvolle fachliche Fragestellungen selbstständig und überführst sie in fundierte, nachvollziehbare Unterlagen und umsetzbare Lösungen.

Was dich erwartet

Was du mitbringst

title: Kundensupport (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Im Kundensupport (m/w/d) bist du ihre erste Anlaufstelle: per Chat, Telefon und Videocall, von der ersten Frage bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Das heißt viel direkter Kontakt, schnelles Feedback und echte Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

  • Problemlösung: Wenn etwas hakt, etwa bei Freigaben, Bestellungen oder Lieferterminen, findest du gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team eine Lösung und hältst den Jahrgang auf dem Laufenden.

  • Begleitung: Du begleitest Jahrgänge von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung und sorgst dafür, dass kein Projekt untergeht.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Du führst buchbare Video-Calls, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Unterstützung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und hilfst dabei, Chatbot und Helpcenter besser zu machen.

  • Feedback: Du gibst weiter, was SchülerInnen bewegt, damit wir Produkt und Abläufe verbessern können.

So arbeiten wir

  • Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Support, idealerweise mit Endkunden. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen, etwa aus Hospitality, Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel, Jugendarbeit oder dem Lehramt, auch ohne abgeschlossenes Referendariat.

  • Du kannst gut mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache und geduldig, wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt.

  • Du schreibst schnell, klar und freundlich. Am Telefon bist du genauso entspannt wie im Chat.

  • Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen den Überblick. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools wie Chat-, Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: Wenn du willst, übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen.
