title: Lead Engineer - Stock Trading App
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Growth Marketing / Performance Lead (m/w/d) - D2C E-Com
descriptionHtml:
Hast du schonmal gesehen, wie jemand beim Auspacken einer schön gestalteten Deko-Box die Augen leuchten lässt?

Hast du schonmal beobachtet, wie Menschen ihre ganz eigene Floristik-Kreation erschaffen und plötzlich Stolz und Freude auf einmal real werden?

Hast du schonmal ein Produkt in der Hand gehabt, das so durchdacht war, dass es Menschen einfach Lust macht, kreativ zu werden?

Ja? Nein?

Jeden Tag versuchen Menschen, ihre Wohnräume schöner zu gestalten — ohne professionelle Floristik-Kurse zu brauchen oder stundenlang Material zusammenzusuchen. Genau dafür entwickeln wir bei Flowers & Me wunderschöne DIY Deko-Boxen: durchdacht, inspirierend, einfach zum Selbermachen. Unsere Vision ist simpel: Wir wollen Menschen die Freude am Selbermachen leichter zugänglich machen und ihnen zeigen, dass sie selbst Designer ihrer Räume sind.

Und jetzt stehst du an einem Punkt, an dem deine Arbeit genau das möglich macht. Flowers & Me hat gerade erst begonnen. Wir skalieren von quasi Null auf 5 Millionen — und Performance Marketing ist der Hebel, der das möglich macht. Du baust das System, das uns von einer kleinen, ambitionierten Gründermarke zu einem europäischen Player entwickelt. Neue Märkte, neue Kundinnen und Kunden, exponentielles Wachstum.

Mit deiner Arbeit entscheidest du mit, ob Millionen Menschen die Freude am Selbermachen entdecken — oder ob sie es nie erfahren.

Aufgaben

Ja, wir zahlen fair, du arbeitest flexibel und hybrid, und du hast kurze Wege direkt zu Christian und unserem Gründerteam. Das ist für uns selbstverständlich.

Wichtiger ist: Du baust hier wirklich etwas – kein fertiges Setup, das du nur verwaltest. So gehst du es an:

  • Ownership: Du verantwortest Acquisition und Retention bei Flowers & Me und elvent und baust ein profitables, skalierbares Growth-System über den gesamten Funnel – mit klarem Fokus auf Wiederkauf, LTV und Brand-Wachstum.
  • Kanalsteuerung & Sparring: Du steuerst unser internes Meta-Team und unsere Google-Agentur strategisch, briefst, challengst und stellst Profitabilität sowie Wachstum sicher – ohne im Daily Doing zu versinken.
  • Strategie: Du entwickelst eine tragfähige Wachstumsstrategie inklusive Kanalpriorisierung, Retention-Hebeln, Testlogik und EU-Roadmap.
  • Brand & Community: Du baust eine konsistente Markenführung über alle Touchpoints (Ads, Newsletter, WhatsApp, Content) auf und entwickelst eine Community, die langfristig bei uns bleibt.
  • CRM & Retention (hands-on): Du baust Klaviyo-Flows, WhatsApp-/ChatArmin-Kanäle und Newsletter selbst auf und entwickelst sie weiter – Welcome, Post-Purchase, Winback, Replenishment, Cross-Sell und Reaktivierung mit messbarem Impact auf LTV und Wiederkaufrate.
  • Automatisierung: Du etablierst automatisierte Reporting- und Entscheidungsworkflows für schnellere, sauberere Performance-Entscheidungen über Acquisition und Retention hinweg.
  • KI-Einsatz: Du nutzt KI für Content-Produktion, Lokalisierung, Übersetzung und Lifecycle-/Creative-Workflows – mit Blick auf Qualität, Brand Fit und Skalierbarkeit über Märkte hinweg.
  • Leadership & Teamführung: Du führst das bestehende Marketing-Team (Meta-Spezialist, Videograf, Werkstudent) disziplinarisch, baust neues Personal auf und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam an Unternehmenszielen, Budgetlogiken und Prioritäten.

Und ganz ehrlich: Das wird nicht nur bequem. Du wirst mit schnellwechselnden Trends, saisonalen Peaks, vielen Prioritäten und hohem Tempo umgehen. Nicht jedes Setup wird perfekt sein. Genau deshalb suchen wir dich – jemanden, der Klarheit schafft, Systeme baut und pragmatisch entscheidet.

Qualifikation

  • Bisherige Stationen: Du hast eine D2C-/Subscription-Brand idealerweise im Bereich 5–30 Mio. € Umsatz wesentlich mit aufgebaut bzw. skaliert und kannst konkrete Wachstums-, Retention- und Profitabilitätsbeispiele nennen.
  • Level: Du bist strategisch stark, bleibst aber hands-on. Du baust eine Roadmap und gehst trotzdem tief in Klaviyo, WhatsApp/ChatArmin, Newsletter, Reporting oder Briefings.
  • Meta & Paid Social (Steuerung): Du hast relevante Meta-Budgets gesteuert oder eng begleitet, kannst Creative-Testing-, Account- und Skalierungslogik auf Augenhöhe mit Spezialist:innen besprechen und challengen – ohne täglich selbst im Ads Manager zu sitzen.
  • Google / Shopping / PMax: Du bringst ein solides Verständnis für Search, Shopping, Feed-Qualität, PMax und Suchintention mit und kannst eine Agentur entlang klarer Profitabilitäts-KPIs sauber steuern.
  • Brand & Marketing Psychology: Du verstehst, wie Marken psychologisch aufgebaut werden, Community entsteht und Kund:innen langfristig bleiben – und übersetzt das in konsistente Tonalität, Story und Touchpoints.
  • CRM / Retention (hands-on): Du hast Klaviyo-Flows, WhatsApp/ChatArmin-Setups und Newsletter selbst gebaut und weißt, wie Welcome-, Post-Purchase-, Winback-, Replenishment- und Cross-Sell-Flows LTV und Wiederkaufrate konkret hebeln. GA4, GTM und CAPI sind für dich kein Nebenthema.
  • Mindset & Leadership: Du denkst unternehmerisch, priorisierst nach Impact, sprichst Klartext und übernimmst gerne disziplinarische Führung über ein bestehendes, kleines Team mit Spezialist:innen.
  • Sprachen: Mit sehr gutem Deutsch und Englisch steuerst du Kampagnen, Märkte und Lokalisierung sauber.

Bist du an Bord?

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice- und Remote-Möglichkeit nach Abstimmung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Zusätzliche Urlaubstage

  • Fitnessabo
  • Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks
  • Kostenloses Parken
  • Haustiere erlaubt

Also, bewirb dich noch heute

Wenn du Lust hast, Performance Marketing bei elvent und Flowers & Me nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern wirklich zu bauen, dann sollten wir sprechen.

Bewirb dich über unser Bewerbungsformular und hilf uns dabei, die Freude am Selbermachen noch mehr Menschen zugänglich zu machen.

descriptionHtml:

Entwickelt wird bei uns das erste zertifizierbare Level-4-Autonomiesystem Europas, das die Erkenntnisse kognitiver Neurowissenschaft nutzt, um komplexe Verkehrsszenarien in der realen Welt sicher zu bewältigen. Unsere fortschrittliche Technologie erkennt nicht nur - sie versteht Zusammenhänge und trifft die richtigen Entscheidungen. Unser vielfältiges und fortschrittlich denkendes Team aus Ingenieur*innen und Wissenschaftler*innen gestaltet die Zukunft der Mobilität.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Homologationsstrategien für autonome Fahrsysteme
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen aus der AFGBV sowie dem StVG für autonome Fahrzeuge
  • Verantwortung für die Erreichung und den Nachweis der System-Compliance gegenüber gesetzlichen und regulatorischen Vorgaben
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Teams zur Definition, Erstellung und Abstimmung der Typgenehmigungs- und Homologationsdokumentation
  • Umsetzung und Überwachung von Risikomanagementprozessen auf Basis gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen
  • Analyse und Interpretation nationaler sowie internationaler Vorschriften im Bereich des automatisierten und autonomen Fahrens
  • Begleitung von Behörden-, Audit- und Zertifizierungsprozessen im Rahmen der Typgenehmigung

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Homologation bzw. Typgenehmigung in der Automobilindustrie
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Autonomous Driving (AD) und Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS)
  • Gutes Verständnis der europäischen Typgenehmigungsanforderungen und relevanten regulatorischen Prozesse
  • Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Normen und Regularien (ISO 21448, ISO 26262, UNECE R155/R156)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Dokumentationen sowie regulatorischen Anforderungen
  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit einem hohen Qualitäts- und Detailbewusstsein
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Ownership
  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (min. C1)

Benefits

  • Bei uns gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft der nachhaltigen Mobilität mit
  • Du profitierst von regelmäßigem, leistungsbasiertem Feedback mit klaren Zielsetzungen, damit du dich persönlich, fachlich und gehaltstechnisch weiterentwickeln kannst
  • Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen – deshalb übernehmen wir die Kosten für Fort- und Weiterbildungen
  • Wir unterstützen deine umweltfreundliche Mobilität mit einem Zuschuss zum Jobticket
  • Teamgeist wird bei uns großgeschrieben – auf regelmäßigen Team- und Firmenevents feiern wir gemeinsame Erfolge
  • Dich erwartet ein Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Berlins in einem engagierten, internationalen Team

In unseren neuen Räumlichkeiten legen wir viel Wert darauf, uns alle kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die Vision voranzutreiben. Unser international aufgestelltes Team wächst und arbeitet gemeinsam an der aufregenden Mission. Persönliche Zusammenarbeit ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg, daher haben wir uns entschieden keine Full-Remote-Company zu werden.

Wir bitten Personalvermittlungen und Agenturen, keine Kandidatenprofile ohne unsere vorherige ausdrückliche Aufforderung einzureichen. title: Lead Manager Governance, Risk & Compliance (Interner ISB & DSB) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Deine Mission: Sicherheit, Qualität & Compliance aus einer Hand.
In dieser Rolle berichtest du direkt an die Geschäftsführung und stellst sicher, dass wir regulatorisch, prozessual und physisch optimal aufgestellt sind. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

Informationssicherheit & Datenschutz (ca. 60%):

  • Offizielles Mandat: Übernahme der Rollen als interne:r Informationssicherheitsbeauftragte:r (ISB) und behördlich gemeldete:r Datenschutzbeauftragte:r (DSB).

  • Sicherstellung der DSGVO-Compliance, Führung der Verzeichnisse von Verarbeitungstätigkeiten (VVT) und Prüfung von Auftragsverarbeitungsverträgen (AVV).

Qualitätsmanagement (ca. 25%):

Arbeitssicherheit & Brandschutz (ca. 15%):

title: Lead Mechatronics and Systems Engineer - Preclinical Research
descriptionHtml:
Type: Fixed-term or Full-time

Location: London · On-site · May require occasional travel

 

The Role

We are building integrated human and non-human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection.

We are looking for an experienced researcher engineer that is hands-on to own the London capture site across both lab and field settings: set up and run the hardware, import and enforce best-practice capture protocols, and ensure every session executes reliably and reproducibly. This is an operational role: you'll take defined capture standards and make them run at scale, not design the science.

 

Responsibilities

Experimental Operations

  • Implement and maintain streamlined, minimal capture protocols

  • Import and operationalize best-practice standards for human mocap

  • Prepare and run recording sessions

  • Maintain clear SOPs and documentation

  • Ensure sessions are reproducible and well logged

Hardware & Systems

  • Set up and maintain motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems

  • Integrate all devices on a shared clock (video, kinematics, physiological streams)

  • Troubleshoot signal, sync, and capture-quality issues

  • Assemble and maintain multi-camera / multi-sensor rigs

  • Manage equipment inventory, calibration, and camera setup

Infrastructure

  • Oversee lab layout and capture-space setup

  • Maintain structured data storage, formats, and backups

  • Coordinate procurement and supplier communication

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • Experience with human motion capture (marker-based, markerless/computer-vision, or IMU-suit systems)

  • Multi-camera calibration and time synchronization

  • Strong hardware troubleshooting ability

  • Comfortable with embedded systems

  • Basic Python scripting

  • Organized and systematic; disciplined about documentation and reproducibility

Valued

  • Hand / finger kinematics capture and video pipelines

  • Structured data formats (e.g. HDF5) and reproducible data logging

  • Experience with physiological recording systems (EEG or similar), or willingness to cross-train

title: Lead Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Lead Platform Engineer to own our Google Cloud platform and the route our engineers take to production. You'll spend most of your time designing and building, and you'll manage one infrastructure engineer from day one.

As the business grows we expect the platform team to grow with it, and we'd like you to lead that. You'll report to the Director of Engineering.

What you'll work on

  • Completing the rollout of the next version of our platform while the current one keeps serving live traffic.

  • Moving acquired sites, which currently deploy in their own ways, onto a common build and release path.

  • Strengthening edge protection and resilience so the platform absorbs traffic spikes and hostile traffic.

  • Giving every team clear visibility of what's deployed, when, and how often.

  • Defining the route from prototype to production, including the checks a service needs before it goes live.

What you'll be responsible for

Platform and infrastructure

  • Design, build and run scalable, secure infrastructure on GCP, defined in Terraform.

  • Own networking and IAM design, including VPCs, ingress through Traefik, and encryption of data at rest and in transit.

  • Make and record architecture decisions for the platform, and keep them visible to the wider team.

  • Work with the software engineering team to ensure we’re delivering the right infrastructure at the right time.

  • Work with our data engineers on the infrastructure behind BigQuery and our data pipelines.

Delivery and developer experience

  • Own our CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and make deployments quick and repeatable.

  • Build self-service tooling so product engineers can ship and run their own services with confidence.

Reliability and security

  • Set up monitoring, logging and alerting using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Prometheus and Grafana.

  • Lead root cause analysis after incidents and see the fixes through.

  • Build security into the delivery process early, and track and address vulnerabilities across the estate.

  • Keep the platform in line with our regulatory obligations and internal policies.

Leadership

  • Line manage and develop our infrastructure engineer, with regular one-to-ones and a clear growth plan.

  • Set platform standards and help the iGaming and Rewards tech leads adopt them.

  • Shape the platform roadmap with the Director of Engineering and plan how the team grows.

  • Hire into the platform team as it expands.

About you

  • Significant experience as a platform, cloud or infrastructure engineer, including time as the senior or lead engineer on a team.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with GCP, including GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

  • Strong Terraform skills and experience running infrastructure as code in production.

  • Experience building and running CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitHub Actions.

  • Solid Docker and Kubernetes experience, including cluster networking and ingress.

  • Scripting and programming ability in Python, Go or Bash.

  • Experience with observability tooling and with leading incident response.

  • Experience mentoring engineers, and a real interest in line management.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort explaining technical trade-offs to people outside engineering.

Nice to have

  • TypeScript or JavaScript experience.

  • ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

  • Experience consolidating infrastructure after an acquisition or major migration.

  • Experience building or growing a platform team.

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Vitality)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

title: Lead Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Principal Accountabilities

Platform Architecture and Engineering

  • Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

  • Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

    Infrastructure as Code and Automation 

  • Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero. 

  • Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

    Security, Governance, and Compliance 

  • Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards. 

  • Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence. 

  • Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed.

    Platform Operations and Service Ownership 

  • Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements.

  • Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes. 

  • Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation.

    Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems. 

  • Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work.

    Personal Attributes & Experience 

  • A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale.

  • Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions.

  • Line Management Experience

  • Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability. 

  • Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents. 

  • Treats developer experience as a product.

  • Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate. 

  • Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past.

  • Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite. 

  • Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation. 

  • Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things.

    Desirable Experience 

  • Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform. 

  • Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments.

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns. 

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Lead Product Engineer, Growth
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer for Growth: someone who has built consumer products across the stack and wants to work where more growth means more lives improved. You join a pod of four to six engineers and an Engineering Pod Lead, and you take member problems from idea to production.

Growth owns how people find Neko, join it, pay for it and bring their friends: the website, waitlist, booking, payments, referrals, invites, membership tiers, B2B, localization, and the launch of every new clinic and market. More clinics and more members mean more lives improved and saved, and the faster we grow, the more lives we reach. You care about the numbers behind every screen: what converts, what compounds, and what to kill.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Ship to production in your first week and own a meaningful part of the funnel within your first month: waitlist, booking, payments or invites.

  • Ship features end to end across the website, web app and backend that move a conversion rate, in every market and currency we operate in.

  • Run experiments properly: hypothesis, instrumentation, ship, read, keep or kill.

  • Build growth machinery rather than one-off features: referrals, invites, membership tiers, payments and localization, so the next launch is configuration, not code.

  • Hold the quality bar with AI tools in your daily loop: fast, secure public surfaces, resilient to fraud and abuse.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience building full-stack products with real customer usage, including a funnel, payments flow or a growth loop.

  • You have shipped features end to end that moved a number, and you solve the problem regardless of the tool.

  • You know the difference between an experiment result and noise.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools, and you can show what you have shipped with them.

  • You work well with product, design, marketing, and other teams, and translate technical decisions into what they mean for members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Launching a consumer product in a new country or market.

  • Marketing or content-driven websites: Next.js, a headless CMS, performance and SEO at scale.

  • Payments, checkout or localization across multiple currencies.

  • A regulated or trust-critical domain: healthcare, fintech or similar

Our Stack

  • Frontend: React, React Native, TypeScript, Swift and Kotlin where needed, Next.js, Sanity, Vercel

  • Backend: C#, Node, Cosmos DB

  • Design: Figma

  • Tooling: Azure DevOps, Claude Code

title: Machine Learning Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.

What You'll Do

  • Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment

  • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for scientific data — including preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and deployment

  • Ability to communicate model behavior, confidence intervals, and limitations clearly to physicists, engineers, and non-ML specialists

  • Strong cross-functional team skills; comfort working in an interdisciplinary environment spanning physics, engineering, and software

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) or neural operators (DeepONet, FNO) applied to physical systems

  • Background in laser physics, plasma physics, high-energy-density science, or related complex physics domains

  • Experience with digital twin platforms and live integration of ML models with simulation environments (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Siemens Xcelerator, ANSYS Twin Builder)

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) workflows, including Design of Experiments (DoE), sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty propagation

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to physical system control or optimization

  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo methods and statistical uncertainty quantification frameworks

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) in a scientific computing context

  • Interest in fusion energy, advanced laser systems, or high-energy-density physics

Role Summary and Impact

This role forms part of a globally-distributed business intelligence team, whose objective is to ensure that one of our most important global accounts have access to the right data and insights to inform their marketing decisions.

The team’s primary responsibility is to build and maintain, bespoke and xLOB global reporting solutions. Automating the collection and transformation of disparate marketing data into a single source of truth for use by both the agency and the brand. Not only does that mean running and maintaining the solution that already exists, but also continually improving it to incorporate new features, add new data sources, and to aid in deriving new insights in support of ever-evolving business demands.

As a BI Manager your primary responsibility will be partnering with the planning and measurement teams to craft technical solutions that deliver complete and insightful reporting data. You will help translate requirements into practical BI and data provisioning solutions, working across tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Looker Studio, cloud data infrastructure, data preparation and ETL processes, and digital marketing data sources.

You will interface with client and agency users across 29 markets, gathering their evolving needs, vetting requirements for feasibility and supporting them in the use of the reporting solution. The team also enlists engineers, project and scrum managers, and business analysts who will aid in the build and support of this reporting solution.

The data processes you will manage will support 2 global client-side ROI models and a suite of media and operational dashboards and reports in support of agency stakeholders.

title: Marketing Manager - Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, with regular time in Benelux

Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We’re looking for a Benelux Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. You’ll be grounded in our London GTM hub and spend lots of time in the region, getting to know the market up close.

We already have great momentum in Benelux, and our new Benelux Sales Director has joined to lead sales in the region. Now we need someone to support the Benelux hub and get our brand out there, so that when a Benelux finance team outgrows its current setup, Light is the obvious next move.

You’ll own the Benelux marketing plan end to end. You’ll have a dotted line into the Benelux hub, which spans sales, implementation and customer success, and you’ll work closely with our central growth team to find new ways to drive demand through digital channels.

We’re open on level. Whether you’re earlier in your marketing career or have years of experience behind you, we’ll shape the role around the person we hire.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and running the Benelux marketing plan, with pipeline targets you share with the Benelux hub.

  • Running a field and events programme across Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Brussels, Antwerp, Luxembourg and any other city you think makes sense, from intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

  • Growing partnerships with the accounting firms, advisors, investors and communities that Benelux finance leaders trust and that extend our voice across the region.

  • Localising our story, content and campaigns so they land with Benelux finance teams in their own language and context.

  • Creating content with our customers, product and design teams that turns what Light does into stories people want to share.

  • Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the region.

  • Building relationships with local press and the people who shape the Benelux tech and finance conversation.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Experience in B2B marketing, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS company, with hands-on time in field, events, partnerships or content.

  • The judgement to know which lever to pull and when, and the drive to learn the ones you haven’t pulled yet.

  • A feel for what lands with Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourgish audiences, and how to localise a brand for each of them.

  • Comfort working with sales, implementation and customer success as one team, with pipeline as the shared goal.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

  • A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

  • Fluency in English and Dutch. French is a bonus.

  • A passport. Expect to spend lots of time across Benelux, plus trips to our teams in Copenhagen, Munich, New York and elsewhere.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London, whenever you’re not on the road in Benelux.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 The chance to put Light on the map in Benelux and shape a category from the inside.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

We already have momentum in Benelux, and now we want every scaling company in the region to know our name. If you know the market, love building from the ground up and want to help retire the ERP for good, let’s talk.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Index Engineer, Search Crawler)
descriptionHtml:
AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure.

  • Develop and optimize indexing strategies that balance performance, freshness, and resource efficiency.

  • Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current.

  • Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput conditions.

  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interface contracts that stay flexible as the system evolves.

  • Define and implement observability across offline and near line pipelines, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals.

  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations as business needs change.

  • Partner with retrieval, ranking, and ML teams to make sure indexing outputs meet their requirements.

  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems.

  • Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust.

  • Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets.

  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability.

  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents.

  • A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.

title: Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Für viele Mandant:innen bist du der Mensch, der endlich Klarheit bringt. Damit du dich voll darauf konzentrieren kannst, bekommst du bei uns digitale Tools, ein Team ohne Ellenbogen und ein Umfeld ohne Callcenter-Druck.

  • Nur eingehende Anfragen
    Du rufst niemanden unaufgefordert an und verschickst keine ungefragten E-Mails. Du betreust ausschließlich Menschen, die sich selbst bei uns gemeldet haben und Hilfe suchen.
  • Kein Callcenter-Feeling
    Bei uns gibt es keine Fließbandgespräche, keine starren Skripte und kein anonymes Großraumbüro. Du arbeitest in einem überschaubaren Team mit eigenem Arbeitsplatz und kurzen Wegen, auch zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Digitale Tools statt Zettelwirtschaft
    Wir arbeiten digital und mit System, zum Beispiel mit HubSpot. Keine Excel-Listen und keine Zettel, sondern durchdachte Prozesse, die dir die Arbeit erleichtern.
  • Faires Gehalt & Sicherheit
    Wir schätzen deine Arbeit mit einer fairen, guten Bezahlung und geben dir mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag eine langfristige Perspektive.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Du unterstützt Menschen dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Am Ende des Tages weißt du, dass du vielen eine Sorge abgenommen hast.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und ein leistungsstarker Laptop, egal ob MacBook oder Windows.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Zentrale Lage, sehr gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt um die Ecke. Dazu ein Innenhof für die Pause und ein eigener Fitnessraum im Haus, kostenlos und jederzeit zugänglich.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Ellenbogenmentalität gibt es bei uns nicht, dafür echte Wertschätzung im Alltag und Events wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder Halloween-Sause. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin mit Massagen und kleinen Auszeiten für Entspannung.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice (w/m/d) bist du für viele Mandant:innen die erste Stimme von Migrando. Du beantwortest Fragen, gibst Orientierung und sorgst dafür, dass sich niemand mit seinem Anliegen allein gelassen fühlt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle über alle Kanäle
    Ob Telefon, Ticketsystem oder Social Media: Du hilfst schnell und freundlich weiter, egal wo die Anfrage reinkommt.
  • Fragen rund um die Einbürgerung beantworten
    Du gibst Auskunft zu unseren Leistungen und erklärst, wie der Weg zum deutschen Pass bei uns abläuft.
  • Statusauskünfte zum Verfahren
    Du schaust im System nach, wo ein Vorgang gerade steht, und erklärst den nächsten Schritt so, dass ihn auch jemand ohne Fachwissen versteht.
  • Zuhören und verständlich erklären
    Viele unserer Mandant:innen lernen gerade erst Deutsch. Du hörst nicht nur, was gefragt wird, sondern erkennst, was dahintersteckt, findest Worte, die ankommen, und erklärst auch gern ein zweites Mal.
  • Termine und Rückrufe
    Du stimmst Rückrufe und Gesprächstermine ab und behältst im Blick, wer wann eine Rückmeldung erwartet.
  • Nachforderung fehlender Unterlagen
    Du erinnerst freundlich an offene Dokumente und erklärst, warum sie gebraucht werden.
  • Saubere Dokumentation
    Du hältst fest, was besprochen wurde, inklusive Rückmeldungen, Beschwerden und Lösungen. So haben alle Kolleg:innen den gleichen Stand.
  • Schnittstelle zur Sachbearbeitung und zum Anwaltsteam
    Wenn eine Frage tiefer geht, leitest du sie mit dem nötigen Kontext weiter und sorgst dafür, dass niemand zweimal dasselbe erzählen muss.
  • Umgang mit Beschwerden und Unmut
    Wenn jemand ungeduldig oder enttäuscht ist, bleibst du ruhig, nimmst das Anliegen ernst und findest gemeinsam eine Lösung.
  • Muster erkennen und Verbesserungen anstoßen
    Wenn dieselbe Frage ständig kommt, sagst du Bescheid. Daraus bauen wir bessere Infos, damit das Problem gar nicht erst entsteht.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern wie du mit Menschen umgehst und wie du arbeitest. Rechtliche Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, die Hintergründe zur Einbürgerung und unsere Systeme lernst du in der Einarbeitung kennen.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen
    Du hast schon in einem Job mit viel direktem Kontakt zu Menschen gearbeitet, ob im Kundenservice, im Einzelhandel, in der Gastronomie, im Hotel oder in der Beratung, und weißt, wie es ist, den ganzen Tag im Gespräch zu sein.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
    Deutsch ist dein tägliches Arbeitswerkzeug, am Telefon wie schriftlich. Alle weiteren Sprachen sind ein echtes Plus.
  • Klare, einfache Kommunikation
    Du kannst komplizierte Sachverhalte so erklären, dass sie auch ohne Vorwissen verständlich sind.
  • Empathie und interkulturelle Offenheit
    Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Ländern und Lebenslagen und begegnest allen auf Augenhöhe.
  • Geduld und Ruhe
    Manche Fragen kommen zum dritten Mal, und manchmal ist jemand verärgert. Für dich ist das kein Problem: Du bleibst sachlich, freundlich und gelassen.
  • Zuverlässigkeit und Struktur
    Du behältst den Überblick, auch wenn viele Anfragen gleichzeitig reinkommen, vergisst keine Rückmeldung und dokumentierst sorgfältig, weil davon die Arbeit deiner Kolleg:innen abhängt.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem PC
    E-Mail, Telefon und digitale Tools sind für dich Alltag. Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen oder CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot ist ein Plus.
  • Diskretion
    Du gehst mit sensiblen Daten verantwortungsvoll um. Verschwiegenheit ist für dich selbstverständlich.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Network Production Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

JEDI steht für Gerechtigkeit, Chancengerechtigkeit, Vielfalt und Inklusion (= Justice, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion). Wir verstehen diese Prinzipien als Grundlage unseres alltäglichen Handelns – sowohl intern beim Recruiting und innerhalb unserer Arbeitsabläufe, als auch gegenüber unseren Kund*innen und der Gesellschaft. Im Arbeitsalltag orientieren wir uns an unseren vier “Core Values”. Sie geben ganz klar vor, wie wir als Individuen und im Team miteinander arbeiten wollen:

Wir entwickeln und betreiben moderne Softwarelösungen für den Automobilhandel. Unsere Anwendungen und Webseiten unterstützen Händler bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und der Vermarktung ihrer Fahrzeugbestände.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen PHP / Joomla Entwickler (m/w/d), der Freude daran hat, professionelle Webprojekte technisch umzusetzen, kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und langfristig zu betreuen.

Dabei arbeitest du sowohl an der Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP und Joomla als auch an der Umsetzung moderner, responsiver Benutzeroberflächen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Joomla-Webprojekten: Du entwickelst, betreust und optimierst bestehende sowie neue Webseiten auf Basis des Content-Management-Systems Joomla.
  • Entwicklung individueller Joomla-Erweiterungen: Du konzipierst und implementierst eigene Joomla-Module, Plugins und bei Bedarf weitere Erweiterungen und integrierst diese in bestehende Projekte.
  • Frontend-Entwicklung: Du setzt vorgegebene Designs und Layouts mit HTML, CSS und JavaScript technisch präzise um und sorgst für eine responsive, performante und benutzerfreundliche Darstellung.
  • Template-Entwicklung und -Anpassung: Du entwickelst und individualisierst Joomla-Templates und stellst eine konsistente Darstellung auf unterschiedlichen Endgeräten sicher.
  • Anbindung externer Systeme: Du integrierst externe Dienste und Datenquellen über Schnittstellen, insbesondere REST-APIs, und entwickelst bei Bedarf eigene Schnittstellenanbindungen.
  • Wartung und Qualitätssicherung: Du übernimmst die technische Pflege bestehender Webseiten, führst Updates durch, analysierst Fehler und sorgst für einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb.
  • Versionsverwaltung und Dokumentation: Du arbeitest strukturiert mit Git, dokumentierst technische Lösungen nachvollziehbar und achtest auf eine saubere, wartbare Codebasis.
  • Technische Optimierung: Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die Performance, Sicherheit, Barrierefreiheit und technische Qualität unserer Webprojekte.

Das bringst du mit

Deine fachlichen Qualifikationen

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Joomla: Du hast bereits eigenständig Joomla-Projekte entwickelt und betreut und kennst dich mit der Architektur, dem Template-System sowie der Entwicklung und Integration von Erweiterungen aus.
  • Sehr gute PHP-Kenntnisse: Du beherrschst PHP sicher und verfügst über Erfahrung in der objektorientierten Programmierung sowie im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, insbesondere MySQL/MariaDB.
  • Sehr gute Frontend-Kenntnisse: HTML5, CSS3 und JavaScript gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug. Du kannst Designvorgaben eigenständig in hochwertige, responsive Webseiten umsetzen.
  • Erfahrung mit APIs: Du hast bereits REST-Schnittstellen angebunden und bist mit JSON, HTTP und gängigen Authentifizierungsverfahren vertraut.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git: Versionsverwaltung und strukturierte Entwicklungsprozesse sind für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Qualitätsbewusstsein: Du legst Wert auf gut strukturierten, wartbaren und dokumentierten Code.
  • Verständnis für Webstandards: Du kennst die Grundlagen moderner Webentwicklung hinsichtlich Performance, Sicherheit, Responsivität und Browserkompatibilität.

Das wäre zusätzlich von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit aktuellen Joomla-Versionen und der Migration bestehender Installationen.
  • Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung eigener Joomla-Komponenten und komplexerer Erweiterungen.
  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Composer und modernen PHP-Entwicklungswerkzeugen.
  • Erfahrung mit Linux-basierten Webservern und gängigen Hosting-Umgebungen.
  • Grundkenntnisse in technischer Suchmaschinenoptimierung (SEO) und Web-Barrierefreiheit (WCAG).

So arbeitest du

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du …

  • gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitest und technische Aufgaben selbstständig löst.
  • ein gutes Auge für Details hast und Wert auf eine saubere Umsetzung von Designvorgaben legst.
  • sowohl Backend- als auch Frontend-Aufgaben mit Freude übernimmst.
  • bestehende Lösungen nicht nur wartest, sondern auch Verbesserungspotenziale erkennst.
  • strukturiert arbeitest und deine Lösungen für andere Entwickler nachvollziehbar dokumentierst.
  • gerne im Team arbeitest und dich mit Kollegen über technische Lösungen austauschst.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Abwechslungsreiche Webprojekte: Du arbeitest an professionellen Webseiten und digitalen Lösungen für den Automobilhandel.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, technische Lösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und eigene Ideen einzubringen.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Dich erwartet eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit vielseitigen Entwicklungsaufgaben.
  • Moderne Entwicklungsprozesse: Wir setzen auf strukturierte Zusammenarbeit, Versionsverwaltung und nachhaltige Softwareentwicklung.
  • Ein kollegiales Entwicklerteam: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Kollegen zusammen und profitierst vom gemeinsamen technischen Austausch.
  • Raum für Weiterentwicklung: Du kannst deine Kenntnisse vertiefen und dich fachlich und technologisch weiterentwickeln.

Interesse geweckt?

Du hast Erfahrung mit Joomla, fühlst dich in PHP genauso wohl wie in HTML, CSS und JavaScript und möchtest anspruchsvolle Webprojekte langfristig mitgestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb dich bei uns und werde Teil unseres Entwicklungsteams.

So bringen wir die Wärmewende direkt in den Gebäudebestand – schnell, skalierbar und ohne klassischen Sanierungsaufwand oder Investitionsrisiko für unsere Kunden.

Deine Mission wird es, Sanitär-, Heizungs- und Klimaanlagen im Bestand so zu planen und auszulegen, dass sie wirtschaftlich, genehmigungsfähig und termingerecht umsetzbar sind. Dabei verbindest du TGA-Planung, Wärmepumpenauslegung, Ausführungsplanung und Schnittstellenmanagement mit einer pragmatischen, hands-on Arbeitsweise.

Klingt nach dir? Dann starte bei uns als

Planer TGA (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt SHK in Mannheim

Planung & Systemauslegung SHK

Erfahrung & Methoden

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role:
We are looking for a platform engineer / developer experience engineer to improve the systems that help our engineering team move quickly and safely.

This is a hands-on role spanning build systems, CI, testing infrastructure, dependency and vulnerability management, and internal developer tooling. The engineer will combine operational ownership with deeper system improvement: keeping critical processes reliable while identifying and removing recurring sources of friction.

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent debugging instincts, and a genuine interest in building tools and workflows for other engineers. They understand that an internal platform is a product: solutions must be reliable, ergonomic, well documented, and easy to adopt.

Candidates do not need prior ownership of every area in the role. We value broad engineering judgment, curiosity, and demonstrated interest in improving developer productivity over narrow specialization.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning and maintaining build systems, CI pipelines, testing infrastructure and internal tooling to keep engineering workflows reliable and efficient

  • Helping and enabling other engineers by identifying recurring sources of friction and designing and implementing solutions to remove them

  • Vulnerability and dependency management

  • Reviewing code and contributing to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer or Developer Experience Engineer

  • Are proficient in at least two of the following: build systems, continuous integration, testing, observability, dependency and vulnerability management, release workflows or internal tooling

  • Are comfortable working with Python tooling and packaging, including dependency management and the broader Python developer ecosystem

  • Have a genuine interest in building tools and processes that help other engineers move faster

  • Have strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent debugging instincts

  • Bring broad engineering judgment and curiosity

  • (Nice to have) Experience with tooling, packaging, and dependency management in JavaScript, Rust, Go or other language ecosystems

  • (Nice to have) Experience working with Kubernetes, including deploying services and debugging running workloads

What you can look forward to:

  • Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

  • Collaborative and supportive work environment

  • Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.
