title: Portfolio Commercial Director
descriptionHtml:
WOULD YOU LIKE TO BE PART OF A FAST - GROWING ORGANISATION?

JOIN US AS AREA COMMERCIAL DIRECTOR!

ABOUT ODYSSEY

We're The Odyssey Hotel Group, Europe’s most ambitious hotel operator and the team behind many famous global hospitality names. We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop exceptional properties across various brands, from Holiday Express to Marriott's Autograph collection. Powered by over 800 employees and supported by Activum SG as our major shareholder, our purpose is to shape hospitality together!

ABOUT POSITION

The Portfolio Commercial Director is responsible for the overall commercial performance of a blended portfolio of full service hotels, strongly MICE driven hotels in key markets in Germany.

This role holds end-to-end accountability for commercial strategy and execution, covering Sales, Revenue Management, Distribution, and Marketing, with a strong focus on sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability, while ensuring alignment with owner expectations and long-term asset value creation.

As a senior commercial leader, the role acts as a trusted advisor to hotel owners and asset managers, delivering transparent, data-driven insights and ensuring that all commercial strategies support both short-term performance and long-term financial returns.

The position operates within a matrix organisation, partnering closely with Operations, Finance, and commercial discipline leaders to drive integrated commercial strategies across the portfolio.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute hotel-level commercial strategies aligned with overall business goals.

• Lead forecasting and budgeting processes to ensure accurate financial planning and performance tracking.

• Drive commercial initiatives at both the hotel and country levels to maximize total hotel revenue opportunities.

• Executive report on results and present business analytics to internal and external stakeholders.

• Act as primary commercial liaison with Hotel Operations, ensuring alignment between commercial and operational priorities.

• Oversee account management and achieving sales targets, maintaining strong customer and partner relationships.

• Manage pricing and inventory strategy, ensuring optimal yield and market competitiveness.

• Develop, manage, and recruit commercial team members, in close cooperation with the relevant commercial disciplinary leader, to build strong regional capabilities and performance.

• Lead structured owner communication, including monthly and quarterly reviews, clearly articulating performance drivers, risks, and opportunities

HOW YOU WILL DO IT

• Building strong and trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, Hotel Managers, and internal stakeholders.

• Applying sound commercial judgement and data-driven decision-making to drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability.

• Translating complex commercial performance data into clear business insights and actionable strategies.

• Aligning Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations around common business objectives.

• Proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and market trends and adapting commercial strategies accordingly.

• Providing clear direction, coaching, and support to commercial teams, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

• Influencing stakeholders at all levels through effective communication, collaboration, and executive presence.

• Maintaining a strong focus on owner satisfaction, long-term asset value creation, and sustainable business growth.

• Ensuring commercial excellence through structured planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and continuous improvement.

• Balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver measurable business results.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 5-8+ years of experience in hotel commercial leadership, across Sales, Revenue Management, or Commercial Operations

  • Proven experience in multi-property / regional roles

  • Strong track record in driving revenue growth, market share, and profitability

  • Deep expertise in:

    • Revenue Management (pricing, forecasting, distribution)

    • Commercial strategy and demand generation

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with hotel owners, asset managers, or investors

  • Strong analytical capability with ability to translate data into strategic insights

  • Experience presenting budgets, forecasts, and performance to senior stakeholders

  • Proven leadership in building and managing high-performing teams

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation

  • Results-driven mindset with focus on asset value and long-term performance

  • Full professional fluency in English and German (written and spoken)

What do we offer

  • A competitive salary with bonus plan

  • Holiday & Christmas bonus after 6 months

  • laptop, phone and appropriate travel compensation depending of what fits your needs

  • A diverse, multicultural, and dynamic work environment

  • Respective of your work scope, discounted stays at large branded hotels worldwide such as Marriott, IHG and all Odyssey properties

  • 30 vacation days from day one for a healthy work-life balance

  • Access to a health card to reimburse health related invoices - Health insurance card with €300 annual budget

  • Access to “Corporate Benefits” discounts

  • Ongoing training, personal growth opportunities, and priority access to internal vacancies.

  • €500 net referral bonus for new hires

title: PR Teamlead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40-köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und will mehr.

Als PR Teamlead bist du nicht nur senior in deiner eigenen PR-Expertise, sondern gibst dein Wissen weiter, entwickelst erfahrene PR-Köpfe und Nachwuchstalente und trägst Verantwortung für ein wachsendes Kundenportfolio.

Bist du dabei?

Deine Rolle

Als Teamlead arbeitest du nicht mehr selbst operativ auf Kund*innen, sondern ausschließlich über dein Team – dein Impact entsteht durch gute Führung, nicht durch eigene Pitches.

  • Teamentwicklung: Du bist Vorbild und Fels in der Brandung. Mit weekly 1:1s, regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und individuellen Entwicklungsplänen erkennst du Stärken und Entwicklungspotenziale. Du entwickelst deine Teammitglieder individuell, vom Junior bis zum Senior.
  • Kundenportfolio: Du hast den Überblick über den Status aller Kund*innen im Team, bist strategische Ansprechperson auf Entscheiderebene und erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, ebenso wie Upsell-Potenziale und Wachstumschancen. So sorgst du langfristig für ein gesundes Portfolio in deinem Team.
  • Unternehmerisches Handeln: Dein Team ist eine kleine unternehmerische Einheit innerhalb von getpress: Du triffst strategische Entscheidungen auf Basis von KPIs und steuerst Team- und Kundenplanung. Dabei bist du nicht scheu, Entscheidungen zu treffen, zu priorisieren und zu delegieren.
  • Sales & Recruiting: Du arbeitest punktuell eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, etwa bei Neukund*innenpitches. Genauso eng arbeitest du mit People & Culture zusammen, wenn es um Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Onboarding und Recruiting geht.
  • Struktur & Qualität: Du baust Prozesse, die dein Team wirklich braucht, basierend auf den Bedürfnissen, die du erkennst. Du sorgst für gemeinsame Routinen, begleitest das Onboarding und trägst die Verantwortung für die Qualitätssicherung im Team.

Wer du bist

  • Du bringst über 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR mit (idealerweise im Agenturumfeld) und hast selbst Kund*innen aus dem Mittelstand und vergleichbaren Unternehmensgrößen direkt betreut, weiterentwickelt und nachweislich in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. Diese Erfahrung ist deine Basis.
  • Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und weiterentwickelt, disziplinarisch wie fachlich. Idealerweise hast du schon Change-Prozesse begleitet und weißt, wie man ein Team sicher durch Phasen des Wandels führt.
  • Du bringst erprobte Führungsskills, eine hohe emotionale Intelligenz und ein ehrliches Interesse für Menschen und ihre Entwicklung mit.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Geschäftsstrategien. KPIs nutzt du bewusst und regelmäßig, um daraus strategische Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du bist Kommunikator*in durch und durch – im Team hörst du zu und nimmst Menschen mit; extern kommunizierst du souverän mit Kund*innen und Stakeholdern über Hierarchieebenen hinweg, vom CEO bis zum Marketing-Ansprechpartner.
  • Der Einsatz von KI in der PR-Arbeit ist für dich gelebter Alltag, keine Theorie. Du bist neugierig, testest aus, was möglich ist und teilst dein Wissen im Team.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland.

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte PR-Arbeit. Bei uns geht es um echte Pressearbeit, individuell und zielgerichtet. Keine Standard-Pressemitteilungen, sondern individuelles Pitchen bei Journalist*innen in einer breiten Range an Medien.
  • Optimismus. Wir glauben, dass man aus Fehlern lernt und dass eine optimistische Grundhaltung den Unterschied macht. Das merkt man nicht nur in unserem Daily Doing, sondern auch bei spontanen Coffee-Talks oder unseren regelmäßigen Teamevents, ob digital oder vor Ort.
  • Impact. Wir haben hohe Standards an unsere eigene Arbeit, aber auch an die Unternehmen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten. Vor allem in Europa gibt es mehr Hidden Champions als sichtbare Erfolgsgeschichten. Das ist die Lücke, die wir schließen wollen.
  • Sparring. Du stehst nie alleine da: Regelmäßiges Sparring gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Mit deiner eigenen Führungskraft, unserer Head of PR, ebenso wie mit anderen Teamleads, dem C-Level oder People & Culture, je nachdem, welches Thema gerade ansteht.
  • Perspektive. Auch als Teamlead lernt man nicht aus. Wir planen langfristig und wollen deine persönliche Entwicklung fördern. Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, und mit unserem Wachstum wächst auch der Raum, dein Wissen einzubringen und mit uns zu lernen. Etwa indem du uns bei Projekten oder der Entwicklung neuer Services unterstützt.
  • Flexibilität. Wir arbeiten hybrid, remote (in DE) oder im Office. Wir haben zwar Kernerreichbarkeitszeiten, aber wann du arbeitest, entscheidest du abgestimmt auf die Bedürfnisse von Team und Kund*innen. Vertrauen, Eigenständigkeit und Kommunikation sind für uns das A und O und sorgen dafür, dass wir Job und Privatleben gut miteinander vereinen können.
  • Benefits und Sweet Treats. Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren, 180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen, aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu.

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!'', dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams!

title: Praktikant (m/w/d) – Produktentwicklung & Datenaufbereitung
descriptionHtml:
CERTUSS beschäftigt über 150 Mitarbeitende in Deutschland, Großbritannien und den USA und ist mit seinen Dampferzeugern in mehr als 90 Branchen weltweit vertreten. Besonders im Gesundheitswesen, der Chemie-, Pharma- und Automobilindustrie sowie der Hotellerie und Lebensmittelbranche leisten unsere Produkte einen wichtigen Beitrag – von der Automobilfertigung bis zur Sterilisation in Krankenhäusern.

Ab sofort bieten wir engagierten Studierenden einen Pflichtpraktikumsplatz im Bereich unserer Produktentwicklung an. Während deines Praktikums erhältst du vielfältige Einblicke in den spannenden Fachbereich unseres Unternehmens, in dem Produkte für eine nachhaltige Zukunft entwickelt und überarbeitet werden und sammelst praktische Erfahrungen in einem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsumfeld. Du arbeitest an realen Aufgaben mit, bekommst ein Gefühl für verschiedene Schnittstellen und lernst unterschiedliche Perspektiven kennen.

Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Einblick und Unterstützung in einem innovativen Unternehmen in Hard- und Softwareentwicklung mit einem Schwerpunkt der Datenaufbereitung (Stammdaten, Prozessdaten)

  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und die Möglichkeit, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Ein motiviertes Team, das Dich unterstützt und dir wertvolle Erfahrungen vermittelt

  • Bei uns übernimmst Du schnell Verantwortung für Deine Themen und stehst im Austausch mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern

  • Deine Ideen sind willkommen – wir fördern Dein Engagement für bessere Prozesse


Dein Profil:

  • Du bist hochmotiviert und möchtest etwas bewegen

  • Eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Mechatronik, Produktentwicklung im Maschinenbau, Datenanalyse, Datenmanagement, Technische Kommunikation, Technisches Informationsdesign oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Das Praktikum ist Teil Deines Studiums (Pflichtpraktikum)

  • Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kannst aber auch Aufgaben eigenverantwortlich und selbstständig vorantreiben

  • Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und ein gutes analytisches Denkvermögen

  • Als Praktikant (m/w/d) unterstützt Du uns für mindestens 3 Monate

title: Prescriptions Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Montu, every department plays an important role in delivering exceptional patient care. From our clinical and pharmacy teams to the people working behind the scenes, we all share the same goal of ensuring our patients receive the care, treatment and support they need.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Coordinator, to join our Operations team at Kings Cross. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference.

With thousands of patients relying on our service, getting the little things right really does matter. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of a team that is helping to shape the future of medical cannabis in the UK.

This is a full-time, working 40 hours per week.

 

About the Role

As a Prescription Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting our patients, clinicians and pharmacy teams, helping to ensure prescriptions are managed accurately and efficiently throughout the patient journey.

Working as part of our busy Operations team, you will be responsible for maintaining patient records, responding to enquiries, coordinating with internal and external teams and ensuring patients are kept informed about their prescriptions.

This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are quite the same. You will need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and patient care.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Responding to patient enquiries via telephone and email, providing a friendly, professional and helpful service.

  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic patient records and prescription information.

  • Working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to ensure prescriptions are processed efficiently and medication reaches patients without unnecessary delays.

  • Keeping patients informed of any changes or updates relating to their prescriptions.

  • Liaising with external pharmacy partners to ensure prescriptions are received, dispensed and delivered correctly.

  • Supporting our clinicians with day-to-day operational queries and ensuring they have the information they need.

  • Assisting with operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities when required.

  • Recording and escalating patient feedback, complaints, incidents and significant events in line with company procedures.

  • Working with our Governance team to ensure concerns are appropriately documented and addressed.

  • Liaising with our Product and Technology teams to help resolve technical issues affecting patients or clinicians.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes and working collaboratively with colleagues to make our service even better.

  • Maintaining compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures and mandatory training.

  • Supporting the wider team with operational activities and attending relevant meetings as required.

  • Demonstrating flexibility to support shift-based working when required.

     

What You Will Need

  • At least two years of experience in an administrative, customer service or operational role.

  • Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

  • Strong communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner.

  • A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others.

  • Good IT skills and the confidence to learn new systems and technology.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, compliance and following established procedures.

  • A proactive, adaptable attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to the continued improvement of our service.

     

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension contribution

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

  • The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business in an exciting and evolving area of healthcare

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued

     

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK.

Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support.

title: Principal Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We're hiring a Principal Compliance Associate to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.

 

The opportunity

  • Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

  • Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

  • Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

  • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

  • Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

  

What you bring

  • Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires.

  • Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply.

  

Nice to haves

  • E-comms surveillance experience.

  

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Principal Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:

The Team:

We believe great UX is not just about usability, it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.
As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows, from search to synthesis to decision-making. Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role:
We are seeking a Principal Design Engineer to play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a senior individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through craft, systems thinking, and technical excellence, building AI-powered experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and essential to our customers’ workflows.
You will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, and product strategy, translating complex, data-rich problems into high-quality, production-ready experiences. You won’t just prototype ideas; you’ll define how they are built, scaled, and experienced in the product.
As a senior member of the Design team, you’ll act as a multiplier—mentoring others, guiding technical and design decisions, and strengthening the connection between user needs, business goals, and engineering realities.

Why this role matters
At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make decisions.
In this role, you will help define that standard—through the systems you build, the experiences you ship, and the team you help elevate.

What You’ll Do

  • Create high-fidelity, coded prototypes and interaction models that bring complex, AI-powered workflows to life and clearly communicate product direction.
  • Own high-impact initiatives from concept through production, shipping experiences that reflect strong design thinking, technical rigor, and a deep understanding of customer workflows.
  • Lead technical design discussions, make architectural decisions, and guide cross-team implementation efforts.
  • Advance AlphaSense’s design system as a core piece of product infrastructure—defining scalable patterns, enabling consistency, and accelerating teams building across AI-native experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to research and evaluate user requirements, translate them into effective designs, and ensure that the final product meets both user and business needs.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams during development, advocating for design quality and user experience by championing design fidelity and attention to detail throughout the development lifecycle.
Design Leadership & Team Impact
  • Act as a senior leader within the Design team, mentoring designers and engineers, raising the bar for craft, and contributing to a strong, collaborative design culture.
  • Serve as connective tissue across design, product, and engineering—helping teams navigate tradeoffs between technical constraints, business goals, and user experience to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Who You Are

  • 12+ years of experience in product design, design/UX/front-end engineering, design systems, or a related discipline.
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher. A degree in design, computer science, information sciences, psychology, or human-computer interaction is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with modern front-end technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React) and evolving design systems.
  • Experience building AI and agentic experiences, and you are already leveraging AI to speed up and augment your end-to-end design and development process.
  • Expertise with modern AI technologies and ability to apply them to design problems (e.g., MCP, Claude Code, Codex, Skills).
  • Experience shipping production-ready experiences and influencing technical and design choices across teams.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, end-to-end customer workflows, and the ability to turn new users into habitual users.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in project leadership, mentorship, and providing constructive feedback to foster professional growth.

title: Principal Research Scientist - AI Safety
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Faculty conducts critical red teaming and builds evaluations for misuse capabilities in sensitive areas, such as CBRN, cybersecurity and international security, for several leading frontier model developers and national safety institutes; notably, our work has been featured in OpenAI's system card for o1.

Our commitment also extends to conducting fundamental technical research on mitigation strategies, with our findings published in peer-reviewed conferences and delivered to national security institutes. Complementing this, we design evaluations for model developers across broader safety-relevant fields, including the societal impacts of increasingly capable frontier models, showcasing our expertise across the safety landscape.

About the role

The Principal Research Scientist for AI Safety will be the driving force behind Faculty's small, high-agency research team, shaping the future of safe AI systems. You will lead the scientific research agenda for AI safety, focusing on large language models and other critical systems. This role involves leading researchers, driving external publications, and ensuring alignment with Faculty’s commercial ambition to build trustworthy AI, giving you the opportunity to make a high-impact contribution in a rapidly evolving, critical field.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading the AI safety team's ambitious research agenda, setting priorities aligned with long-term company goals.

  • Conducting and overseeing cutting-edge AI safety research, specifically for large language models and safety-critical AI systems.

  • Publishing high-impact research findings in leading academic conferences and journals.

  • Shaping the research agenda by identifying impactful opportunities and balancing scientific and practical priorities.

  • Helping to build and mentor a growing team of researchers, fostering an innovative and collaborative culture.

  • Collaborating on delivery of evaluations and red-teaming projects in high-risk domains like CBRN and cybersecurity.

  • Positioning Faculty as a thought leader in AI safety through research and strategic stakeholder engagement.

Who we're looking for:

  • You have a proven track record of high-impact AI research, demonstrated through top-tier academic publications or equivalent experience.

  • You possess deep domain knowledge in language models and the evolving field of AI safety.

  • You exhibit strong research judgment and extensive experience in AI safety, including generating and executing novel research directions.

  • You have the ability to conduct and oversee complex technical research projects, with advanced programming skills (Python, standard data science stack) to review team work.

  • You bring excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of sharing complex ideas with diverse audiences.

  • You have a deep understanding of the AI safety research landscape and the ability to build connections to secure resources for impactful work.

    Our Interview Process

    1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

    2. Experience & Theory interview (45 mins)

    3. Research presentation and coding interview (75 mins)

    4. Leadership and Principles interview (60 mins)

    5. Final stage with our CEO (45 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Product Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.

About the role

You will own how customers experience Agent F, from landing pages and product demonstrations through onboarding and migration to the work they do every day. A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. Both should understand where they are, what a number means and what to do next.

This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering. You will talk to customers, shape the journey, design the interactions and ship them in the product. You will use AI coding agents to help implement changes, and take responsibility for reviewing the code and checking the finished experience.

Your work will connect the product into a coherent whole: consistent navigation, familiar controls and clear explanations across features. You will also own the steps that turn an interested visitor into an active, paying customer.

What you will build and improve

  • An engaging path from first interest to a useful result. Connect landing pages and product demonstrations to sign-up, account setup and the first session so a customer understands what to provide and what they will get back. Measure where people abandon the process and address the causes.

  • A migration experience people can follow. Help customers bring in their history from accounting software or spreadsheets. Make upload progress, missing information, validation errors and next steps understandable.

  • A consistent product experience. Develop the design language, navigation and reusable components used across the product. Make tables, forms and reports behave predictably, including loading, empty and error states.

  • Useful decision screens. Design views that help customers compare recommendations, understand costs and choose what happens next. Our planned evidence board brings this information together as customers describe their needs.

  • Interfaces that earn trust. Help users see where a figure came from, understand a proposed change and review it before approval. Include accessibility, keyboard use and clear language in the implementation.

  • Improvements grounded in actual use. Keep up with the customer pipeline, from interested prospects to customers onboarding or migrating. Observe customer sessions and work with the customer-facing team. Turn recurring questions into product changes, then check whether those changes helped.

For example, a customer uploads a file and sees a different total from the one they expected. You would design the journey that explains what was imported, what needs checking and how to resolve the difference, working with the data engineer on the underlying evidence.

What you bring

You have five or more years of experience designing and shipping software, including business-to-business software sold as a service (B2B SaaS). You may come from product design with strong engineering skills, or from front-end engineering with substantial design ownership.

You can show a product journey you improved, explain the choices you made and describe the effect on customers. You have owned an onboarding, activation or conversion measure: whether people got started, reached a useful result or became paying customers.

Core experience

  • Product design across information architecture, interaction design and visual design.

  • Production front-end work with React, TypeScript, CSS and reusable components, including reviewing and debugging code generated by agents.

  • Building or maintaining a design system that other people use.

  • Customer research, usability testing and product analytics that inform what you ship.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents, with a clear approach to specifications, review and verification.

  • Clear written explanations of design decisions and their trade-offs.

Useful additional experience

Financial software, complex tables and dashboards, or products where people need to inspect the source of a result. Experience with configuration-driven interfaces, where shared rules and data determine how a screen is assembled, would also be useful.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would map the main customer journeys, establish a baseline for onboarding and conversion, and ship an improvement to a step where customers regularly get stuck. Alongside that, you would start consolidating repeated interface patterns into reusable components.

We would look for evidence that customers reach a useful result sooner, complete more of the journey independently and need less help with the interface. The exact priorities will follow the customer needs you find with the team.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a product customers can depend on under pressure. When sign-up, migration or a critical financial workflow breaks, you step in, establish what the customer needs and work with the team to restore a safe path forward. A misleading balance, missing transaction or incorrect status can be a financial emergency even when the page loads normally. You make the problem visible, help contain its impact and verify the complete customer journey after a fix.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role in a small team, with scope to shape product decisions and engineering practice. You will work closely with the engineers responsible for platform operations and customer data. You will carry work from customer observation through implementation and release, then follow up on how it performs.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole product and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and in-person in Berlin. German is not required.

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Projektleiter Bau (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Padel ein magischer Sport ist – einer, der Menschen durch seine einzigartige Kombination aus Leichtigkeit, Dynamik und sozialer Interaktion begeistert. Padel ist für alle da: von Jung bis Alt, vom Anfänger bis zum Profi – jeder kann an dieser Leidenschaft teilhaben. Es ist mehr als nur ein Spiel; es ist ein Erlebnis, das verbindet, Freude bereitet und Freundschaften schafft.

mitte ist ein Boutique Padel Club, der erstklassige Spielbedingungen und ein stilvolles Umfeld für unsere dynamische, moderne Community bietet. Unsere Clubs kombinieren hochwertige Einrichtung in zentralen innerstädtischen Standorten mit digitaler Innovation und menschlicher Wärme, um Padel zu einem festen Bestandteil des Alltags zu machen – sei es für ein schnelles Spiel oder als „Third Place“ für verschiedenste Erlebnisse.

Was uns besonders macht:

  • Unsere Indoor-Clubs sind so gelegen, dass man sie in unter 15 Minuten erreichen kann – ideal für den urbanen Alltag
  • Unsere vollautomatisierten Systeme sorgen für ein reibungsloses, modernes Spielerlebnis
  • Unsere Community Leader leben Gastfreundschaft und hospitality-like Betreuung und widmen sich voll und ganz der Aufgabe, hervorragende Gastgeber zu sein
  • Unser Interior Design stammt von einem renommierten Boutique-Architekten

Unsere Ambition: Die globale Brand für Premium Padel zu werden.

Aufgaben

Als Projektleiter Bau (m/w/d) verantwortest du die bauliche Realisierung unserer Clubs vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem internen Architekten, externen Designpartnern, Fachplanern und ausführenden Gewerken zusammen und stellst sicher, dass jeder neue Club in Zeit, Budget und Qualität entsteht.

Dein Ziel: eine reibungslose Bauausführung über mehrere Standorte parallel – mit dem Anspruch, dass jeder neue Club schneller, präziser und besser wird als der vorherige.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Bauliche Projektsteuerung: Du verantwortest die Bauausführung mehrerer Standorte parallel – von der Vergabe über die Bauüberwachung bis zur Abnahme.
  • Bauüberwachung vor Ort: Du überwachst die Bauausführung, führst Abnahmen durch, dokumentierst den Fortschritt und stellst die Einhaltung von Kosten, Terminen und Qualität sicher.
  • Vergabe & Gewerke-Koordination: Du verantwortest den Vergabeprozess, formulierst und adaptierst Leistungsverzeichnisse aus unseren Standards, wertest Angebote aus und triffst fundierte Vergabeentscheidungen.
  • Schnittstellen-Management: Du koordinierst die Schnittstellen zwischen unserem internen Architekten, MAG Design, Fachplanern und ausführenden Gewerken – und sorgst dafür, dass der mitte-Standard in jedem Detail umgesetzt wird.
  • Mängelmanagement & Gewährleistung: Du begleitest die Mängelbeseitigung nach Fertigstellung und sicherst die Gewährleistungsverfolgung.
  • Skalierbare Standards: Du entwickelst die baulichen Module – von Fit-out bis Touch-up – kontinuierlich weiter und standardisierst sie, um Skaleneffekte zu erreichen und Bauzeiten zu reduzieren.
  • Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest eng mit Architektur, Investment und Launch zusammen und stellst sicher, dass jeder Club rechtzeitig und in mitte-Qualität zur Eröffnung bereitsteht.

Das Besondere an dieser Rolle ist, dass…

  • du den baulichen Skalierungs-Motor von mitte verantwortest – jeder Club, den du in Betrieb bringst, ist ein Stück Unternehmensentwicklung.
  • du echte Multi-Projekt-Verantwortung trägst – nicht eine Baustelle, sondern viele parallel.
  • du an der Schnittstelle von Bau, Design und Operator-Geschäft arbeitest – mit dem Anspruch, dass das Ergebnis nicht nur funktioniert, sondern Premium-Qualität hat.
  • du an einem skalierbaren Bau-Playbook mitbaust – damit jeder neue Club schneller und besser entsteht als der vorherige.

Qualifikation

  • Bauliche Tiefe: Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der baulichen Projektsteuerung – mit Schwerpunkt auf den Leistungsphasen 5–9 HOAI.
  • Multi-Projekt-Erfahrung: Du hast nachweislich mehrere Bauprojekte parallel gesteuert – nicht eine Baustelle nach der anderen.
  • Branchenerfahrung: Hospitality-, Retail-, Gastronomie- oder Premium-Innenausbau-Erfahrung ist präferiert, aber kein K.o.-Kriterium – wichtiger ist Multi-Projekt-Steuerung mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
  • Vergabe: Du bist sicher in der Vergabe, formulierst belastbare Leistungsverzeichnisse.
  • Gewerke-Koordination: Du kannst Architekten, Fachplaner TGA, Brandschutz, Tragwerk und ausführende Gewerke souverän koordinieren – und Konflikte auf der Baustelle pragmatisch lösen.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist auf der Baustelle genauso zu Hause wie am Schreibtisch – und triffst dort schnelle Entscheidungen, wo sie gebraucht werden.
  • System-Denken: Du arbeitest nicht nur projektbezogen, sondern denkst in Standards, die sich replizieren lassen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Unsere Clubs entstehen in ganz Deutschland und perspektivisch europaweit – du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort zu sein.
  • Sprachen: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch – Englisch ist ein Pluspunkt für die internationale Zusammenarbeit.
  • Company Building: Du hast Lust, aktiv am Aufbau von Europas führendem Padel-Operator mitzuwirken — mit Ideen, Initiative und echter Verantwortung. Nichts passiert, solang wir es nicht tun.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil einer Erfolgsgeschichte: Unser Ziel ist klar: Europas größter Padel-Operator zu werden. Du bist von Anfang an dabei – mit der Chance, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und diese Vision aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Zentrales Büro im Herzen Berlins: Ein Ort für produktives Arbeiten und offenen Austausch auf Augenhöhe. Snacks & Getränke stehen selbstverständlich bereit.
  • Modernes Equipment: Du arbeitest mit einem MacBook und allem, was du brauchst, um produktiv zu sein.
  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Foundern zusammen und bekommst aus erster Hand mit, wie Entscheidungen getroffen, Strukturen aufgebaut und Strategien entwickelt und umgesetzt werden.
  • Entlohnung: Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit langfristigen Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • Sport & Wellbeing: Bei uns bekommst du regelmäßige Padel Matches auf unseren Courts - für deinen körperlichen Ausgleich und dein Wohlbefinden neben dem Arbeitsalltag.

descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

title: Regional Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Regional Operations Director (EMEA)

Location: London, United Kingdom (3 days a week from our London offices)

About the role: 

The Regional Operations Director is accountable for the operational effectiveness of the EMEA region. Reporting to the Global Chief Transformation and Operations Officer, you'll translate the global operating model into practical, market-specific execution — building the structure, governance and performance focus needed to strengthen operational control and support scalable growth.

You'll lead a regional operations team, partner closely with regional and global leadership, and act as the key connector between regional execution and global capability. The role calls for a leader equally comfortable setting strategic direction and solving complex operational problems hands-on — someone who turns data into action, builds high-performing teams, and keeps commercial performance firmly in focus.

What you will be doing: 

Regional operational leadership

  • Set clear priorities, accountabilities and ways of working for the EMEA Regional Operations function.
  • Build the structure, rhythm and capability needed to improve client delivery, business performance and regional growth.
  • Act as the senior operational partner to Regional Leadership on risks, performance, capacity and improvement priorities.

Client delivery operations

  • Own the operational run model for EMEA clients — including cadence, governance, issue resolution and escalation management.
  • Partner with Account Leadership to ensure delivery risks are visible, blockers are resolved quickly and client teams are set up to deliver effectively.
  • Ensure regional clients are mobilised and supported through consistent operating standards and reliable delivery controls.

Governance, cadence and decision management

  • Own the regional governance rhythm: forums, communications, decision-making and performance reviews.
  • Ensure decisions are made at the right level, escalations are routed effectively and regional context is represented in relevant global and regional forums.
  • Drive clear actions, accountability and follow-through across the function.

Operating model execution

  • Embed the global operating model across EMEA, ensuring standards, processes, tools and governance expectations are adopted consistently.
  • Translate enterprise-level standards into practical, market-specific ways of working.

Resource and capacity management

  • Own the regional view of demand, supply, utilisation, resource mix and capacity gaps.
  • Partner with Global Capacity Management, Account Teams, Delivery Leads and Offshore Operations to optimise deployment, resolve constraints and improve utilisation.
  • Provide regional input into enterprise workforce planning and future capacity needs.

Business and client enablement

  • Ensure regional client teams have the operational foundations needed to mobilise and deliver work effectively.
  • Coordinate core business processes including client onboarding, timesheeting, billing readiness, interagency set-ups, compliance and headcount approvals.
  • Act as the regional operational point of coordination for enablement issues, working across Finance, HR, Technology and Implementation to unblock dependencies.

Commercial performance and margin management

  • Manage the operational levers that affect cost-to-serve across the region, including scope leakage, resource efficiency, rework and avoidable cost.
  • Partner with Account Leadership and Finance to improve margin visibility and ensure practical actions are in place to protect profitable delivery.
  • Oversee regional budget performance and present financial outcomes to regional and global stakeholders.

Regional insight and continuous improvement

  • Use performance data to identify risks, issues and improvement opportunities across the region.
  • Translate insight into action — ensuring key issues have clear owners, measurable outcomes and appropriate escalation routes.
  • Identify recurring operational bottlenecks and lead remediation, including regional adoption of global improvement initiatives.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Act as the key operational connector between EMEA and global operations capabilities.
  • Partner across Sales, Account, Implementation, Finance, HR, Technology and Offshore functions to drive client outcomes and operational consistency.
  • Provide regional operational input into sales pursuits, client mobilisation, scope expansions and solution design — ensuring proposed models are deliverable and scalable.
  • Interface with Global Programme Directors where regional and global client contexts intersect, aligning on dependencies, escalations and capacity impacts.

Team leadership and development

  • Lead, coach and develop the Regional Operations team, building a high-performing function with clear roles, standards and ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational discipline and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure the team has the skills, confidence and behaviours needed to support a more mature, insight-led and scalable delivery model. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

Essential

  • Senior operations leadership experience within, advertising, consulting, creative production, media agency or professional services.
  • Deep understanding of agency operating models — including client delivery, workflow, resource planning, utilisation, scopes of work, billing, compliance and margin management.
  • Proven experience leading regional or multi-market operations teams in a people-led, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with confidence managing the operational levers that affect profitability.
  • Experience owning or improving resource and capacity management, including demand and supply visibility, workforce mix and deployment planning.
  • Ability to use operational data, KPIs and reporting to identify risks, drive action and improve performance.
  • Track record embedding governance, process discipline and ways of working across complex teams or markets.
  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder skills — with experience partnering across regional and global functions including Finance, HR, Technology, Account and Delivery.
  • Proven people leadership: building capable teams, strengthening operational performance and creating a culture of accountability.
  • Comfortable moving between strategic direction and hands-on operational problem-solving.

Desirable

  • Experience in a global matrix organisation with regional, global and offshore delivery models.
  • Background in an in-house agency, embedded agency, creative production or complex marketing ecosystem.
  • Exposure to client mobilisation, implementation, transition or new operating model design.
  • Experience contributing to RFPs, commercial modelling, solution design or delivery model development.

As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
  • Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
  • Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
  • Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
  • Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals
  • Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
  • Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
  • Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
  • Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

title: 1221 | Technical Lead
descriptionHtml:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled Technical Lead to join our dynamic team on a part time basis.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation of complex digital and enterprise IT solutions within a large-scale international environment. The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership, systems integration experience, and a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.

We offer long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required (Germany).

Requirements

  • 7+ years of proven experience in solution architecture, technical architecture, technical design, or closely related digital solution roles.
  • 5+ years of experience defining solution architectures for complex digital or enterprise IT solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience translating business and functional requirements into end-to-end solution designs and documented architectural decisions.
  • Proven architecture experience covering at least three of the following domains: application, integration, data, cloud, identity and access management (IAM), infrastructure, or security.
  • 3+ years of experience working with non-functional requirements, including security, scalability, performance, reliability, availability, maintainability, and interoperability.
  • 3+ years of experience providing architectural oversight and technical guidance to development teams, system integrators, or external vendors.
  • Proven experience leading and coordinating technical implementation across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong experience translating solution architecture and technical designs into practical implementation approaches.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting APIs, services, interfaces, data flows, and system integrations.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, version control, technical documentation, and quality assurance.
  • Experience performing technical estimations, coordinating engineering tasks, resolving technical blockers, and ensuring consistent implementation across solution components.
  • Proven ability to identify, investigate, and resolve complex technical, configuration, interoperability, and integration issues.

title: Financial Crime Lead
descriptionHtml:
What is Finary?
Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real.

Why now?
AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested.

What we offer
We’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here.

The opportunity

More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination.

Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto.

What you'll do

  • Lead the AML/CFT framework: procedures, client risk classification, detection rules and tools (screening, blockchain analytics, Travel Rule), calibrated on our own data.

  • Investigate and decide the hard cases: enhanced reviews of individuals and companies (ownership chains, financial statements, flows), on-chain investigations, decisions on suspicion.

  • Draft and file suspicious transaction reports, and act as deputy TRACFIN declarant and correspondent.

  • Handle screening and asset freezing: PEP, sanctions and adverse media hits, list updates.

  • Build with AI: design and tune the agents and rules in our back-office tool that prepare files and clear first-level reviews, and keep the decision on suspicion human.

  • Work with Ops, Care, Product and our outsourced review team so that AML decisions are clear, fast and fair to the honest majority of our clients.

What we're looking for

  • You've spent 6 to 8 years in AML/CFT in financial services, including hands-on work at a crypto-asset service provider (PSAN/CASP).

  • You've drafted and filed suspicious transaction reports with TRACFIN yourself.

  • You investigate on-chain: you use blockchain analytics tools and you know the Travel Rule and self-hosted wallets.

  • You hold a certification in on-chain analysis (Chainalysis CCI, CCCA or CRC, or a TRM Labs or Elliptic equivalent) and a Travel Rule certification (Notabene NB-TRFC or equivalent).

  • You work with data and AI every day: you query data yourself and you already use AI in your reviews or investigations. This is a must, not a plus.

  • You decide on evidence, you keep weak signals in proportion, and you explain your decisions clearly.

  • You prioritise a growing queue by risk without missing a legal deadline, and you move the framework forward at the same time.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

This role is not for you if you'd rather stay on onboarding checks, you prefer advising to deciding, or you need a large financial crime department and mature tools before you can start.

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: investigating cases, deciding them and filing the reports.

Interviews

Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call.

Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity

title: Global Head of Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Global Head of Manufacturing to build and lead UFORCE’s manufacturing capability as we turn battle-proven autonomous systems into high-quality products delivered reliably at scale.

You’ll bring together teams across Portugal, Poole and our expanding US manufacturing footprint behind one practical production strategy. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Global Demand & Delivery to turn customer commitments into accepted hardware, while keeping the rapid engineering and field feedback that make UFORCE effective.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll establish the operating discipline, capacity and leadership needed for sustained growth while staying close to the factory floor and the problems that affect delivery today. The role reports initially to Global CEO, with reporting expected to transition to the EU CEO or Global COO once the relevant leader is hired.

What You Will Do

  • Own manufacturing delivery across contracted programs. Establish achievable production and recovery plans, identify material and capacity constraints, and address risks before customer commitments are missed.

  • Build a resource-constrained global production plan across Portugal, Poole and planned US sites, balancing near-term execution with longer-term capacity, staffing, equipment, supplier and test needs.

  • Work with Global Demand & Delivery through the S&OP process to align site capacity and production commitments with the consolidated demand forecast.

  • Shape the manufacturing footprint and investment roadmap. Evaluate expansion, production transfers, make-versus-buy decisions and automation with Finance and cross-functional leaders, using demand scenarios, delivered cost and capital requirements.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product and Quality to prepare new products and major changes for production, improve manufacturability and bring field feedback into controlled, rapid changes.

  • Establish consistent production controls for bills of materials, work instructions, configuration, inspection, testing and traceability. Work with Quality and site leaders to resolve critical defects and safety or readiness gaps.

  • Use production data and time on the factory floor to improve yield, cycle time, labor productivity and unit cost. Address bottlenecks, shortages, rework and downtime with the teams closest to the work.

  • Partner with Supply Chain on critical material availability, supplier recovery and alternate sources, and escalate competing priorities with clear options and recommendations.

  • Build and develop site and functional leaders, clarify decision rights, strengthen technician skills and establish a consistent operating rhythm across the manufacturing network.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of taking complex hardware from early builds into sustained production, with direct ownership of delivery, output and quality through a ramp.

  • Experience leading manufacturing across multiple sites or countries through site managers, including building teams, developing leaders and establishing common standards while retaining local expertise.

  • Strong manufacturing engineering and industrialization judgment, including design for manufacture, assembly methods, tooling, test, configuration control and engineering change.

  • Demonstrated results improving production flow, first-pass yield, cycle time or cost through practical problem solving, continuous improvement and direct engagement on the factory floor.
