title: Hands-on Engineering Manager (C#/Vue)
descriptionHtml:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.


What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

  • Hands-on experience as a Senior Field Marketing Manager (or equivalent regional field marketing role) running events, account-based campaigns, and sales partnership.

title: Senior/Staff Product Engineer (Full Stack) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to be a technology leader in the SaaS space? Join epilot!


We are looking for product minded engineers not only coders. We're seeking builders who bridge technical expertise with product strategy. If you're passionate about impactful software, apply now! (Learn more about our understanding of being a product engineer here)

epilot is building a SaaS product to sell complex products online, focusing on solving ecommerce in the rapidly transforming energy market. Our mission: Make selling complex energy products as easy as selling a pair of shoes online.

As Software Engineer at epilot you will be a driving force in shaping this mission. What makes working as a Software Engineer at epilot so special? Our unique engineering culture is defined by a few core engineering principles.


We "epilots" are a team of experts from the fields of software development, energy management, product management and sales. In order to bring our solution even faster to the top in the energy world, we are looking for you as a Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack).


What awaits you

As a Product Engineer at epilot, you’ll go beyond just coding. You’ll play an integral role in building our cutting-edge platform using technologies like TypeScript, React, Svelte, and serverless AWS microservices. Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Immerse yourself in our tech stack: Microfrontends, serverless AWS, and best-in-class developer tooling and automation. Learn more here: docs.epilot.io

  • Be part of a cross-functional dream team: Collaborate with full-stack, backend, and frontend developers, designers, and product managers to deliver impactful features.

  • Work end-to-end: From ideation to delivery, you’ll team up with product management and design to bring features to life and make product decisions.

  • Take ownership: Got an idea? Draft an RFC (Request for Comment), drive the initiative, and own it from start to finish.

  • Foster growth: Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and continuously learn new technologies.

  • Innovate with agility: Participate in diverse, exciting development projects, leveraging pair programming and agile methodologies.

What you bring

We’re looking for a Product-Minded Engineer who resonates with our values and has the following skills and mindset:

  • Product Thinking: You care about delivering value to customers and users, not just writing code.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Hands-on experience with React or other JavaScript frameworks.

    • Knowledge of RESTful APIs or GraphQL.

    • Familiarity with microservices architecture and public/private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

    • Basic understanding of application and cloud security principles, and how to build secure, reliable software.

  • Ownership Mentality: You take initiative, drive features to completion, and thrive on responsibility.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You think like a business owner, understanding how your work impacts our goals.

  • Problem-Solver: You see challenges as opportunities for growth.

  • Collaborative Mindset: You’re a true team player who motivates and inspires those around you.

  • Agile Know-How: You’re familiar with methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, or XP and understand how to apply them effectively.

What we offer you

At epilot, we believe in rewarding performance, fostering growth, and creating an environment where you’ll thrive:

  • Impactful Work: Be part of a product-driven company that’s reshaping the energy sector.

  • Startup Mentality: Enjoy a dynamic atmosphere with flat hierarchies and open communication.

  • Flexibility: Work remotely or from our centrally located office in Cologne, with flexible working hours.

  • Growth Opportunities: Your career will grow as fast as we do. Learn, experiment, and embrace a “Fail Fast and Often” mentality.

  • Competitive Compensation: We take your desired salary seriously and value performance.

  • Team Spirit: Join us for regular events like summer parties, company breakfasts, and our epic annual epilot summit, where you’ll connect with co-epilots worldwide.

What to/we expect in your first 180days

-read full version: here-

  • Start learning the business: who our customers are, what we're building toward, why it matters

We welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, disability, or sexual orientation!

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

title: Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Numeric

Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era. Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.

Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on. We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP), a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one.

We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We’re in-person, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There’s never been a better time to join.

About This Role

As a Sales Engineer, you'll be the technical expert partnering with our sales team, helping accounting & finance leaders understand how Numeric solves their most complex accounting challenges. The product is moving fast, customers are getting more sophisticated, and the SE role is at the center of every major win.

We’re looking for someone with experience in technical selling to the OCFO and can hold their own with a Controller pushing back on the technical detail. This role is your path to owning bigger deals, shaping the playbooks the team runs on, and helping define what world-class presales looks like.

What you'll do

  • Independently lead demos, discovery sessions, and proof-of-concept engagements across mid-market and select enterprise accounts

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop technical win strategies and drive deals forward

  • Build credibility with senior finance stakeholders including CFOs, Controllers, and FDs of Finance as a trusted domain expert

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform product roadmap priorities. Partner closely with PMM and product to shape the future of the platform

  • Develop and maintain reusable demo environments, technical collateral, and enablement materials for the broader tea

About You

  • 3–5 years of total experience, with time as a Sales Engineer/Solution Consultant or Implementation Consultant at an ERP or FP&A platform (e.g., NetSuite, Workday, or Pigment), or time in an accounting & finance org with a passion for more customer-facing work

  • Solid accounting and finance domain knowledge, with the ability to hold a credible conversation with a Controller or CFOs

  • A track record of running demos, POCs, and discovery independently on deals of real complexity

  • Based in the London

Nice To Haves

  • Experience contributing to an SE function at a high-growth startup

  • ACCA/CIMA or formal accounting background

  • Familiarity with accounting close management or financial reporting workflows

How We Work:

This role is in-person in London (in office, with flexibility). We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:

  • Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.

  • Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.

  • SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” For too long, accounting and finance systems have reflected outdated processes instead of reimagining what’s possible. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.

  • Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.

  • Earn the right: We’re impatient to deliver results. We relentlessly iterate, measure, and improve. Every day is an opportunity to beat our prior best, raising the bar for the value we deliver to customers.

title: Senior Account Director - Healthcare (Data)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role
We are a diverse team of 45+ healthcare communications specialists who thrive on curiosity, the thrill of a challenge, good old-fashioned fun and working in partnership with clients to improve the health of the world, one brilliant idea at a time.

We deliver global, EMEA and UK integrated marketing communications solutions for many of the world’s leading healthcare companies.

Our breadth of work is limitless, as we challenge ourselves to innovate in all that we do and really make a difference. If it’s led by solid-insight or data, nothing is out of reach; from traditional media campaigns, data communications and brand launches, to multi-channel digital and social media programmes, to influencer campaigns and disease awareness initiatives, to patient apps or patient advocacy partnerships, to multi-award-winning corporate re-positioning videos and crisis management, the list is endless.

We believe that working here is a chance to change lives, including your own. We’re a super supportive team with a warm, friendly and social culture. Through our solid PDP process and ongoing training and support, we pride ourselves on nurturing our people to be their very best.  

What you’ll do

  • Support the strategic development and delivery of integrated, insight-led communications programmes for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.
  • Act as a day-to-day lead across projects, ensuring high-quality delivery, alignment with client goals, and consistent performance against KPIs.
  • Translate complex healthcare data (e.g. clinical trials, real-world evidence, HES data) into compelling narratives that support client messaging and engagement.
  • Lead and inspire account teams, providing mentorship, fostering collaboration, and ensuring continued professional growth.
  • Partner with senior leadership to shape strategic proposals and pitch documents, contributing to business development and organic account growth.
  • Cultivate strong, trusted client relationships by demonstrating sector expertise, strategic counsel, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Collaborate across Burson's network, including creative, digital, and strategy teams, to deliver bold, integrated campaigns that challenge the status quo.
  • Contribute to the broader agency culture by actively participating in forums, operational initiatives, and thought leadership efforts.

Experience that contributes to success      

  • Proven experience delivering UK, EMEA, and global communications programmes for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.
  • Strong track record in building and maintaining trusted client relationships, with hands-on leadership of integrated campaigns.
  • Skilled in data and brand communications, including digital, social media, disease awareness, and advocacy initiatives.
  • Confident in managing project financials, forecasting, and reporting, with experience contributing to successful new business pitches.
  • Demonstrated people management skills, including team leadership and direct line management.
  • Known for being collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering high-quality, insight-led work.
  • Brings a growth mindset with enthusiasm for learning, development, and tackling challenges positively.
  • Values an inclusive, open-minded, and supportive team culture where individuality is embraced.

#LI-SF1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d) - Befristet auf 12 Monate vorerst
descriptionHtml:
Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social.
Die Stelle ist vorerst auf 12 Monate befristet.

  • Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen.

  • Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette.

  • Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops.

  • Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS.

  • Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen).

  • Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen.

  • Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok).

title: Senior AI Deployment Strategist, Robotics - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Strategist you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI models, working closely with customers from strategic vision through production implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment. Specializing in robotics, you will help customers connect Mistral’s models with robotic systems, operational workflows, and existing technical infrastructure.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for robotics, collaborate with Mistral’s technical teams to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales; with a focus on large enterprises. Your job is to understand modern robotics systems well enough, including their capabilities, constraints, and deployment realities and link them to customers hardest challenges and guide them and our technical teams to successful outcomes.

Where robotics stands at Mistral today: we focus on delivering the best robotics models on the field, going beyond research to unlock concrete ROI. We work on the intelligence layer only. We integrate with incumbent robot platforms, we do not build robots. We work through research partnerships and pilots with industrial customers, not an off the shelf product. . We customise our models with manufacturers on their own floor via data capture and fine-tuning to reach best scalable results.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in robotics, and are passionate about turning AI science into real world impact. You will be based in Paris, co-located with the science team and our robotics lab, working closely with our Singapore hub, and traveling 30-60%.

What You Will Do

Strategic discovery and vision setting

  • Lead executive level workshops to identify robotics specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step change improvements for industrial manufacturing.

  • Translate customer priorities into practical robotics use cases across areas such as industrial automation, manipulation, inspection, navigation, and human–robot interaction.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value. Define a progression from initial experimentation to deployment in real operating environments.

  • Partner with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives.

  • Help customers prioritize robotics use cases based on value, feasibility, data availability, operational readiness, and deployment risk.

AI and robotics solution deployment

  • Architect an end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer manufacturing workflows and technical infrastructure.

  • Determine how these solutions should interact with customers’ robotic systems, software, data pipelines, and operational processes.

  • Partner with the Applied AI and Science teams to design, prototype, and deploy roboticssolutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

  • Own pilots and proofs of value, demonstrating the technology’s potential and paving the way for full-scale deployments.

  • Guide deployment at scale on diverse infrastructure (on-premise, edge, cloud) to ensure that proposed solutions account for real world constraints such as latency, reliability, safety, connectivity, hardware limitations, and changing operating conditions.

Value realization and customer success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customer robotics strategy and ensuring maximum value from Mistral’s solutions.

  • Monitor and communicate outcome-driven KPIs, on both science hypothesis and business impact, with executive sponsors.

  • Identify and address barriers to deployment, including process changes, user adoption, governance, integration ownership, and operational readiness.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial wins to drive long-term partnerships. This may include expanding deployments to additional workflows, sites, or robotic platforms.

Cross functional collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science focused product and research roadmaps.

  • Translate between customer business leaders, robotics specialists, software teams, operational teams, and Mistral’s technical experts.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary projects involving AI models, robotics software, customer infrastructure, and external technology partners.

  • Create reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence. This includes reference approaches for robotics discovery, piloting, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Contribute to Mistral’s robotics GTM strategy by sharing market insights, customer needs, and deployment learnings.

  • Travel approximately 30 - 60% to foster deep client relationships and support onsite deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client facing strategic and technical role, for example deployment strategy, solutions architecture, value engineering, technical sales, or applied science, with hands on exposure to robotics or industrial automation.

  • Real depth in robotics, not just an interest. You can talk perception, planning, navigation, manipulation, control, simulation, and human-robot interaction, and you know where vision-language-action models fit and where they don't. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our VLA roadmap

  • Strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.), you hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus. You are aware of recent model architectures in robotics, like VLM/VLA, you are able to understand where they fit. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our science roadmap.

  • Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences

  • Experience shaping or delivering technology projects in physical or operational environments.

  • Comfortable working with robotics engineers and understanding integration constraints across hardware, software, data, and infrastructure.

  • Strong business acumen and structured problem solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Executive presence and strong communication skills with VP and C-level stakeholders on technically advanced solutions.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python).

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business, AI, software, robotics, and operations.

  • Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying robotics, industrial automation, computer vision, or edge-AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with robotics platforms, middleware, or simulation environments such as ROS, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or equivalent technologies.

  • Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, automotive, aerospace, energy, construction, or other robotics intensive industries.

  • Understanding of robotics data collection, evaluation, simulation, and sim-to-real considerations.

  • A track record taking a robotics or AI application from prototype to production.

  • Experience working with research, engineering, systems-integration, and industrial partner ecosystems.

  • Experience with hardware OEMs, integrators, or industrial procurement on the customer side.

Why This Role Matters

You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring that Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact.

Robotics is moving from narrowly programmed machines toward more adaptive systems powered by foundation models. Turning that potential into customer outcomes requires more than strong models: it requires clear use-case prioritization, thoughtful integration, realistic deployment plans, and close coordination between business, AI, robotics, and operational teams.

You will help customers navigate this transition, translating strategic ambition into production-ready robotics solutions while ensuring that Mistral’s technology addresses real operational needs.

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

title: Senior Associate, Network Fee Management
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com is looking for a proactive, analytical Senior Associate, Network Fee Management to join our global NFM team. In this role, you’ll help optimise network fees across the region by analysing card scheme economics, fee structures, and scheme updates - ensuring billing accuracy, optimising revenue assurance, and unlocking cost savings. Partnering directly with Sales and Account Management, you’ll deliver client facing insights to help win and retain key merchant business.

Based in London as the regional expert, you’ll collaborate across Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. You’ll own defined analyses and work streams from investigation through implementation - evaluating scheme impacts, coordinating change delivery, and enhancing internal controls. By turning complex fee data into practical financial models and actionable recommendations, you’ll directly guide commercial strategy, pricing decisions, and merchant discussions through strong project ownership and stakeholder influence.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Network Fee Analysis & Reconciliation: Analyse network and scheme fee data across data sources and scheme insights. Investigate variances, identify root causes, and document findings with clear supporting evidence.

  • Fee Change Delivery: Assess the impact of scheme fee changes and coordinate with Finance, Commercial, Product, and Operations colleagues to support accurate implementation, configuration, and reporting.

  • Revenue Assurance & Cost Optimisation: Identify fee leakage, billing discrepancies, and opportunities to reduce costs through detailed analysis and ongoing monitoring. Recommend practical actions that protect revenue and improve fee accuracy.

  • Controls, Governance & Process Improvement: Maintain clear controls, documentation, and repeatable processes for fee analysis, reconciliations, and change management, helping the team work accurately and efficiently across markets.

  • Tools, Data & Insight: Utilising AI, this role will be expected to work on projects that improve reporting, analytical tools, and automation.

What We're Looking For

  • Payments Expertise: 5+ years of commercial experience in the payments industry within a fast-paced B2B environment, must have a strong understanding of payment network fee structures (Interchange, Scheme Fees, etc.) in particular Visa and Mastercard.

  • Operational Excellence & Commercial Impact: exceptionally organised and proactive operator who looks to drive continuous improvement, strengthens revenue assurance, and identifies opportunities to optimise costs.

  • Cost Model Delivery: Direct experience successfully designing, drafting, and launching complex global Cost models and structural frameworks, to aid the business in strategic design making.

  • Exceptional Communication: Ability to clearly communicate complex scheme related updates, and regulatory standards to stakeholders at all levels within the business and externally.

  • Ambiguity & Drive: Takes ownership of complex, evolving scheme-fee challenges - reconciling data and turning fee changes into clear, practical guidance for merchants and internal teams.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

descriptionHtml:
Notre Circular Analytics Team recherche un·e BI Engineer (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Paris ou à Lille. 

Au cœur du domaine Circularité, notre équipe de 25 experts et expertes de la donnée (BI Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists) construit l'intelligence qui propulse la transformation durable de Decathlon. Nous transformons la donnée brute en actions concrètes pour rendre la réparation, la location et la seconde vie aussi naturelles que l'achat neuf. Notre défi ? Réduire l'empreinte environnementale tout en sécurisant un modèle économique circulaire et performant à l'échelle mondiale.

En nous rejoignant, tu feras évoluer notre infrastructure BI en structurant la donnée 'back' et les flux décisionnels, pour en faire le moteur de solutions en libre-service et d'outils d'exploration basés sur l'IA générative. 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que BI/Analytics Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Circularité et notamment la squad dédiée au business model de la seconde main (buyback, revente). Ton objectif est de structurer la donnée "back" et de concevoir des solutions BI robustes pour libérer le plein potentiel de nos données liées au marché de la seconde main.
Au quotidien, tes missions incluent :

  • Comprendre le besoin métier & piloter la stratégie BI : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes business pour définir les KPIs, traduire leurs besoins en solutions visuelles et concevoir des architectures de données réutilisables. 
  • Modéliser et concevoir des solutions BI robustes : Dénormaliser et structurer des datasets optimisés (Focus Back/Analytics) pour garantir des performances maximales à notre portfolio de dashboards actuels tout en préparant les futures interfaces sémantiques et outils d’IA.
  • Assurer la livraison et la qualité : Piloter le backlog, prioriser les développements et mener les audits ou refontes techniques nécessaires sur nos dashboards clés.
  • Maintenir et sécuriser : Garantir l'intégrité des données de notre portfolio de dashboards, résoudre les incidents de production en collaboration avec les protocoles de gouvernance de Decathlon.
  • Favoriser le Self-Service et l'Innovation : Rédiger la documentation (Wiki/Confluence) pour rendre les utilisateurs autonomes et mener des POCs innovants.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

Nous recrutons avant tout des passionnés et passionnées de sport qui partagent nos valeurs de vitalité et de responsabilité.

  • Expérience : Tu as minimum 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire (BI Engineer, Analytics Engineer ou Data Analyst) avec une forte composante modélisation.
  • Compétences techniques : Tu maîtrises parfaitement SQL, la modélisation de données (Data Modelling & Design) et l'environnement Tableau. Tu as idéalement une bonne connaissance des outils de transformation (dbt), de l'environnement Databricks, ainsi que des concepts CI/CD (Git, Airflow)
  • Soft Skills : Tu es doté·e d'un esprit d'équipe, d'une pensée critique et d'une forte rigueur organisationnelle (culture du "You build it, you run it").
  • Engagement : Tu souhaites mettre tes compétences techniques au service de l'innovation durable (Tech4Good).
  • Anglais : Tu maîtrises l’anglais à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour évoluer dans notre contexte international.

STACK TECHNIQUE

Pour réussir dans tes missions, tu utiliseras :

  • Datalake & Execution Engine : Databricks, AWS S3
  • Data Transformation & Orchestration : dbt, SQL, Airflow
  • Data Visualisation & Interfaces : Tableau (Desktop, Server & Cloud Administration), Outils Self-Service, Semantic Layers
  • CI/CD & Version Control : Git, GitHub Actions
  • Documentation / Code : Confluence, Wiki, dbt docs

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. title: Senior Business Analyst – Financial Crime Compliance & Market Conduct
descriptionHtml:
Joining Capco means becoming part of an innovative and dynamic consultancy firm, committed to fostering an inclusive environment where you are encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We embrace individuality as a key factor in promoting diversity and inclusion, values that sit at the core of our success. We aim to attract a wide variety of talented professionals with different skills and experiences. If you require any adjustments to support your application process, please feel free to inform us at any stage.

ABOUT CAPCO

Capco is a global technology and business consultancy that is passionate about supporting clients in the financial services sector to grow and succeed in today's ever-changing world. We are:

  • Experts in banking, capital markets, payments and asset and wealth management.
  • Trusted advisors in core banking, securities and wealth management transformation, regulatory change, risk management and technology modernization.
  • A company dedicated to continuous development and excited to welcome top talent to help us drive innovation and deliver lasting results.
  • A business built on agility, collaboration, and entrepreneurial spirit.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to help shape the strategic transformation of our Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) and Market Conduct & Trade Surveillance (MCTS) capabilities within Legal & Compliance.

Working at the intersection of compliance, business, technology, architecture and data, you will shape strategic target states, assess current capabilities and translate business and control objectives into prioritised transformation roadmaps and actionable requirements. You will facilitate complex cross-functional decisions and provide clear recommendations to senior management.

You will act as the senior business-analysis and transformation lead for selected FCC and MCTS initiatives, shaping target states and roadmaps while working in close partnership with Compliance, Technology, Architecture, Data and Programme Management.

YOUR CAPCO DAY

  • Lead the business definition of strategic target states, facilitating alignment across Compliance, Technology, Architecture and Data and ensuring that agreed target states are translated into actionable transformation plans.
  • Assess current capabilities and conduct gap analyses across processes, organisation, systems, architecture, data quality and governance, translating findings into prioritised transformation measures and investment considerations.
  • Define business and technology requirements and develop relevant use cases and options, including opportunities to improve data quality, reduce false positives, automate and scale alert handling, and strengthen monitoring and surveillance processes.

title: Senior CRM Manager*in (m/w/d) - E-Mail-Marketing & Automation
descriptionHtml:
Du baust nicht nur Kampagnen, sondern den Kanal, über den eRecht24 verkauft

Bei uns ist E-Mail kein Begleitkanal, sondern der Kanal, über den aus kostenlosen Nutzer:innen zahlende Kund:innen werden und aus Kund:innen bessere Kund:innen. Wir haben kein klassisches Sales-Team. Was das Marketing nicht konvertiert, konvertiert niemand.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die diesen Kanal fachlich verantwortet: Strategie, Segmentierung, Automationen, Trigger, Testing, Zahlen. Hands-on in Brevo, im Austausch mit unserem Data-Team, im Sparring mit Product.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise). Unsere Kund:innen sind Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops, Agenturen und Webdesigner.

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen: viel Freiheit, viel Tempo, einiges noch unaufgeräumt. Brevo läuft, Kampagnen gehen raus, ein Data Warehouse liefert Segmente. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht: Lifecycle statt Gießkanne, Trigger statt Kalender, Tests statt Bauchgefühl.

Wie du bei uns arbeitest

Unser Marketing arbeitet in Squads innerhalb eines Marketing-Tribes. Du verantwortest den E-Mail- und CRM-Squad und arbeitest dort eng mit unserer E-Mail-Marketing-Managerin zusammen. Dein wichtigster Sparringspartner ist die Rolle Senior Marketing Manager Customer Journey: Sie orchestriert die Journey über alle Kanäle, du besitzt den E-Mail-Kanal in der Tiefe.

Die Grenze zu Product ist klar: Onboarding- und System-Mails gehören dem Produkt-Team. Du verantwortest die Marketing-Mails, also Konversion, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Retention und Winback, und stimmst Timing und Überschneidungen mit Product ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kanalverantwortung: Du entwickelst die CRM- und E-Mail-Strategie für unsere drei Kohorten und setzt sie um: Subscriber zu Freemium, Freemium zu eRecht24 PREMIUM, PREMIUM zu höheren Tarifen und Zusatzprodukten.

  • Automationen und Trigger: Du baust verhaltensbasierte Sequenzen in Brevo für Konversion, Upsell, Retention, Re-Engagement und Re-Permission, gespeist aus Plattform- und Tracking-Daten. Ein Teil dieser Infrastruktur entsteht gerade, zum Beispiel dynamische Angebotsblöcke in Mails, und du gestaltest mit.

  • Segmentierung mit Daten: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem BI-Team (Data Warehouse auf BigQuery) an Zielgruppen, Selektionen und Ausschlüssen. Du weißt, was du brauchst, und kannst es formulieren, gern auch in SQL.

  • Kampagnen und Copy: Du planst Kampagnen im Jab-Jab-Jab-Punch-Rhythmus (erst Mehrwert, dann Angebot) und in Batches, schreibst mit KI-Unterstützung auf Basis unserer Wording-Guidelines und finalisierst selbst. Fachinhalte kommen aus Legal und Content.

  • Kontaktregeln und Hygiene: Du definierst und setzt durch, wer wann was bekommt, zum Beispiel: Wer gerade in einer Sequenz steckt, bekommt keine Upsell-Mail. Dazu Listenqualität, Double-Opt-in, Einwilligungen, Bounce-Management und ein sauberer Umgang mit Inaktiven. Wir sind der Rechtssicherheits-Anbieter, unsere Mails sind es auch.

  • Testing und Zahlen: A/B-Tests (Betreff, CTA, Timing, Inhalt), Conversion je Kohorte, Umsatzbeitrag von E-Mail. Du verantwortest eine klare Zielzahl, den Umsatzbeitrag aus E-Mail, und berichtest monatlich, was funktioniert und was du deshalb änderst.

  • Schnittstellen: Customer Journey, Performance Marketing, Content, Product und Support.

Was wir nicht von dir erwarten

  • Ads schalten oder Social Media bespielen

  • Fachinhalte von Grund auf schreiben (die kommen aus Legal und Content)

  • Design (Vorlagen und Unterstützung sind da)

  • Personalführung

  • CRM-Administration oder -Customizing (Salesforce, Dynamics, SAP und Co.)

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 5+ Jahre E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM im B2B-, SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, davon mehrere Jahre mit eigener Kanalverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge mit Lifecycle-Automationen und Segmentierung (Freemium-to-Paid, Upsell, Churn-Prevention), nicht nur Newsletter

  • Sicher in einem Automation-Tool (Brevo, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud); Brevo-Praxis ist ein starkes Plus

  • Datenaffin: SQL-Grundkenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu lernen

  • Conversion-Copywriting auf Deutsch: klar, kurz, ohne Marketing-Sprech. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch gut

  • Routine mit KI im Workflow und das Urteil, wann das Ergebnis gut genug ist

  • Hands-on-Mindset in einem Umfeld, das sich gerade professionalisiert

  • Plus: Legal-Tech-, Compliance- or Rechtsthemen-Hintergrund, Erfahrung mit CDPs oder Cross-Domain-Tracking, Matomo

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Der wichtigste Umsatzkanal der Firma liegt bei dir.

  • Daten sind da: BI-Team, Data Warehouse, Plattform-Tracking.

  • Kein Leerlauf: Ein Backlog an Kampagnen-Konzepten wartet auf jemanden, der priorisiert und rausbringt.

  • Kurze Wege zur Marketing-Leitung, zu Product und zur Geschäftsführung.

  • AI-first, organisationsweit und von der Geschäftsführung getragen.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Keine Personalverantwortung, du berichtest an die Marketing-Leitung

Klingt nach dir?

15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und eine kleine Aufgabe aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Automation oder Sequenz hast du zuletzt selbst gebaut, und was hat sie in Zahlen gebracht?

  2. Mit welchem Tool arbeitest du heute, und wie groß ist die Liste, die du verantwortest?

  3. Wie entscheidest du, wer eine Mail nicht bekommt?

title: Senior Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will help our UK business understand performance, make better decisions and improve how quickly we learn. You'll work directly with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations and Finance, owning important commercial questions from problem framing through diagnosis, recommendation and measurement.

This isn't primarily a reporting role. We want someone who notices when something changes, works out why, and helps the business act. You'll also turn recurring questions into reliable, reusable analytical capabilities, contributing to our move towards proactive monitoring, automated diagnosis and trusted self-service insights. You'll collaborate with analytics colleagues across Eucalyptus and Hims & Hers while remaining close to UK business priorities.

What you’ll do

  • Diagnose performance. Investigate movements in acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue. Validate the signal, quantify the drivers, distinguish correlation from causation, and identify the controllable levers behind the change.
  • Drive decisions. Work backwards from commercial objectives, challenge assumptions and turn ambiguous questions into focused analysis. Recommend concrete actions, explain trade-offs and follow up to establish whether the decision worked.
  • Measure impact. Design and evaluate experiments, launches and operational changes. Use statistical reasoning, cohort analysis and appropriate causal methods to make credible claims, including when evidence is incomplete.
  • Build repeatable capabilities. Turn frequent investigations into trusted metrics, models, monitoring, diagnostic workflows and self-service tools. Help strengthen shared definitions and reusable approaches across markets rather than rebuilding the same analysis repeatedly.
  • Work AI-natively. Use AI to accelerate exploration, coding, validation and repetitive investigation, and help develop increasingly automated analytical workflows. Maintain ownership of assumptions, evidence and correctness: faster answers only matter when they can be trusted.
  • Ship and learn quickly. Deliver useful intermediate answers early, make uncertainty visible, seek stakeholder feedback and iterate. Balance speed with rigour rather than waiting for a polished, one-off analysis.

title: Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)
locations: Windsor, Windsor and Maidenhead, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

  • Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role.

If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.
