title: Senior Engineer, Graphics
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer. This role can be based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, Spain or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.  

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices. 

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS).

  • Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD.

  • Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR).

  • Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers.

  • Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance.

  • Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers.

  • Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs.

  • Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms.

  • Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms.

  • Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code.

  • Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs.

  • Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs.

  • Understanding of mobile GPU architecture (tiling, bandwidth, power constraints).

  • Proficiency in GPU performance profiling and optimization workflows.

  • Familiarity with compute-based rendering techniques, GPU-driven pipelines, and modern culling/visibility approaches.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with UE5’s Nanite/Lumen or equivalent advanced rendering solutions.

  • Background in custom engine development or low-level rendering systems.

  • Contributions to open-source graphics tools or technical publications.

  • Cross-platform rendering experience beyond mobile (PC/console).

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

  • Consistently self-source pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, partner-led account mapping, inbound qualification, and collaboration with the Sales Development team

  • Stay close to competitor positioning, pricing, and GTM dynamics across CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX markets
  • Provide informed feedback to internal teams on market positioning, competitive threats, and emerging enterprise buying patterns

What You Need:

Experience

  • Enterprise software, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or telecom new logo sales experience
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex six- and seven-figure ARR deals
  • Demonstrated experience owning the full sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through commercial and contractual close
  • Proven ability to build and convert pipeline in competitive, technically complex sales environments
  • Consistent and demonstrable overachievement of sales goals and revenue targets

Market Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market landscape - including key platform players, buying patterns, and enterprise decision drivers
  • Familiarity with leading enterprise CRM platforms and an understanding of how communications solutions integrate with or complement CRM ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge of cloud migration dynamics, API-first platform architectures, and how enterprises evaluate and adopt communications infrastructure
  • Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals, including SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, and regulatory considerations such as E911

Sales Skills

  • Exceptional outbound prospecting ability with a track record of self-sourced pipeline generation
  • Ability to build relationships at director level and above across IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX functions
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - working effectively with solutions engineering, legal, product, marketing, and partner teams
  • Commercial acumen and ability to construct and negotiate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements

Channel & Partner Experience

  • Experience collaborating with channel partners to close new logo opportunities
  • Understanding of how to engage partner organisations as a force multiplier in enterprise sales motions
  • Act as a trusted and credible partner-facing representative of Bandwidth in joint selling scenarios

Communication & Leadership

  • Ability to communicate complex technical and commercial value propositions clearly and compellingly at executive level
  • Strong pipeline and forecast discipline - comfortable operating in a data-driven, CRM-centric sales environment
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent enterprise sales experience
  • SI Proficiency: You don't just use SI — you build with it. You've created automations, workflows, or tools that others on your team rely on, combining SI with existing systems and data to solve real business problems. You design responsible use from day one.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling into BPO, contact centre, or AI-enabled CX environments
  • Track record of selling into complex regulated industries where compliance, resiliency, and security are key buying criteria

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

title: Senior Growth Manager - Strategic Accounts (Berlin)
descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Senior Growth Manager - Strategic Accounts (Berlin)

Salary Range: €65k-€90k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. This is a full 360 degree role with a sales and account management motion. Quota chasing is not the job but you'll have full top-line ownership and will not only shape the work but also execute it.

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. Tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Translate cap-fill outcomes and retention targets into bid moves. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Catch problems before advertisers do. Know what each account should do next before they ask. Push budget increases, geo expansions, format tests on a schedule. Intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Translate between commercial and technical teams. When a partner reports cost-data drift, you debug, push our engineering teams for an ETA, and frame the response back to the partner.

  • Ship the playbook. Document improvements to the Growth team's standard operating procedures every week.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our Director or CEO. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Senior team treats you as the named owner. You're already covering for a peer's vacation. You've spotted at least one non-obvious revenue lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: Within a few years, the path runs from regional accounts to country ownership to multi-country or vertical leadership (gaming, non-gaming) to regional head (EMEA) or global.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not just collect a title.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. A 15% cohort revenue drop on a daily view? You spot it in under 30 seconds and you explain it in two sentences a non-technical listener gets.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

Bonus points if you:

  • You speak Russian or Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

  • Know your way around platform-marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, and ARPU. If you don't yet, you will by week 2 - we'll onboard you on the math.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have hands-on experience with MMPs like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular. You can read postbacks, navigate attribution disputes, and explain View-Through Attribution to a confused partner.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way, for example taking a €2M/yr account book to €8M/yr in 18 months.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up Senior Associate background. We hire the for right mindset. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

descriptionHtml:

You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
descriptionHtml:
At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.

About the role

Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on.
What You'll Do
  • Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D.
  • Train at scale. Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real.
  • Define what "good" means. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy.
  • Explore stronger priors. Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see.
  • Land research in the product. Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there.
  • Track the field. This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it.

    • What we're looking for
  • Hands-on feed-forward reconstruction experience. You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break.
  • A track record of models others relied on. We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here.
  • Large-scale training. Practical experience with multi-node, multi-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early.
  • Strong PyTorch skills in a large shared codebase with real build and CI.
  • Research judgment. You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so.
  • Clear communication with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike.

    • Strong pluses
    These are listed in order of how much they matter to us.
    1. Feed-forward Gaussian prediction. Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene.
    2. Top-tier publications in feed-forward reconstruction. First-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area.
    3. Video diffusion models. Familiarity with diffusion or flow-matching video models, especially camera-conditioned generation.
    4. Dynamic scenes. Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency.
    5. Real-world capture. Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust.
    6. Making big models fast, or open-source contributions to widely used reconstruction libraries.
    Why join Parallel Domain?
    We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member.
    To attract and inspire the right talent, we offer: • Competitive compensation (range will be openly discussed early in our interview process)• Employer-paid supplemental medical, mental health, dental, and vision benefits.• Flexible paid vacation, sick time, winter shutdown, and 11+ holidays per year• Paid parental leave• Equipment budget to optimize your setup• Annual learning and development stipend

We are committed to providing employees with an environment free of discrimination, bullying and harassment. title: Senior Manager Product Structure & Systems (PLM/MES)
descriptionHtml:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As the Senior Manager of Product Structure, PLM & MES, you are the architect of the digital backbone that connects our robotic innovations to real-world production. In this high-impact leadership role, you will strategically own the implementation and evolution of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution (MES) systems and processes to scale with a rapidly growing product and manufacturing organization ("Digital Thread").
You will govern the product architecture for our complex mechatronic systems, ensuring that our Engineering BOM (EBOM), Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), and Service BOM (SBOM) are perfectly synchronized.
This is not just a systems role — it’s a business transformation mandate. You will define and execute the PLM and MES roadmap in collaboration with executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering, operations, product, and after-sales service functions. You’ll help us build an integrated, enterprise-grade ecosystem that accelerates product development, enables traceability, and scales product data excellence.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Product Structure & Configuration Governance
  • BOM Mastery: Define and govern multi-level BOM structures for complex robotic systems, ensuring alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service.
  • Modular Architecture: Support platform-based development by managing product configurations, variants, and component reuse strategies.
  • Data Standards: Enforce rigorous part-numbering schemes, revision control, and BOM rules to maintain 100% data integrity.
  • PLM System Ownership & Digital Thread
  • Platform Management: Own the strategic roadmap, implementation and functional administration of the PLM environment (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, CIM Database).
  • System Integration: Manage the technical "Digital Thread" between CAD → PLM → ERP → MES, ensuring real-time synchronization of product and manufacturing data.
  • Release Management: Oversee the lifecycle states, access controls, and workflows for all product releases and configuration baselines.
  • MES & Manufacturing Data Integration
  • Production Execution: Ensure the flawless transfer of product structures from PLM to the MES for production execution.
  • Process Definition: Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to define production routings, assembly sequences, and digital work instructions in the MES.
  • Traceability: Maintain "As-Built" traceability, ensuring consistency between MES production data and ERP production orders.
  • Engineering Change (ECM) & Continuous Improvement
  • Change Governance: Lead the Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Order (ECO) processes, ensuring controlled propagation of changes across all systems.
  • Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in workflows to reduce NPI (New Product Introduction) cycle times and improve manufacturing scalability.
  • Audit & Compliance: Conduct regular product data audits and implement corrective actions to ensure "Single Source of Truth" reliability.

    • Your Profile
  • Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering

  • 7+ years of experience in Configuration, PLM and MES system management, administration and implementation, ideally in hardware or complex mechatronic product environments

  • Proven track record leading cross-functional PLM projects with enterprise impact — from roadmap design to hands-on delivery

  • Strong technical knowledge of PLM architectures (e.g., Teamcenter, Windchill, Arena, CIM Database), MES systems (e.g. Tulip, Opcenter) and their integration with ERP, CAD, and quality systems

  • Deep understanding of business processes spanning engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and service

  • Highly effective communicator with the ability to engage and influence at all levels, including senior leadership and management

  • Demonstrated mentoring, training, or enablement of teams in system adoption and process maturity Fluency in English required; German is a strong plus


    • Bonus Points
  • Prior experience in scaling PLM environments in a high-growth startup or SME

  • Familiarity with quality management systems and industry regulations, e.g. ATEX directives

  • Experience in AI-enabled or robotics-based product companies

    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich. Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

title: Senior Manager Retail & Products met Supply Chain-ervaring
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met een focus op Supply Chain en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun supply chain klaar willen maken voor de toekomst. Of het nu gaat om een toekomstbestendig DC-netwerk, slimmere planning en/of forecasting, of een omnichannelstrategie die ook in de operatie werkt: jij vertaalt hun ambitie naar een scherpe strategie en zorgt dat de verandering ook echt landt.

Daarvoor werk je met multidisciplinaire teams uit strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie en organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Zo combineer je analyses, scenario’s en businesscases met de technologie en verandering die nodig zijn om resultaat te boeken.

Als senior manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor grote klanttrajecten en een vertrouwde sparringpartner op C-level. Je bouwt accounts uit, ziet de volgende vraag van de klant al aankomen en zet die om in nieuwe opdrachten. Daarbij krijg je alle vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel voor het project als voor de accountontwikkeling.

Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze supply chain-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?
Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). Bovendien realiseren we groei met dubbele cijfers en hebben we onze blik stevig gericht op verdere uitbreiding. We zitten met onze eigen succesvolle transformatie midden in een spannend avontuur! Waarom zou je er geen deel van uitmaken?

Wat zeggen je toekomstige collega's?

De scherpte van IG&H-consultants en de state-of-the-art digitale oplossingen, die leiden tot daadwerkelijke resultaten bij onze klanten, halen het beste in mij naar boven – elke dag.” Cazijn Langeler – Managing Director Retail & Products

“De huidige groeifase van IG&H biedt een geweldige kans om mezelf te ontwikkelen op een breed spectrum aan vaardigheden, omringd en ondersteund door heel veel intelligente mensen.” Guus Boonstra – Manager Retail & Products


Wat neem jij mee?

· Afgeronde universitaire master.

· Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren in strategie en digital consulting.

· Sterke management- en communicatievaardigheden; je weet stakeholders te verbinden en C-levelklanten te activeren.

· Sterk analytisch vermogen en conceptueel denken.

· Diepgaande kennis van Supply Chain en Logistiek.

· Een relevant netwerk in de Retail, Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en/of FMCG-sector.

· Je ontwikkelt geavanceerde businessmodellen en langetermijnstrategieën.

· Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie.

Wat we jou bieden:

· Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige werksfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen.

· Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

Waarom IG&H?

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. title: Senior ML Ops (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to power every ML and AI initiative at Doctolib — from experiment to reliable production service. You will build and operate the foundations that let data scientists, ML engineers, and AI teams ship models and agents safely, fast, and at scale, from classic machine learning to self-hosted generative AI. You will contribute directly to the reliability and performance of AI-powered features that improve the daily lives of millions of patients and thousands of healthcare professionals across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with data scientists, ML & AI engineers to take models from experimentation to reliable, scalable production deployment.

  • Operate and evolve the orchestration layer for training, serving and evaluation workloads, built on GCP and AWS using Kubernetes (GKE) and Ray-based platforms (Anyscale) — including CI/CD, versioning and automated testing pipelines that carry a model from the registry to a served endpoint.

  • Build the tools, templates and best practices (Terraform modules, Kubernetes CRDs and operators, GitOps workflows, internal libraries) that let any ML team deploy and operate their models and agents safely and consistently.

  • Ensure the availability, reliability and performance of ML systems in production across training, serving and the agents platform; define and track SLOs; take part in on-call and incident response for the whole stack.

  • Build and maintain observability for ML systems: infrastructure and model health via Datadog, and evaluation/quality signals via Braintrust, catching regressions before they reach users.

  • Work hand in hand with AI inference engineers on the shared foundations of our self-hosted LLM stack (model registry, deployment automation, shared GPU capacity), and stay current with MLOps practices for classic ML, generative AI and agentic systems alike.

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have prior experience as an MLOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer for ML applications, AI Infrastructure Engineer, or Platform Engineer for AI, or in a similar role

  • Are proficient in Python, Shell scripting and Terraform, with a solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, concepts and trends

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production and GitOps tools (e.g. ArgoCD), and have built MLOps pipelines for containerizing models and solutions with Docker

  • Have experience with cloud platforms such as GCP (GKE, BigQuery) and/or AWS or Azure equivalents, and with observability tools such as Datadog

  • Have hands-on experience with an experiment tracking/model registry tool (e.g. MLflow) and an LLM evaluation/observability tool (e.g. Braintrust)

  • Are a strong team player with excellent communication and documentation skills, comfortable with an evolving scope, and pragmatic about build vs. buy decisions

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes-native agent abstractions (CRDs/operators, e.g. kagent) or building production agent runtimes

  • Have experience with ML model quantization and optimization

  • Have experience with GPU sharing/partitioning technologies (e.g. NVIDIA MIG, time-slicing, MPS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • HR Interview by phone (45 min)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour)

  • Case Study & Restitution: MLOps pipeline design and AI agent production-acceleration exercise (1h30)

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Tech stack: Python / Terraform / Kubernetes

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Senior Operational Excellence Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As the Senior Operational Excellence Manager, you will be the architect of efficiency for our Australia and New Zealand markets. Sitting at the intersection of Planning, FSQA, Procurement, and Fulfillment, you will define our Target Operating Model (TOM) and drive the strategic framework that ensures our end-to-end (E2E) supply chain is lean, scalable, and resilient.

This role is based in Chippendale, Sydney and reports to the Associate Director of Operations Enablement.

You will…

  • Define and own the ANZ Operational Excellence strategy, translating business goals into a multi-year roadmap tailored to local market nuances.
  • Design and maintain the Target Operating Model (TOM) to ensure clear accountability, escalation governance, and seamless hand-offs across Planning, Procurement, FSQA, and Fulfillment.
  • Lead a portfolio of high-complexity projects using Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen methodologies to drive step-change improvements in Cost per Box (CPB), Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), and operational error rates.
  • Identify E2E supply chain bottlenecks and standardize tools and systems to reduce manual intervention, enhance data integrity, and drive supply chain digitalization.

  • Build a Continuous Improvement (CI) DNA across ANZ by designing training programs, coaching regional teams, and scaling best practices across our network.
  • Act as the primary bridge for ANZ leadership to ensure operational consistency and alignment across all business units.

You have…

  • Deep operational expertise across Supply Chain pillars (Planning, FSQA, Procurement, and Fulfillment) within high-growth, complex environments.
  • Proven experience designing Target Operating Models and E2E frameworks, along with a track record of leading large-scale organizational change.
  • Demonstrated mastery in project governance and continuous improvement methodologies (such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen) with a history of delivering measurable ROI.
  • Strong analytical and technical judgement, with the ability to use data-driven insights to identify systemic issues and drive financial targets.

You are…

  • A strategic, systems-level thinker who anticipates E2E supply chain impacts and moves proactively from reactive troubleshooting to systemic prevention.
  • An influential communicator with high emotional intelligence, capable of pitching process improvements to the C-suite and running Kaizen events on the warehouse floor.
  • Autonomous and results-oriented, bringing a "Founder’s Mentality" to navigate ambiguity and take full accountability for cross-functional KPIs without formal authority.

Start Date: Immediately available - Can wait a notice period

Location: Chippendale Head Office - hybrid working environment

Experience using Salesforce

descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

As our Senior Performance Marketing Manager for the US and Mexico, you'll be the operational engine behind our growth in two new markets. Reporting to the Head of Growth, you'll own the tactical campaign management of our digital acquisition across the US and MX - standing up channels from scratch, finding what works, and scaling the winners. You'll manage significant budgets on Meta, TikTok and Google Ads, identify and iterate on winning creative concepts, and optimise conversion funnels for two very different markets.

You'll be part of a lean, high-performing team of operators. At Zable, individual contributors wear many hats. We ask ourselves: what's the most impactful thing I can achieve this week? And then own that thing end to end. This role combines digital strategy with hands-on performance marketing execution - perfect for someone who's a deep specialist in one or more digital channels, with the breadth and appetite to learn fast and build in unfamiliar territory.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, spots opportunities others miss, and gets genuinely excited about turning creative concepts into scaled winners - in markets where there's no existing playbook to lean on. You'll work with sophisticated attribution models, systematic creative testing frameworks and modern growth methodologies.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • 2–4 years in performance marketing with a strong creative tilt, preferably D2C, challenger brands and/or fintech

  • Deep hands-on Meta, Google Ads and TikTok campaign management experience, managing multi-million annual budgets

  • A strong understanding of effective hooks, messaging and creative formats for social media

  • Familiarity with attribution modelling and incrementally testing concepts

  • A strong analytical mindset; SQL proficiency preferred

  • Comfortable creating and working with AI tools to enhance productivity and analysis

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building in new audiences and markets without an established playbook

Desirable:

  • Experience launching or scaling acquisition in the US and/or Mexican markets

  • Spanish language skills valued but not essential

  • Experience standing up a digital channel or market from scratch

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated consumer categories

You're a good fit if you're:

  • An owner: you see digital marketing opportunities and execute them without detailed instructions

  • Creative and analytical: you balance intuition with data-driven decision making

  • Detail-oriented: you catch performance patterns others miss and build robust testing processes

  • Energised by greenfield: you'd rather build the engine in a new market than take the reigns from someone else

  • Growth-minded: you're here to learn, improve and take on bigger challenges

What you'll be doing

Channel Strategy & Scaling:

  • Own the D2C acquisition strategy for the US and Mexico across paid social and search, driving volume and efficiency against ambitious incremental CAC targets

  • Lead the launch and scale of new high-potential channels while ensuring Meta, Google and TikTok maintain a best-in-class foundation from day one

  • Establish what works in two distinct markets and build the repeatable playbook to scale it

Creative Engine:

  • Drive the performant creative engine: translate customer insights and winning patterns to inform clear, data-informed briefs for our external creator network, ensuring high-performing video content is produced at speed

  • Systematically analyse creative output to build and refine our hook and concept library, providing actionable feedback to the in-house creators

  • Adapt messaging and creative to the cultural and linguistic nuances of the US and Mexican audiences

Optimisation & Measurement:

  • Execute daily and weekly optimisations across paid channels, leveraging internal attribution models to inform bidding and budget allocation decisions

  • Maintain and audit the conversion tracking setup to ensure accurate, high-quality signal engineering for ad platform algorithms

  • Actively triangulate results from multiple attribution sources (e.g. MMM, internal models, incrementality tests) to drive as much impact as possible

Life at Zable

title: Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)
descriptionHtml:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident.

The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist.

Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call.

Thousands of teams, from AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering organizations like LinkedIn, Citi and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Our stack is AI (Claude, Codex, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We don't filter on programming language. If you ship full-stack with AI, you'll pick ours up. We ship to prod all day, every day, practice Agile (not scrum), keep meetings low and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

 

What you'll do

  • Shape a product from early stage to strategic. You'll be involved early in how we build incident response out as a platform, technically and on the product side. That means a lot of ownership, influence and visibility.

  • Build the foundation first. Incident management, status pages, on-call, and tight integration with the rest of Checkly. For at least the first six months this is solid product engineering. AI-assisted incident response comes once the foundation is in place.

  • Build and ship with AI. Coding agents are how you work: exploring solutions, scaffolding, refactoring, testing and debugging.

  • Talk to the people on call. You'll be directly involved in customer conversations. You'll learn how responders work under pressure and turn that into what we build next.

  • Find the right problems to solve. In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

  • Own your work end to end. From the first idea to rollout to how it behaves in production. You'll join the on-call and support rotations like everyone else.

 

What you should have

  • You've built incident management, on-call, alerting or status page products before. You know what responders need from a tool when something breaks at 3am.

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can drive a product area, not just pick up tickets. You make decisions without perfect information, and you ask for input when it counts. You have opinions about what we should build and why, and you change your mind when someone makes a better case.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • You share work early. Drafts, rough MVPs and half-finished docs go out for feedback before they’re polished. In an async team, that’s how good ideas get better fast.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without waiting for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, team meetups or conferences.

 

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

 

How we build with AI

Don’t take our word for it. Here’s what that looks like in practice, written by the team:

  • Checkly and the agentic software layer: Hannes on why the CLI is how agents use software, including running monitoring and incidents.

  • Your software factory stops at deploy: Stefan on what happens after deploy, when a failing check should kick off the fix.

  • We let AI agents rewrite a 92M-message-a-day service in Go: Eddie on porting a core service with an agent, and zero incidents.

  • Why I built my own AI agent orchestration tool: Immanuel on running 10 to 20 coding agents at once.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

 

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €107k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

 

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

At Fin, you will be a product engineer - someone who solves real customer problems through a smart and efficient application of your technical knowledge and your tools. You’ll be part of one of our multidisciplinary product teams, where you will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts.

We’re facing many exciting scaling challenges and we’re building a robust platform where your expertise can be applied to areas such as building a beautiful messenger composer, rule matching, deliverability, security, app availability and machine learning, to name a few. 

What will I be doing?

As an experienced engineer you will:

  • Develop technical plans and contribute to our technical architecture as we scale our products to serve tens of millions of people every day.
  • Write Ruby code, which knits together a lot of AWS, infrastructure, platform and SaaS technologies that form the core of Fin's backend infrastructure
  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. That “day one” change is automatically deployed to production along with 100 other deployments (on average) each weekday.
  • Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Grow your team’s capacity by mentoring other engineers and interviewing candidates. This is a chance to be an integral part of building and growing a team.

What skills do I need?

  • 5+ years of industry experience in a software engineering role, preferably building a SaaS product. You can demonstrate significant impact that your work has had on the product and/or the team.
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Javascript etc.) (If you don't know a language we use, that's okay! We think great people can learn quickly or introduce us to better ways of working.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)
  • Experience collaborating directly with product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams
  • Experience with Distributed systems 

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
descriptionHtml:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.
  • Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.
  • People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs).

title: Senior Product Manager Supply Chain / Logistics / Transport (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Contexte du poste

Au sein d'un environnement international, nous recherchons un Senior Product Manager spécialisé en Supply Chain pour piloter la transformation digitale des outils et processus logistiques.

Tu interviendras au cœur des enjeux opérationnels de la Supply Chain : gestion des stocks, entrepôts (WMS), commandes (OMS), transport (TMS), assortiment et référentiels de données logistiques.

Ton objectif : concevoir et faire évoluer des produits digitaux permettant d'optimiser les flux physiques et informationnels, d'améliorer la disponibilité des produits, de fiabiliser les données et de renforcer la performance opérationnelle et financière.


Tes missions

1. Product Discovery & compréhension des enjeux Supply Chain

  • Comprendre les processus métier de bout en bout : approvisionnement, gestion des stocks, entreposage, préparation de commandes, distribution et transport.

  • Recueillir les besoins des équipes Supply Chain, Logistique, Transport, Retail et Finance.

  • Identifier les irritants opérationnels, les ruptures de flux et les opportunités d'automatisation.

  • Cartographier les parcours utilisateurs et les flux de données entre les différents systèmes (WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP).

  • Traduire les problématiques terrain en solutions digitales à forte valeur ajoutée.

2. Product Strategy & pilotage de la roadmap

  • Définir une vision produit alignée avec les objectifs de performance Supply Chain.

  • Construire et prioriser une roadmap produit à moyen et long terme.

  • Piloter des produits liés à plusieurs domaines fonctionnels :

    • WMS (Warehouse Management System) : gestion des entrepôts, réception, stockage, préparation et expédition.

    • OMS (Order Management System) : orchestration des commandes, gestion des disponibilités et suivi des flux omnicanaux.

    • TMS (Transport Management System) : planification, exécution, suivi et optimisation des opérations de transport.

    • Gestion des stocks : visibilité des inventaires, fiabilité des données, réapprovisionnement et optimisation des niveaux de stock.

    • Assortiment & distribution : allocation des produits, disponibilité en magasin et coordination des flux entre entrepôts et points de vente.

    • Master Data Management : fiabilisation et synchronisation des référentiels produits, fournisseurs, transporteurs et données logistiques.

  • Définir et suivre les KPI métier : taux de service, disponibilité produit, fiabilité des stocks, lead time, coûts logistiques et performance transport.

3. Product Delivery & transformation digitale

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Tech, Data, UX/UI et les experts métiers Supply Chain.

  • Formaliser les besoins fonctionnels, Product Briefs, User Stories et critères d'acceptation.

  • Piloter le backlog, les arbitrages et les différentes phases de delivery.

  • Accompagner l'intégration des solutions avec les systèmes existants : ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, APIs et plateformes Data.

  • Garantir la qualité et la cohérence des données échangées entre les systèmes.

  • Organiser les déploiements et accompagner la conduite du changement auprès des équipes opérationnelles.

4. Performance & innovation Supply Chain

  • Optimiser les processus logistiques grâce à l'automatisation et à la digitalisation.

  • Améliorer la visibilité et la traçabilité des flux de marchandises.

  • Contribuer à la réduction des coûts opérationnels et à l'amélioration de la qualité de service.

  • Explorer les opportunités offertes par la Data, le Machine Learning et l'IA pour anticiper les besoins, fiabiliser les prévisions et optimiser les opérations.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 45.000-55.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.

Expérience

  • 2 ans minimum d'expérience en Product Management, dans un environnement Supply Chain, Logistique, Retail, E-commerce ou Transport.

  • Expérience significative sur des produits digitaux complexes, connectés à des processus opérationnels et à plusieurs systèmes d'information.

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux de transformation digitale et des architectures fonctionnelles Supply Chain.

  • Capacité à piloter un produit de la discovery jusqu'au déploiement et à mesurer son impact business.

Expertise Supply Chain recherchée

Une expérience approfondie sur au moins un des domaines suivants :

  • WMS / Warehouse Management : opérations d'entrepôt, stocks, préparation et expédition.

  • OMS / Order Management : orchestration des commandes, disponibilité et gestion des flux.

  • TMS / Transport Management : transport international ou domestique, planification, suivi et performance.

  • Inventory Management : gestion des stocks, allocation, réapprovisionnement et optimisation.

  • Supply Chain Planning & Assortment : prévisions, distribution, assortiment et disponibilité produit.

  • Supply Chain Data / MDM : référentiels, qualité de données, interopérabilité des systèmes.

Environnement technique apprécié

  • Outils Product : Jira, Confluence, Figma.

title: (Senior) QA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Build the quality system that lets Tilla ship quickly and safely: reusable test automation, sound release judgement, and a way of working that makes quality everyone's job in practice.
