title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

What You'll Work On

  • Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites.

  • Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather.

  • Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse.

  • Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them.

  • Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors.

  • Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control.

  • Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts.

  • New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design.

  • The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack.

  • Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments.

Your Background

  • A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth).

  • Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors.

  • Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior.

  • Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries.

  • Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests.

  • Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills.

  • Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs.

  • Willingness to visit customer sites regularly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment.

  • Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework.

  • Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation.

  • Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation.

  • Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog.

  • Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

  • 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

  • Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

  • Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

  • Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.

  • Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.

  • Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

Nice to Have

  • ROS 2.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation.

  • Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

  • Functional safety or comparable standards work.

  • On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience.

  • Having been on call for hardware in the field.

What We Offer

title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers allemand courant (Télétravail depuis Nancy) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

  

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

Au quotidien, tu :

  • échanges avec les clients dirigeants et leurs équipes ;

  • comprends et qualifies leurs demandes ;

  • les accompagnes sur les sujets liés au compte professionnel, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement ;

  • interagis avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les demandes et opérations liées aux services financiers ;

  • coordonnes les échanges entre les clients, les équipes internes et les partenaires concernés ;

  • analyses les situations et identifies les prochaines étapes ;

  • apportes une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée ;

  • formalises les informations utiles au traitement des dossiers ;

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Au démarrage :

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur Pennylane et ses services financiers.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu’avec les différents départements.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends progressivement en charge ton portefeuille de demandes.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu analyses les demandes, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches la solution la plus adaptée.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

 

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo, Senior Recruiter : 30 minutes

  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert, Responsable de l’équipe : 1 heure

  • Test pratique en allemand : lecture d’un message client et rédaction d’une réponse

  • Dernier échange en visio avec Nathan Robinet, Senior Team Lead Customer Support, Financial Services : 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

  • Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production

  • Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources

  • Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

  • Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale

  • Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale

  • Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants

  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

  • Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL)

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

  • Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

  • Experience with RL post-training of LLMs or VLMs

title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

We take cutting edge software-testing technologies and make them useful for finding real bugs in our customer’s software, allowing them to make more reliable software and ship with confidence.

Historically we’ve focused on the hardest testing problems, providing deterministic simulation testing of whole distributed systems, finding and helping people to understand bugs that would have been a nightmare to find in production.

As more and more code is written by agents, everyone is starting to realise just how important software verification is, and we’re in the process of expanding the problems and companies we target, and are providing an increasingly broad suite of open source and commercial testing tools for a much wider variety of problems and audiences.

We’re well funded, deeply technical, and committed to improving the quality of software across the board. If you’d like to help us do that, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

You'd be joining a small London-based team building out a new Antithesis product, focusing on a more downmarket and diverse set of customers than our main product. We’re rapidly iterating and expect to be shipping some time early in the new year.

We're looking for an engineer at the Senior to Staff level to help us make that system dependable. This will be “devops” in the traditional sense, though more dev than ops: You'll be a member of the engineering team, not a separate operations function, working in the same repository as everyone else, but your primary area of responsibility will be how the system runs in production. That means AWS, deployment, observability, alerting, and the on-call that comes with them.

There will be some on-call, shared with the rest of the team, and part of the job will be helping us define how that works. This is the first product Antithesis is shipping primarily out of the UK, and we want to get things right from the start to make it sustainable and quiet. We’re thinking of this role as less about being the person that gets paged, and more being the person who tries to make sure that nobody does.

Likely much of this will have already been prototyped by the time you join, but there will be a lot of latitude to make big changes to how that works.

What You'll Do

  • Own our AWS environment.

  • Define and build out our observability and alerting

  • Ensure our continuous deployment story is robust and stress-free in an environment where we expect to change production many times a day.

  • Build and maintain our infrastructure for our fleet of testing VMs for running customers’ code.

  • Take charge of our incident response and make sure we learn from incidents so we don’t repeat them.

What We're Looking For

An ideal candidate would have most of the following:

  • You have been responsible for a production system on AWS, including being on call for it, and you have opinions about what you would do differently.

  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD.

  • Practical experience of observability.

  • You have built alerting that people trusted.

  • Experience operating Postgres: backups, upgrades, migrations, and what happens when they go wrong.

  • Solid Linux, container and networking fundamentals.

  • You are comfortable directing AI coding agents and skeptical of what they produce.

Bonus:

  • Experience running agentic systems in production.

  • Sandboxing or isolating untrusted code (microVMs, gVisor, or similar), or security work on a multi-tenant platform.

  • Being the first infrastructure engineer on a team, or building an on-call rotation from nothing.

  • Cost management for bursty, compute-heavy workloads.

  • Nix.

About Our Team

Our team spans CS degrees, philosophy, mathematics, everything in between, or nothing formal at all. What everyone shares is a high bar for engineering quality. We work primarily in-person because it's how we build trust and tackle hard problems together.

Location: This position is onsite, based in our London, UK office.

Visa Sponsorship: We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without current or future sponsorship requirements.

title: Staff Security Engineer - Application Security
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi moves over $2B a month across 30+ countries for people who cannot afford mistakes. That makes security a core product feature, not a compliance checkbox. As our Staff Security Engineer for Application Security, you are the most senior technical voice on how we build, ship and defend software. You own the full AppSec surface: intrusion response, pipeline hardening, vulnerability management, OS-level exposure, and the external testing programme spanning AI-driven pen testing, third-party engagements and bug bounty.


You work directly with Engineering, Product and Infrastructure to make security a first-class part of every pull request and every production incident. This is a high-ownership role with no ceiling on scope and no handoffs to hide behind.

What you'll build and own

  • Own the application security posture end to end, from threat modelling in design to triage in production, with no gaps.

  • Harden our build and CI/CD pipelines: integrate SAST, DAST and SCA tooling so vulnerabilities are caught before they ship.

  • Lead intrusion response for application-layer incidents: contain fast, analyse deeply, remediate thoroughly, and feed lessons back into prevention.

  • Run the vulnerability management lifecycle: scanning, OS-level patching cadence, prioritisation by real-world impact, and clear SLAs for remediation.

  • Manage the external security testing programme: scope third-party pen tests, drive AI-assisted pen testing coverage, and operate the bug bounty so researchers are rewarded and findings are actioned at pace.

  • Write the code that scales your work: automation scripts, custom scanner integrations, internal security tooling, using AI coding tools to move faster without cutting corners.

  • Set the bar for the wider engineering team: define secure-by-default patterns, run threat-modelling sessions, and make security a first-class part of engineering culture.

Your experience

  • 5 or more years in a security engineering or AppSec role, with at least one stretch operating at staff or principal level scope.

  • Hands-on coding ability in one or more languages used in modern backend or infrastructure stacks: you write real code, not just review it.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of application vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10 and beyond), OS-level exposures, and pipeline security risks.

  • Proven track record running vulnerability triage and remediation programmes at scale: you can prioritise under pressure and get fixes shipped, not just filed.

  • Experience managing or contributing to external security testing: third-party pen tests, AI-augmented offensive tooling, or bug bounty operations.

  • Confident using AI coding and analysis tools to build automation, analyse logs at speed, and augment offensive testing coverage.

Nice to have

  • Background in fintech, payments or any regulated environment where the cost of a breach is existential, not just reputational.

  • Offensive security certifications or demonstrable CTF and pen testing experience that shows you think like an attacker, not just a defender.

  • Experience building a security champions programme or embedding AppSec practices across a fast-growing engineering organisation.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Streaming
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Job Description

About the role

Checkout.com is looking for an ambitious Staff Data Engineer to join our Data and AI Platform Team. Our team’s mission is to build a platform where you can create reliable, scalable, AI-powered streaming and batch data applications, and share data across Checkout.com to improve business performance.


The Data and AI Platform team is here to ensure internal stakeholders can easily collect, store, process and utilise data to build AI use cases and data products aiming to solve business problems. Our focus is on maximising the amount of time engineers spend on solving business problems and minimising time spent on technical details around implementation, deployment, and monitoring of their solutions.

We're building for scale. As such, much of what we design and implement today is the technology/infrastructure which will serve hundreds of teams and petabyte-level volumes of data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with stream processing technologies (Kafka and Flink) to build a continuously available large-scale event streaming platform

  • Leverage subject matter and technical expertise to provide leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence across the organisation whilst building strong relationships with engineers and engineering managers

  • Build tooling (modules/SDKs/DSLs) and associated documentation to foster the adoption of the streaming platform by enabling upstream teams and systems to easily publish data and deploy streaming applications

  • Implement all the necessary infrastructure to enable end users to build, host, monitor and deploy their own streaming applications

  • Provide consultancy across the technology organisation to drive the adoption of the platform and unlock event-driven use-cases

  • Participate, translate, run and execute the collection of requirements and architecture/design initiatives into action plans

  • Provide hands-on support for all event-based systems including incident triage and root cause analysis


About You

While experience with our specific tech stack is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in data systems who are eager to learn. The core remit of this role is to own and scale our event streaming capability, not to serve as a general DevOps or infrastructure engineer.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with a proven track record of influencing engineering organisations

  • Strong engineering background with a track record of implementing and owning event streaming platforms

  • Hands-on experience working with stream technologies, ideally Kafka

  • Experience designing and implementing stream processing applications with Flink

  • Experience working with cloud-based technologies such as AWS (MSK, S3, Lambda, ECS, SNS)

  • Experience with Kubernetes (either self-hosted or on the cloud)

  • Experience with SQL databases

  • Experience working with Docker, container deployment and management

  • Experience describing infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) as well as designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines

  • Excellent programming skills with at least one of Java or Python

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Stage Data Science & Clinical AI – start dec 2026 t/m mrt 2027
descriptionHtml:
Wil je meebouwen aan de zorg van morgen met AI? Als stagiair bij Pacmed bouw je modellen die de besluitvorming in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen elke dag verbeteren. Je werkt met echte klinische data, samen met data scientists, engineers en clinici. We zoeken twee stagiairs die starten tussen december 2026 en maart 2027.

Over Pacmed

Bij Pacmed combineren we technologie en menselijkheid om de zorg toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig te houden. Onze software draait al in meerdere Nederlandse ziekenhuizen en we breiden actief verder uit. We helpen zorgprofessionals om real-time betere beslissingen te nemen, capaciteit efficiënter te benutten en patiëntenstromen soepel te laten verlopen. Als stagiair zit je precies op het punt waar onze modellen en data de klinische praktijk raken.

Waarom Pacmed een ideale stageplek is:

  • We zijn een scale-up met een duidelijke missie: de zorg toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig houden.

  • Je werk doet ertoe. Het komt terecht in producten die in ziekenhuizen gebruikt worden, niet in een la.

  • Je krijgt een begeleider die investeert in je ontwikkeling, en een team dat elkaar graag beter maakt.

  • We gaan vriendelijk en respectvol met elkaar om en hebben graag plezier, met regelmatige teamuitjes en een jaarlijkse off-site.

De twee stages

Elke stagiair krijgt een eigen project. Beide projecten gaan over patiëntenstromen: hoeveel patiënten komen het ziekenhuis binnen, en hoeveel stromen er uit naar de nazorg.

Stage 1: instroom voorspellen op de acute as (Capaciteitsmonitor)

De Pacmed Capaciteitsmonitor geeft zorgprofessionals AI-voorspellingen op basis van real-time ziekenhuisdata, zodat ze personeel en capaciteit proactief kunnen plannen in plaats van reactief. De capaciteitsmonitor voorspelt patiëntbezetting en zorgzwaarte en vertaalt dat naar de daadwerkelijk benodigde personele capaciteit.

We breiden deze aanpak nu uit naar andere afdelingen op de acute as: de spoedeisende hulp (SEH), de eerste harthulp (EHH) en de cardiac care unit (CCU). Daar houdt de personeelsplanning nog weinig rekening met schommelingen in de instroom, met over- en onderbezetting als gevolg.

Sinds september 2026 werkt een stagiair aan instroommodellen voor deze afdelingen. Jij versterkt dat project en bouwt erop voort. Denk aan:

  • modellen voor de SEH, EHH en CCU ontwikkelen en verbeteren op basis van ziekenhuisdata over instroom, uitstroom en bezetting en publieke data zoals weer, evenementen en epidemiologische gegevens

  • de (potentiële) impact van de AI modellen op de personeelsplanning doorrekenen

  • afdelingen (SEH, EHH, CCU) of ziekenhuizen met elkaar vergelijken;

  • de uitkomsten samen met clinici interpreteren en valideren.

Stage 2: uitstroom naar de VVT voorspellen (Transfer Monitor)

De Pacmed Transfer Monitor richt zich op een van de grotere inefficiënties in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen: vertraagde overplaatsing van patiënten naar de nazorg. Patiënten die medisch gezien niet meer in het ziekenhuis hoeven te liggen maar nog nergens terechtkunnen ("verkeerde bedden") zijn naar schatting goed voor 5 tot 15% van de ligdagen in de ziekenhuizen waarmee we werken. Dat blokkeert de doorstroom vanaf bijvoorbeeld de SEH en het electieve programma, is vervelend voor patiënten, verhoogt het risico op complicaties en kost onnodig geld.

De Transfer Monitor voorspelt vroeg en per patiënt of iemand nazorg nodig heeft en wat de verwachte ontslagdatum is. Zo kan het transferbureau bepalen welke patiënten het eerst gescreend worden, en kunnen artsen en verpleegkundigen het ontslag op tijd regelen.

In deze stage gebruik je klinische data om te voorspellen hoeveel patiënten uitstromen naar VVT-instellingen (verpleeg- en verzorgingshuizen en thuiszorg). Daarmee kunnen die instellingen hun eigen capaciteit beter plannen. Je bouwt en evalueert het model en toetst het samen met ziekenhuizen en nazorginstellingen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je traint en evalueert machine-learningmodellen op echte ziekenhuisdata.

  • Je ontwerpt en voert impactanalyses uit die de klinische waarde van onze producten laten zien en verbeteren.

  • Je schuift aan bij sessies met clinici om hun werkproces te begrijpen en dat te vertalen naar modelkeuzes.

Wat bieden we

Je krijgt intensieve begeleiding van een ervaren data scientist, met echte ruimte om je project zelf te trekken. Je bouwt een stevig portfolioproject op een echt clinical-AI-probleem, en de stage richten we zo in dat hij past bij de eisen van je scriptie of opleiding. Vanaf dag één hoor je er volwaardig bij. Eerdere stagiairs leverden werk op dat direct in onze producten terechtkwam, zoals ons zorgzwaartemodel.

Daarnaast:

  • een stagevergoeding van €500 per maand;

  • regelmatige sociale activiteiten, met kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijkse off-site;

  • flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om af en toe vanuit het buitenland te werken;

  • 25 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (naar rato bij parttime);

  • dagelijks lunch op kantoor, met veel vegetarische en veganistische opties;

  • de mogelijkheid om standaard feestdagen te ruilen voor andere dagen, bijvoorbeeld voor persoonlijke of religieuze feestdagen;

  • een laptop van de zaak voor de duur van je stage.

Solliciteren

De sollicitatie bestaat uit een of twee gesprekken waarbij we kennis maken, jij de kans krijgt om je vragen te stellen en wij graag meer horen over je motivatie en ervaring.

Interesse? Stuur ons een korte motivatie en je cv. Vermeld je opleiding, je beschikbaarheid (startdatum en aantal uur per week) en of je een voorkeur hebt voor stage 1 of stage 2.


Wie zoeken we

We zoeken iemand die analyses kan uitvoeren, modellen kan bouwen en de uitkomsten hervan op een begrijpelijke manier kan presenteren en bespreken met clinici zonder data-achtergrond. Dit vragen we:

  • Je spreekt Nederlands. Je werkt met personeelsplanners, verpleegkundig teamleiders, capaciteits- en transfermedewerkers in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen, en met Nederlandstalige data.

  • Je hebt een goede data science-achtergrond. Je beheerst de kernprincipes en kunt in Python zelfstandig analyses uitvoeren en modellen bouwen, evalueren en verbeteren. Praktijkervaring, bijvoorbeeld uit een eerdere stage, baan of serieus project, heeft onze voorkeur.

  • De stage is onderdeel van je masteropleiding of promotietraject.

  • Je kunt starten tussen december 2026 en maart 2027.

  • Je bent minimaal 6 maanden fulltime beschikbaar, of een gelijkwaardige hoeveelheid tijd parttime (meer dan 50% van fulltime, over een navenant langere periode).

Klinische ervaring is een pre, bijvoorbeeld als (bijna) laborant, verpleegkundige of technisch geneeskundige of vanuit een bijbaan. Het helpt je om de data goed te interpreteren en om de juiste vragen te stellen aan de mensen die onze producten gebruiken.

title: Stage Privacy & Data
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou!

Over MyWheels

MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt.

Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡

Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Samen bouwen we aan iets wat echt telt.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, jouw begeleider.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je duikt in klantklachten over privacy en ontrafelt de lastige gevallen: wat is er gebeurd, en hoe lossen we het op?;

  • Signaleren van quick wins en verbeterkansen op het gebied van privacy en data.


  • Verbondenheid met de duurzame impact doelstellingen van MyWheels;

  • Je hebt interesse in de praktische kant van wet-en regelgeving en dan voornamelijk op het gebied van privacy en data;

  • Je volgt een juridische opleiding, bij voorkeur WO Rechtsgeleerdheid of HBO Rechten, maar iedere student met de juiste interesse is welkom;

  • Je zoekt een meewerkstage om praktijkervaring op te doen;

  • Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en leergierig en durft kritische vragen te stellen;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The Role

A European building materials group has agreed with Hive at CEO level to roll out supervised autonomy across its quarries. Pilots are running, and the agreement covers around 80 sites in several countries over the next years.

The signed agreement is where your work starts. Head office has said yes, but every site still has to: the plant manager, the safety team and the production planner. You get each site commercially ready before our Delivery team arrives, and you decide with the customer in which order sites go live.

This role sits between Sales and Delivery. Account Executives land new customers. Delivery installs and runs the machines. You own the rollout inside the accounts that have already signed at group level, starting with this one and followed by the next global customers.

Nobody has held this job at Hive before. How you run this account becomes how Hive runs every global account after it.

What You Will Do

Own the rollout plan

  • Build the site by site rollout plan with the customer's executive sponsor.

  • Sequence the rollout against what Hive can actually deliver, and defend that sequence to the customer and internally.

  • Get each site to yes on its own numbers.

Build the business case per site

  • Set the commercial terms per site inside the frame agreement: KPI thresholds, scaling estimates, exit criteria and pricing.

  • Find the value beyond labour cost, such as pit design, shift patterns and production planning, and build the case the plant director takes to their board.

Run the relationship

  • Keep the stakeholder map current in every country, from the group executive sponsor to the site supervisor.

  • Run the governance: monthly with the customer's programme owner, quarterly with their executive sponsor, weekly with Hive's Delivery lead.

  • Hand each site over to Delivery once it is scoped, then move to the next.

Build the model

  • Carry customer requests into Product and Engineering, and push back on the ones that are not worth building.

  • Document how Hive runs a global account, and hand it to the person who takes the next one.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • You have run a multi-site or multi-country programme, either on the vendor side or as the customer's programme owner.

  • You have owned a number on an account: revenue, margin or a rollout target.

  • Experience building business cases and working with both executive teams and site operations.

  • Industrial context: construction, quarrying, mining, building materials, infrastructure or process industry.

  • Highly structured, and comfortable owning the details over a long programme.

  • You have told a customer no on scope, price or date, and kept the relationship.

  • A life situation that allows heavy travel in the UK and Europe.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Strongly Preferred

  • Operations or strategy consulting experience with industrial or infrastructure clients.

  • Experience from a large construction or building materials company.

  • French or German.

This Is Probably Not the Job for You If

  • You want to recommend and move on. Site 40 in year three is part of the job.

  • You need a delivery organisation that hits every date. Ours is young, and you will be the one explaining a slip to the customer.

  • You want a pure sales role. Landing new logos belongs to the Account Executives.

What Success Looks Like

  • The first sites are past pilot, in contract and running, and the next batch is commercially ready before Delivery gets there.

  • The customer's executive sponsor holds a written rollout plan with dates and KPIs, and treats it as theirs.

  • Every site that went live did so on terms that make money for Hive.

  • Hive has a documented way of running a global account, in use on the second one.

title: Systems Engineer / DevOps Engineer (M/W/D) - CARSYNC
descriptionHtml:
CARSYNC bietet ein 360° Mobility ECO System, mit dem in der Geschäftsmobilität sämtliche Workflows digitalisiert und automatisiert werden. Mit zukunftsorientierten Technologien ermöglichen wir neben einer effizienten Steuerung der Geschäftsmobilität auch die Transformation von Fuhrparks in die nächste Generation der Geschäftsmobilität: Intermodal, vernetzt, autonom, geteilt und emissionsfrei.

Bereits über 50.000 Dienst- und Poolfahrzeuge sowie 125.000 Nutzer vertrauen auf unsere SaaS-Lösung. Mehr als 100 Tech- und Mobility-Enthusiasten gestalten in München, Alzenau und Rostock die Geschäftsmobilität neu.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du wirst Teil unseres Infrastruktur-Teams und arbeitest mit uns daran, eine stabile, sichere und zukunftsfähige Plattform zu betreiben und weiterzuentwickeln. Niemand bei uns muss alles alleine können – wir verteilen Verantwortung, tauschen uns viel aus und bringen unsere jeweiligen Stärken ein.

Was dich erwartet

Gemeinsam mit dem Team betreibst und entwickelst du unseren Kubernetes-Stack weiter (Rancher, RKE, Ceph). Wo dein Schwerpunkt liegt – Cluster-Betrieb, Storage, Observability – hängt auch von deinen Interessen ab.

Du baust mit uns CI/CD-Pipelines in GitHub Actions aus und hilfst Entwicklungsteams dabei, ihre Build-, Test- und Release-Prozesse robuster zu machen. Bei der Containerisierung von Anwendungen (Docker) und bei Architektur- oder Betriebsfragen bist du Sparringspartner – vom Dev- bis zum Prod-Cluster.

Unsere Infrastruktur steht auf zwei Beinen: On-Prem betreiben wir ein Datacenter-Rack mit Netzwerk (Switches, Firewalls) und Virtualisierung (Proxmox), in AWS laufen ebenfalls zentrale Services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3). Beide Welten entwickeln wir gemeinsam weiter.

Monitoring und Logging (Checkmk, Grafana/Loki, Datadog) betreiben wir im Team. Du bringst dich beim Ausbau ein und hilfst, Incident- und Problem-Management proaktiver zu gestalten – inklusive blameless Postmortems.

Bei unseren Datenbanken (MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL) unterstützt du den Betrieb über mehrere Umgebungen hinweg: Backup, Replikation, Performance-Tuning. Tiefe in allen dreien ist kein Muss – Spezialisierung ist willkommen.

Und ja: Dokumentation, Automatisierung und Mentoring gehören dazu. Nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil wir's selbst gut finden, wenn Dinge auffindbar sind und Wissen im Team bleibt.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Must-have:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer oder in vergleichbarer Rolle
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Linux, Netzwerken und Containern (Kubernetes)
  • Erfahrung mit physischer Infrastruktur (Racks, Switches, Firewalls) und Virtualisierung (z. B. Proxmox)
  • Praxis mit CI/CD und Infrastructure-as-Code (z. B. GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible)
  • Lust auf Teamarbeit, klare Kommunikation und pragmatische Lösungen
  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Nice-to-have:

  • AWS-Erfahrung (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, EKS) und Security-Themen (IAM, Secrets-Management, Policy-as-Code)
  • Observability- und SRE-Praktiken (Grafana, Loki, Datadog)
  • Datenbank-Operations mit HA- und Performance-Fokus – Schwerpunkt auf einer DB reicht völlig
  • Deutschkenntnisse

Du musst nicht jeden Punkt abdecken. Wenn du in einem Bereich stark bist und andere Themen spannend findest, reden wir gern.

Zum Standort

Idealerweise wohnst du im Umkreis von ca. 1,5 Autostunden um München oder bist bereit, gelegentlich vor Ort zu sein.

Benefits

Warum wir

Wir arbeiten wirklich als Team – offene Feedbackkultur, gegenseitige Unterstützung, geteilte Verantwortung. Weiterbildungsbudget, Communities of Practice und Zertifizierungen gehören dazu, weil Lernen Teil des Jobs ist. Und: kurze Entscheidungswege, echter Gestaltungsspielraum und sichtbarer Impact auf die Plattform, an der du mitbaust.

  • Du trägst mit deinem Einsatz dazu bei ENGINEERING A BETTER WORLD Realität werden zu lassen
  • Pro Quartal bekommst du im Rahmen eines People & Culture Checks die Gelegenheit zu reflektieren was uns wirksamer macht und was wir gemeinsam tun können, um deine Performance zu steigern
  • Wir bieten dir einen modernen open Space Arbeitsplatz, eine agile Arbeitsumgebung mit flachen Hierarchien und konstruktiver Atmosphäre mit schnellen Entscheidungen
  • Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, Dein E-Fahrzeug mit Ökostrom aus den Solarparks der VISPIRON Group zu laden
  • Du bekommst Zugang zu unserem Firmen-Carsharing, frisches Obst und kostenlose Getränke im Büro
  • Du kannst an regelmäßigen Firmenveranstaltungen teilnehmen und aus einer Vielzahl anderer Vergünstigungen das Passende für dich auswählen. Z.B. Mitarbeiterrabatte in unserer eigenen V-Lounge un djeden monat Gutscheine im Wert von 50 Euro
  • Du bekommst einen unbefristeten Vertrag mit wettbewerbsfähiger Vergütung und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

title: Talent Acquisition Advisor - 12 Month FTC
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

Oxa’s Talent Advisor will play a pivotal role in supporting the effective delivery of talent acquisition activities by sourcing and engaging candidates, supporting recruitment processes, building future talent pipelines and contributing to early careers and employer branding initiatives. The Talent Advisor will play an important role in ensuring recruitment activity is organised, efficient and delivers a positive experience for both candidates and hiring managers over an initial 12 month period as we scale our operations worldwide.

Responsibilities:

Candidate sourcing and recruitment

  • Support recruitment activity across a range of technical and commercial domains.

  • Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, Major job boards, the ATS and other relevant channels.

  • Review applications to identify suitable candidates and maintain a strong pipeline of talent.

  • Conduct initial screening calls and structured interviews to assess candidate suitability.

  • Coordinate interview processes, manage candidate communications and provide timely updates throughout the recruitment journey.

  • Support hiring managers to build candidate shortlists, interview scheduling and recruitment tool kits.

  • Ensure candidates receive a professional, consistent and positive experience throughout the process.

Talent pipeline development

  • Build and maintain talent pools for current and future recruitment needs.

  • Identify potential talent through proactive sourcing, networking and market research.

  • Maintain regular engagement with prospective candidates to support future hiring requirements.

  • Keep talent pipelines organised, relevant and up to date within the ATS.

  • Support talent mapping and research to identify potential candidates in key skill areas.

Early careers

  • Support the coordination and delivery of early careers recruitment activity, including graduate, intern, apprenticeship or entry-level hiring, as applicable.

  • Assist with university engagement, careers events and early careers attraction initiatives.

  • Help manage candidate applications, communications and selection processes for early careers programmes.

  • Contribute ideas to improve the attraction and engagement of emerging talent.

Employer branding and candidate attraction

  • Support the delivery of employer branding initiatives across relevant recruitment channels.

  • Assist with creating and sharing recruitment-related content, including job adverts, candidate communications and social media content.

  • Help ensure job adverts and candidate-facing materials reflect the organisation’s values, culture and employee proposition.

Recruitment systems, administration and reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records, recruitment stages and vacancy information within the ATS.

  • Support the creation and maintenance of external job adverts, interview documentation, candidate records and recruitment reports.

  • Monitor recruitment activity and assist with basic reporting on vacancies, candidate pipelines and recruitment progress.

  • Provide general administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the talent acquisition function.

     

What you need to succeed

  • Recent experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, resourcing or a candidate-facing coordination role, ideally within a technical or engineering environment.

  • Experience of utilising candidate sourcing techniques and managing end to end recruitment processes via an Application Tracking System

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with candidates and stakeholders at all levels.

  • Solid organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing confidential candidate information and recruitment systems.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach with a willingness to learn and develop.

  • Confidence using digital tools, recruitment platforms, G-suite and ATS software, ideally ASHBY.

  • An interest in employer branding, early careers and developing talent attraction strategies.

      

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.
