title: Talent & Growth Intern - Germany
descriptionHtml:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

Every great company starts with exceptional people, and the best of them are rarely looking. As our Talent & Growth Intern, you'll work directly with our founders to find them early, put Dryft on their radar, and get them excited to build with us. Think of it as venture capital, except your portfolio is people. One day you're spotting the standout at a hackathon, the next you're hosting a dinner for the most ambitious people in the city, and in between you're turning a "maybe later" into a "when can I start?"

  • Scout the outliers: find the people who'll be impossible to hire in three years, from lecture halls and competitions to every other corner of the market, and get to them first

  • Make Dryft the place to be: throw the hackathons, founder dinners and parties nobody wants to miss, and launch the campaigns and stunts that bring people to us before we ever reach out

  • Build the team that builds Dryft: turn your top finds into hires, get every one of them to yes, and grow into a full-time role in Talent, Growth or Special Projects

Building the world's best team is Dryft's highest priority. You'll meet more exceptional people in six months than most do in a decade, and you'll be the reason they choose Dryft.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience: you've thrived somewhere fast-moving, like a high-growth startup, a student initiative or something you built yourself, and you're obsessed with startups and the people who build them

  • Community builder: you've grown a student initiative, an event series or a network from nothing, and the best people kept coming back

  • Talent magnet: you spot who is going to make it long before their CV does, and after ten minutes with you, they want in

  • Sense of urgency: you keep fifty conversations moving at once, and when you meet someone exceptional, they hear from you that same day

  • Genuine & zero ego: you're honest with people even when the answer is no, and you'd rather see the team win than get the credit

  • Language: you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation: you're ready to work onsite in Munich

title: Team Lead Sales Enablement (x/f/m)

Als Team Lead Sales Enablement führst Du ein vierköpfiges Team, steuerst die Aus- und Weiterbildung unserer Seller:innen und sorgst dafür, dass neue Teammitglieder schnell produktiv werden.

Deine Aufgaben

title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech Scale-up, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du ein Team regionaler Account Executives auf, das Kanzleien aktiv gewinnt – Outbound wie Inbound: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Deine Mission

Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director, an den du direkt berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Sales Firms Director, Case Study, Onsite-Gespräch mit dem Team in Berlin.

Dein Team

  • Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien.

  • Outbound ist Kern: Einen wesentlichen Teil eurer Pipeline baut ihr selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr.

  • Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben.

  • Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien.

  • Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir.

  • Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

  • Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams: den MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien und die Marktdurchdringung von Pennylane im deutschen Kanzleisegment.

  • Du baust mit deinem Team eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst die Aktivitätsquoten hoch.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen.

  • Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

  • Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast selbst Outbound gemacht und Teams darin geführt: Kaltakquise bei Inhaber:innen und Entscheider:innen schreckt dich nicht – sie ist dein Hebel.

  • Du bist ein Builder: Du hast schon einmal ein Team, einen Markt oder einen Prozess aufgebaut – idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Scale-up) – und baust Vertrauen auf, im Team wie bei Kanzleiinhaber:innen.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und Englisch auf C1-Niveau für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil).

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

Deine Mission: Du übernimmst einen Mandanten — einen internationalen Hersteller, der uns seine Geräte zur Reparatur anvertraut. Du führst dein Team, du steuerst den Prozess, du hältst die Durchlaufzeiten, du sprichst mit dem Kunden. Wenn etwas nicht läuft, wartest du nicht auf Anweisung — du löst es.

Aufgaben

Dein Mandant:

  • Du steuerst deinen Bereich anhand klarer Kennzahlen und stellst sicher, dass Durchlaufzeiten, SLA-Ziele und Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden
  • Du bist der direkte Ansprechpartner für den Kunden — auf Englisch, auf Augenhöhe

Dein Team:

Dein Ergebnis:

Qualifikation

title: Tech Lead - Terminals
descriptionHtml:
About Ryft

 

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

 

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

About the Job

Are you an engineering leader who wants to own the systems that connect physical point-of-sale hardware to a modern, scalable payments platform?

We are looking for a Tech Lead to head up our Card Present (In-Person Payments) squad. You will lead the technical direction and hands-on delivery of the infrastructure that allows our merchants to take physical payments. You'll work across our C#/.NET backend on AWS, shaping how physical card taps and inserts securely communicate with our event-driven services, split funds, and settle correctly.

This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role. You won't just be managing a Jira board, you'll be deep in the architecture, writing code, mentoring your squad, and owning the technical strategy for our physical terminal estate. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and physical hardware, ensuring our in-person payment flows are as robust, scalable, and developer-friendly as our online ones.

What You'll Work On

  • In-person payments architecture: Leading the technical design for our card-present estate, ensuring low-latency, highly reliable communication between physical terminals and our AWS backend.

  • Terminal & Gateway Integration: Building the critical paths that connect smart payment terminals and Point of Sale (POS) systems into Ryft’s core gateway and marketplace routing logic.

  • Hardware-to-cloud flows: Handling the unique complexities of physical payments: offline modes, state synchronization, hardware webhooks, and complex failure modes.

  • Security & Compliance pipelines: Ensuring our physical payment flows remain airtight and fully compliant within heavily regulated environments.

  • Squad Leadership: Setting the technical standard for the Card Present squad. Breaking down complex product requirements into actionable architecture and guiding engineers through delivery.

  • The platform itself: Contributing to our broader event-driven C#/.NET service estate, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling alongside other Tech Leads.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical delivery: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end features for our card-present offering. You are the ultimate technical owner of what your squad ships.

  • Design for hardware-cloud correctness: Write and architect services that behave under network drops, partial failure, and hardware concurrency. Idempotency and absolute accuracy are the job, not edge cases.

  • Raise the bar & mentor: Improve the codebase and our engineering practices. Review code rigorously, set conventions, and level up the engineers in your squad.

  • Own it in production: Take real ownership of what goes live: instrumentation, alerting, and incident response for a system where physical merchants are relying on your uptime to make a living.

  • Harness AI, stay in control: Use AI-assisted workflows to multiply your output (we invest heavily in them) while remaining in full command of every line you ship and review.

  • Collaborate: Work day-to-day with your Engineering Manager, Product Managers, hardware vendors, and other squads to deliver seamless omnichannel payment features.

Experience & Skills Required

  • Technical Leadership: Proven experience leading technical projects, architecting complex backend systems, and guiding small teams of engineers to deliver high-quality software.

  • Strong backend engineering: Significant commercial experience building and running production backend services. Our backend is C#/.NET, so depth there is ideal, but if you're excellent in another modern typed language and will get fluent fast, we want to hear from you.

  • AWS in production: Hands-on experience running distributed services on AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB or similar) and understanding the operational reality that comes with them.

  • Distributed systems judgement: Comfortable reasoning about service boundaries, asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, and building resilient systems that handle downstream provider outages.

  • AI-augmented, engineer-first: You use AI coding tools effectively to move faster, but you review, understand, and take full ownership of the output. We are not looking for someone who ships code they can't explain.

  • Fast, self-directed learner: A track record of getting productive quickly in unfamiliar domains. Enthusiasm to master the complexities of hardware-software interactions matters more to us than knowing it all on day one.

Nice to Have

  • POS & Terminal Integration: Existing experience integrating physical payment terminals, card readers, or Point of Sale (POS) systems into payment gateways.

  • Android Experience: Familiarity with Android development, specifically in the context of building or maintaining applications for smart payment terminals.

  • PCI-DSS & Compliance: Deep understanding of payment scheme rules, PCI-DSS compliance, EMV standards, or Point-to-Point Encryption (P2PE).

  • Infrastructure ownership: Infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and containerisation.

Why Ryft? If you want to build the systems that move money in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you. We value engineers who care about the craft, speak up with their ideas, and take pride in what they ship. You'll join a team where your voice is heard, your work matters, and there's plenty of room to grow.

title: Technical Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast.

The job shifts with it. Instead of grinding through every stack trace yourself, you direct AI to accelerate the investigation and apply what AI can't: judgment on whether a fix is safe to ship into a live enterprise environment, whether the root cause is actually fixed or just patched, and whether this is a one-off or a pattern worth escalating to Product.

As Omnea's Technical Solutions Engineer, you're the senior technical presence sitting between Customer, Product, and Engineering. You own Omnea's most complex customer-facing technical problems end to end - gnarly integrations, cross-system issues, escalations nobody else can crack. You're the person the team calls in when something's on fire, and you're just as comfortable stepping into a customer's implementation when it gets technical.

This is a foundational hire. You'll set the technical bar for how Omnea supports enterprise customers, and help define how the function grows from here.

What You'll Do

  • Own the hardest technical problems: Lead investigation and resolution of Omnea's most complex customer issues - integrations, configuration edge cases, cross-system bugs. Direct AI to accelerate the first pass, then apply the judgment AI can't: is this safe to ship, is the root cause actually fixed.

  • Be the SWAT team between Customer, Product, and Engineering: Act as the senior escalation point when an issue is beyond what the Customer team can resolve alone, and the technical voice in the room when Product and Engineering need to understand what's really happening on the ground.

  • Get technical inside implementations: Step into live implementations when they hit technical complexity - tricky integrations, custom logic, unusual data flows - and work directly with the implementation team to get them unstuck.

  • Feed the product roadmap: Spot patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-scoped input for Product and Engineering, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

  • Build the standards as you go: Document what you learn, build the tooling and playbooks for triaging and resolving complex technical issues, and raise the bar for technical quality as the team grows around you.

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time directing AI through the first pass of an investigation than manually tracing every log line yourself. AI narrows down the likely cause fast; your job is confirming it's right and safe to act on.

  • Writing a sharp, specific brief for what you want AI to investigate or fix is now a core skill, not a nice-to-have.

  • Judgment on production risk matters more, not less: AI can suggest a fix in minutes, but you decide whether it's safe for a live enterprise environment.

  • You'll keep experimenting with AI tooling as it evolves, and bring what works back to the rest of the team.

About You

We don't expect you to have done this exact job before.

TL;DR: you're a technical, customer-facing problem-solver who's as comfortable elbow-deep in an API integration as you are explaining what went wrong to a CFO's technical lead.

  • 3-8+ years in a customer-facing technical role - technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or similar - at a fast-growing SaaS company

  • A technical background: a Computer Science or Engineering degree, prior experience as a software developer or engineer, or strong hands-on experience with SQL, APIs, and system integrations

  • Strong systems intuition: comfortable diving into unfamiliar platforms, reasoning about architecture, and figuring out where in a complex system something's actually broken

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to speed up investigation and first-draft fixes, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check

  • An excellent communicator who can flex between a technical deep-dive with an engineer and a clear explanation for a non-technical stakeholder

  • Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity: you want to help build the standards and playbook for this function, not just follow one that already exists

  • High ownership: when something's broken, you own it through to resolution, and you raise your hand for the hard problems rather than waiting to be assigned them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)
descriptionHtml:
À propos

Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain.

Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact.

  

Rôle

Nous recherchons un Technicien Qualité pour rejoindre notre bureau de Paris. En travaillant sur le terrain aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de qualité, vous veillerez à ce que la qualité soit intégrée à nos produits, du prototype jusqu'à la livraison au client. Vous rapporterez au Responsable Qualité.

  

Responsabilités

Support à la fabrication de prototypes :

  • Fournir un support qualité lors de l'assemblage des prototypes, en veillant à ce que les constructions soient conformes aux plans, aux instructions de travail et aux spécifications.

  • Identifier et documenter les pièces non conformes, soutenir le traitement et les actions correctives aux côtés de l'équipe d'ingénierie.

  • Aider à définir les méthodes d'inspection et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux composants.

 

Revue de premier article (FAI) :

  • Réaliser des revues de premier article sur les pièces de développement.

  • Préparer et maintenir les rapports FAI avec une traçabilité complète des résultats d'inspection.

  • Assurer le suivi des conclusions de la FAI et veiller à ce que les actions correctives soient clôturées avant la mise en production.

 

Mur Qualité – Produits en développement :

  • Gérer le point de contrôle du mur qualité, en vérifiant que chaque unité de développement répond aux critères définis avant de passer à la phase suivante.

  • Tenir à jour les registres du mur qualité et donner de la visibilité sur l'état des produits et les motifs de blocage.

  • Faire remonter les défauts récurrents à l'Ingénierie Qualité et à la Conception pour résolution.

 

Support après-vente et tri chez le client :

  • Participer aux activités de support après-vente, y compris l'inspection sur site et le tri des produits chez les clients si nécessaire.

  • Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour identifier les unités non conformes, isoler les produits défectueux et documenter les résultats.

  • Agir en tant que représentant qualité sur site, assurant la liaison entre le client et les équipes internes pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes de qualité.

  • Remonter les observations du terrain au centre de développement pour piloter les actions correctives et l'amélioration des produits.

 

Système Qualité et Amélioration Continue :

  • Veiller à ce que les rapports d'inspection et de non-conformité soient correctement documentés dans les outils appropriés (Jira, Confluence ou QMS).

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus d'inspection et des critères du mur qualité au fil du temps.

 

Prérequis

  • Diplôme technique en qualité, génie mécanique, fabrication ou domaine connexe.

  • Première expérience dans un rôle d'inspection qualité ou de qualité fabrication, idéalement dans les secteurs de l'aérospatiale, de la défense ou de la haute technologie.

  • Capacité à lire des dessins d'ingénierie et à utiliser les outils d'inspection standards (pieds à coulisse, micromètres, etc.).

  • La connaissance des processus de revue de premier article (FAI) est un plus.

  • Connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et EN 9100.

  • Minutieux, rigoureux et à l'aise pour travailler en atelier.

  • Esprit d'équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

  • Bon niveau d'anglais ; disponibilité pour se déplacer sur les sites des clients si nécessaire.

  • Adhésion totale à la mission de Harmattan AI et volonté de s'investir pleinement pour soutenir notre croissance.

 

Nous avons hâte de découvrir comment vous pouvez aider à façonner l'avenir des systèmes de défense autonomes chez Harmattan AI.

title: Test Engineer (Flight Test) (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join a small, fast-growing engineering team developing a new high-speed air vehicle in the UK, reporting to the programme's Chief Engineer. The team works across both propulsion and airframe, moves fast and uses modern tools, including AI, to maximise progress. We are versatile and hands-on, and we believe great designs are forged at the interfaces. You will work alongside a second test engineer who leads ground testing, and help grow the flight test team as the programme develops.

YOUR MISSION

You will lead the flight test campaign for a new high-speed air vehicle, from early flight vehicles through to qualification. You will own planning and execution, including the test range and licensing interface, and support ground and wind tunnel testing as needed.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the flight test campaign: objectives, instrumentation, test points and schedules
  • Manage the test range interface: bookings, licensing and coordination
  • Produce flight safety documentation
  • Prepare flight vehicles: integration, instrumentation and telemetry
  • Support test operations on site at test ranges
  • Lead post-flight data analysis and reporting
  • Support ground and wind tunnel test campaigns as needed

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

  • Experience of planning and executing flight test campaigns for aerospace vehicles, in a hands-on test engineering role
  • Experience with flight vehicle instrumentation, telemetry and post-test data analysis
  • Engineering degree or equivalent experience
  • Proficient in Python or similar for data processing

Nice to Have

  • Test range licensing and flight safety processes
  • High-speed vehicle flight test
  • Telemetry systems and flight data reconstruction
  • Engine ground testing

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening.


Dit breng jij mee

  • Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden;

  • Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren;

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak;

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren;

  • Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap;

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto;

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike;

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit;

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibelwerkenbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical;

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de vijf weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

title: VP, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

*Open to hiring in London, UK.

Runway is scaling its Enterprise revenue organization with leaders who know how to build and scale high-performance teams. And, who can operate a revenue machine while keeping customer value in mind - leading our industry-based revenue pods responsible for both net-new ACV, NRR, and Renewal.

This role is designed for the leader who wants to accelerate their CRO career trajectory. Someone who knows how to build and scale teams and leadership excellence from $100M to $500M+ organizations, operate in AI-native fluid environments, and have experience selling-to, expanding, and renewing with client operators from across a variety of ICPs (From operators in Marketing, HR, Operations, and Finance, to technologists in AI, IT Infrastructure, and Security).

Runway is searching for leaders who enjoy the build - hiring top-performing AEs and frontline leaders to grow your teams for scale. You’re a leader-of-leaders who lead hybrid revenue pods of AEs + Engagement managers. We expect you to think like a CRO - every pod is effectively a P&L, expansion is as much your number as new logos, and any customer who signs needs to see value through consumption of the Runway platform.

If you have only ever inherited a running enterprise org, this is not the right fit. If you have built one, we'd like to talk.

What you’ll do

  • Build and lead an Enterprise segment of 4 - 5 frontline revenue managers; each with 5 - 8 revenue pods beneath them with operating Enterprise Account Executives and Engagement Managers in each pod. At scale, this role leads 40+ GTM teammates

    • Build regional teams across UK&I, DACH, Benelux, Nordics, and EMEA South, with possible ME expansion.

  • Own the segment's new ACV and NRR targets - both numbers, one owner, reviewed weekly with the CRO

  • Engage personally with C-level executives on accounts, building business cases and navigating procurement, security review, legal through to production deployment

  • Run the operating rhythm: forecasting to +/-5%, deal inspection, pipeline generation discipline, and account planning across a long-cycle book

  • Ensure that each of your leaders engages their revenue pods (AE + Engagement manager) to drive license consumption and value output. The more we invest in our customer’s adoption, the more everyone wins.

What you’ll need

  • 12+ years of enterprise software sales with 5+ years leading enterprise sales organizations with experience as a second-line leader and selling into EMEA-based organizations for at least 5+ years in-region.

  • A validated record of building - you have grown an enterprise segment past 30 sellers and beaten the number while doing it. And, have experience leading post-sales account teams.

  • Personal history of closing and sponsoring $250k-$1M+ ACV deals with $1B+ revenue companies

  • Experience running consumption or usage-based revenue models, where expansion is earned through customer value

  • Fluency with modern AI - you use these tools daily, operate your team with them to drive productivity, you can demo Runway credibly to a CMO or CTO, and you have a defensible point of view on where generative media is going

  • Deep understanding of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message to reinforce value-orientation and deal progression with your teams

  • A record of exceeding quota year-over-year

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience selling API and AI infrastructure solutions to CTO / CIOs

  • Sold creative, media, or content technology to Fortune 500 marketing and studio organizations

  • Built vertical pod or team structures with shared new ACV + NRR%/Renewal ownership

  • Scaled a GTM org through the $100M to $500M+ revenue stage

  • Fluent English required; working German or French desired

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

title: Working Student / Intern (all genders) Electrical Test Systems & Instrumentation
descriptionHtml:
About H2FLY

Join H2FLY, the leader in hydrogen-electric powertrain systems for aviation. Since 2015, we’ve been developing, integrating and testing hydrogen-electric powertrains and demonstrated several records including the world’s first piloted flight powered by liquid hydrogen. 
Since 2021, we’re part of Joby Aviation, the leading developer of electric air taxis. Together, we’re accelerating the path toward quiet, zero-emission flight.
As part of our team, you will work hands-on on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of aviation. By harnessing the power of fuel cell technology, our team is at the forefront of making hydrogen-electric flight a reality.
From engineers to software experts, our team spans different disciplines. We celebrate the different skills and perspectives everyone brings to the table and foster a work environment where new ideas can thrive.
Become part of the future of flight.


Responsibilities

We are looking for a Working Student or Intern (all genders) to support our Test & Validation team and actively contribute to the further development of our test benches and prototypes:

  • Support the setup, wiring, and commissioning of electrical test setups for fuel cell systems
  • Support the integration of sensors, actuators, measurement equipment, and data acquisition systems into our test bench infrastructure
  • Research, select, and evaluate suitable electrical measurement and test equipment
  • Create and revise electrical schematics, control cabinet documentation, and bills of materials (BOMs) using EPLAN Electric P8
  • Support troubleshooting and optimization of test benches and test systems
  • Document electrical systems and maintain technical documentation
  • Support the preparation, execution, and evaluation of development and validation tests

Requirements
  • Enrolled student (all genders) in a technical field, e.g. Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Basic knowledge of electrical engineering, measurement technology, and circuit design
  • Initial experience with EPLAN Electric P8 is a plus
  • Interest in test benches, test systems, and innovative hydrogen technologies
  • Hands-on mentality and good practical skills
  • Independent, structured, and reliable way of working
  • Good German and English language skills

What we're looking for

We're looking for people who take initiative, own their work, and develop solutions together. You enjoy working hands-on, stay curious, and are ready to grow with us.

  • Hands-on mentality: You turn ideas into action and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves
  • Ownership: You take responsibility for your work, embrace new challenges, and think proactively
  • Team collaboration: You work well in teams, communicate clearly, and organize your work independently
  • Structured thinking: You approach complex tasks methodically and focus on finding solutions
  • Personal qualities: Curiosity, resilience, and a willingness to keep growing

What we offer
  • Working with purpose: transforming the aviation industry
  • Remote work options
  • 30 days paid vacation
  • Access to the Corporate Benefits platform
  • A public transport friendly office and In-house gym 
  • Regular team events and celebrations 
  • A team that truly values diversity and achieves great things together
